izzyondroid:com.anthonyla.paperize.name: Paperize - A Wallpaper Changer
izzyondroid:com.anthonyla.paperize.summary: Changes your home and lock screen wallpaper on a schedule, from your own albums
izzyondroid:com.anthonyla.paperize.description:
Paperize changes your home and lock screen wallpaper on a schedule, from albums you build out of your own images and folders. It works offline and has no internet permission.
 Albums: an album holds single images, whole folders, or both. Folders are rescanned when you open the app, and daily while a schedule is running, so new files join the rotation by themselves.
 Schedule: turn on the lock screen, the home screen or both, and pick an album for each. One interval covers both screens, from 15 minutes to 30 days, or each screen can have its own. Wallpapers go in order or shuffled.
 Effects: brightness, blur, vignette and a gray filter, each with a strength slider and separate switches for home and lock. Adaptive brightness adjusts the wallpaper to light or dark mode. Scaling is Fill, Fit, Stretch or None.
 Live wallpaper mode: instead of ordinary static wallpapers, Paperize can run as a live wallpaper that crossfades between images, changes on a double tap or when the screen turns off, moves with your home-screen pages (parallax), and allows intervals down to 1 minute.
 Change now: skip to the next wallpaper from the app, a Quick Settings tile or the app icon shortcut.
 Formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, HEIC/HEIF, BMP, GIF and TIFF.
 Privacy: albums and settings stay on your device. There are no ads, analytics or accounts.
 Privacy policy: https://anthonyy232.github.io/Paperize/#privacy

izzyondroid:inc.flide.vi8.name: 8Vim Keyboard
izzyondroid:inc.flide.vi8.summary: A small screen keyboard inspired by VIM and 8Pen
izzyondroid:inc.flide.vi8.description:
VI8 started essentially as a clone for 8pen, which for some reason they have stopped distributing.
 From the original 8vim description: „The 8vim draws inspiration from handwriting. By mimicking the way our hand moves when constrained to a square canvas, we are able to create a natural and fun writing experience, akin to doodling on a piece of paper. The layout is optimised for fast writing, by allowing for the most common letter sequences to be produced with swift, fluid gestures. Once familiar with the layout, you can reach speeds of 40 words per minute.“
 With 8pen you could actually type blind. Together with any text editor, you could get the job done, but you have to keep your both hands engaged and keep tapping on the various toolbars and buttons... I was missing VIM .
 I wanted my keyboard to also act as the editor. So VI8 , the Editor-in-Keyboard, was born. And here it is – try it out! And head over to the project page for more details.
 Usability Guide 
 So, what capabilities does 8Vim have? Once you know how to type with this thing (Learn how to type with this original 8Pen-game video ), you must know the following:
 Basic Needed Stuff: 
 Right Sector acts as a backspace Key.
 Bottom Sector acts as a Enter Key.
 Top Sector acts as a combination of SHIFT and CAPS_LOCK Key, i.e, Press once Shift is active, Press Twice CAPS is active and Press once more and everything is back to usual.
 Left Sector acts as the button that takes you to the Number Pad.
 Cursor Movements: 
 If you move your finger from the centre-circle to any sector and stay, the cursor movement will be emulated. For example, if you swipe from circle->right, the cursor will move right. You get the picture.
 Selection: 
 There is selection built in to the keyboard. if you move your finger from the right sector to the circle, the cursor will start moving left and selecting everything in it's path. once you release, a selection keyboard will open up for various stupidities to do.
 Paste Functionality: 
 Moving your finger from right->circle->lift-your-finger performs a paste. whatever is in the clipboard.

fdroid:com.florianthaler.githo.name: Githo
fdroid:com.florianthaler.githo.description:
G et I nto T he H abit O f…
Acquiring habits that stick can be difficult. Githo helps you by letting you gradually advance, instead of going from 0 to 100%.
This principle borrows ideas from exposure therapy.
Define levels of your final habit, going from easy to hard. Then start with the first one. Level up by consistently succeeding. If a level is too difficult (= if success isn't consistent), repeat the previous one.
Such a gradual acquisition reduces the physical/mental strain and helps you create a routine long before arriving at the final habit .
 Example of a Habit-Plan: 
Final Habit: Go jogging every morning 
Levels: Every morning... 
 * Week 1: Just step outside on the street, then return home.
 * Week 2: Take a walk around your house/building.
 * Week 3: Take a walk spanning 3-5 buildings.
 * Week 4: Take a longer walk and add short jogging-segments into the mix.
 * Week 5: Go jogging. Well done.
 Permissions 
Permissions are only used to display notifications.

fdroid:com.github.bmx666.appcachecleaner.name: Cache Cleaner
fdroid:com.github.bmx666.appcachecleaner.summary: Clean cache of installed user and system apps using Accessibility
fdroid:com.github.bmx666.appcachecleaner.description:
Since the release of Android 6 (Marshmallow), the option to clear the cache of all apps at once has been restricted by Google to system apps only. This means that users no longer have the convenience of clearing the cache of all their apps simultaneously. To clear the cache of individual apps, one must manually navigate to each app's "App Info" screen, locate the "Storage" menu, and then select the "Clean cache" button.
To simplify this process and save time, Cache Cleaner requests a list of installed apps on your device and utilizes the Accessibility service to replace the manual steps involved in clearing the cache. This allows for a more convenient and automated process of cache cleaning.
 Cache Cleaner provides the added benefit of customizable app lists. This functionality allows you to create personalized lists of specific apps, giving you the flexibility to selectively clear the cache of only the apps you choose.

fdroid:com.gitlab.cyberghost13337.social.name: Social Thread Markdown
fdroid:com.gitlab.cyberghost13337.social.summary: Turn websites and X/Twitter threads into readable, shareable Markdown
fdroid:com.gitlab.cyberghost13337.social.description:
Social Thread Markdown turns website links and X/Twitter posts into clean, readable Markdown. Share a link to the app from your browser or another app, or paste it manually. Preview the result, edit it, and share it with your favorite note-taking or publishing app.
Websites:
- Create a Markdown link card with the page title as a heading, source URL, description, and preview image when available.
- Read Open Graph, Twitter Card, and standard page metadata.
- Save website cards in history and reopen saved Markdown offline.
- Website conversion creates link previews, rather than full article downloads. Some websites require sign-in, block previews, or only expose content through JavaScript. Images remain remote links and may need a connection.
X/Twitter:
- Expand individual posts or full threads by sharing the last tweet.
- Include photos and quoted posts.
- Choose whether to include original links, tweet dates, and author usernames.
- Tweet fetching uses the third-party api.fxtwitter.com service.
Everyday tools:
- Preview, edit, and share Markdown.
- Select and delete individual history items, with confirmation.
- Customize images, source links, text suffixes, and offline saving.
- Choose a dark, light, or system theme.
- Find the installed version and release notes in Settings > About & Changelog.

fdroid:com.nooto.app.name: Nooto
fdroid:com.nooto.app.summary: Cross-platform, privacy-focused notes with end-to-end encryption
fdroid:com.nooto.app.description:
Nooto is a note-taking app that keeps your notes private. Everything is encrypted on your device before it ever leaves it, using AES-256-GCM encryption with keys derived locally via Argon2id. Nobody but you, not even the server operator, can read your notes.
 Features: 
 Notes are encrypted on-device before sync; the server only ever sees ciphertext
 Works fully offline, no account required to use the app locally
 Optional sync across devices, using the built-in public server or your own self-hosted instance
 Folders, drag-and-drop organization, and a markdown editor
 Fully open source and auditable
 What the server stores: only an opaque note ID and ciphertext blobs for content and metadata. No readable title, no readable content, no plaintext of any kind.
 Please note: Nooto is beta software and still under active development. The encryption design has not yet been reviewed by an independent security auditor. Use at your own discretion, and please report issues on the project's GitHub page.

fdroid:com.uc.caffeine.name: Caffeine Health
fdroid:com.uc.caffeine.summary: Track your caffeine. Protect your sleep. Real-time pharmacokinetic curves.
fdroid:com.uc.caffeine.description:
Caffeine Health is a beautifully designed Android app that helps you understand how your caffeine intake affects your body throughout the day — and whether that late-afternoon espresso might cost you sleep tonight.
Log drinks from a curated catalog, watch your active caffeine level in real time on a 24-hour curve, and get a personalized sleep forecast based on your unique metabolism.
 Features: 
• Real-time 24-hour caffeine curve with emoji drink markers
• Personalized pharmacokinetic modeling based on age, weight, lifestyle
• Sleep forecast — see if caffeine will affect your bedtime
• Curated drink catalog: coffee, tea, energy drinks, soda
• Barcode scanning, live or from a photo, with an optional Open Food Facts lookup
• Typo-tolerant drink search and tea re-steep tracking
• Drink detail sheets showing individual contribution curves
• Quick actions — edit, duplicate, or delete entries
• Analytics: caffeine by source, bedtime impact, and when you drink it, hour by hour
• Home screen widgets, reminders, and automation via Tasker, MacroDroid or NFC tags
• Material 3 Expressive design with dynamic color
• Montserrat typography and haptic feedback throughout
• Full dark mode support
 Privacy: 
• Works fully offline — all your data stays on your device
• The internet is only used if you choose to look up a scanned barcode on Open Food Facts, and only the barcode number is sent
• No ads, no tracking, no telemetry, no accounts
• Open source (GPL-3.0)
 Science: 
The app uses a one-compartment oral pharmacokinetic model with personalized half-life calculation. Your caffeine metabolism is estimated from age, weight, smoking status, alcohol intake, and CYP1A2-inhibiting medications — grounded in real pharmacology.

fdroid:dev.khoj.pitaka.fdroid.name: Pitak
fdroid:dev.khoj.pitaka.fdroid.summary: Privacy-first offline library catalogue with an encrypted lending vault
fdroid:dev.khoj.pitaka.fdroid.description:
Pitak is a privacy-first, offline personal library catalogue. Catalogue your books, lend them to borrowers from an encrypted vault, keep a wishlist, import/export your data, make portable backups, and optionally publish a read-only library site.
Features:
* Library — add, edit, search, sort and filter books; soft-delete with restore; on-device cover capture; ISBN barcode scan with metadata lookup (Open Library → Google Books, chained and cached).
* Borrowers vault — a persistent, AES-256-GCM encrypted store for borrowers and loans, unlocked by a passphrase (Argon2id key derivation). Optional biometric unlock.
* Wishlist — track books to acquire; move them to the library on purchase.
* Import / Export — JSON, CSV (including Goodreads import), and paginated PDF export with Indic-script support.
* Backup / Restore — portable .pitabak archives.
* Publish — optionally push a read-only library viewer to GitHub Pages, with PII redaction.
* Library network — save other Pitak libraries and browse their published catalogues inside the app (search, filter, sort, read-only detail), with an explicit "Open in browser" fallback.
* App-lock — optional biometric/device-credential gate before the library screen.
Privacy posture: local-first by default. Sensitive data lives in the platform Keystore; secrets are held as wipeable bytes. Network calls happen only on explicit user action (ISBN lookup, publish, Refresh, opening a saved library, opt-in remote covers). A catalogue you open is not stored on your device, and its cover images load only while you view it and only if the remote-cover switch is on. Screenshots are blocked while sensitive data is visible.
The cryptographic core is written in Rust and built entirely from source.

fdroid:es.manifold.sidedeck.name: SideDeck
fdroid:es.manifold.sidedeck.summary: Free DJ app. Mix on your phone. No subscriptions.
fdroid:es.manifold.sidedeck.description:
SideDeck is a free, open-source DJ app for Android. Mix local files on dual decks, or plug in a USB mixer such as the Teenage Engineering EP-136 K.O. Sidekick and mix on the hardware. No monthly subscription, no paywall, no premium tier.
MIX ON THE PHONE, OR ON HARDWARE
Use SideDeck as a standalone DJ app: landscape dual decks, waveforms, 3-band EQ, filter, and a crossfader. Or connect a USB mixer and send Deck A and Deck B out as separate stereo channels so you EQ, cue, and mix on the device.
SideDeck is built to work with the Teenage Engineering EP-136 K.O. Sidekick. Connect the EP-136 over USB, set Sidekick USB mode to Multi, and enable the external mixer in SideDeck. Deck A and Deck B go out separately so you can mix on the EP-136. The on-screen EQ and crossfader step aside so you're mixing on the hardware, not fighting a software mixer.
Other USB mixers that can take Deck A and Deck B as separate outputs work the same way.
YOUR MUSIC, YOUR SERVER
SideDeck plays tracks from your phone and from a Subsonic music server. Point it at any Subsonic-compatible library, browse albums and tracks, and download them to the device.
Load music from folders on the phone. Analyze BPM and musical key on load. The library highlights keys that sit well with what's already on a deck.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Dual-deck landscape DJ layout with waveforms
• Sync, loops, BPM nudge and jump
• Internal mixer: 3-band EQ, filter, crossfader
• USB out to the Teenage Engineering EP-136 K.O. Sidekick (and similar mixers)
• Subsonic browse and download
• Local library with BPM and key analysis
FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
SideDeck is GNU GPL v3 software. There is no subscription, no in-app DJ "pro" unlock. If you want a DJ app that works with the Teenage Engineering EP-136 K.O. Sidekick, talks to a Subsonic server, and stays free, this is it.
Requires Android 8.0 or later. USB host (OTG) on the phone if you use an external mixer such as the EP-136 K.O. Sidekick.

fdroid:io.github.buerlino.gridload.name: GridLoad
fdroid:io.github.buerlino.gridload.summary: Shows when to run your appliances, based on the dynamic electricity price
fdroid:io.github.buerlino.gridload.description:
GridLoad tells you at a glance whether now is a good time to run household appliances like the washing machine, dishwasher or EV charger. It reads your tariff's dynamic electricity price, or the day-ahead market price, and shows one colour:
 Green, good time: electricity is cheap, run your appliances now.
 Orange, fair time: average price, only run what you need.
 Red, bad time: electricity is expensive, wait if you can.
The price now is compared with the next 24 hours, so red means a cheaper time is coming, and the app shows when the next good time starts. A price curve shows those prices in their colours and how long the green lasts. Cheap times are when the grid has the most to spare, for example at midday when solar power peaks. Shifting load to those times lowers your bill and helps the grid.
 Regions: in Switzerland the price comes from your local utility's dynamic tariff: Central Switzerland (CKW), Canton of Zurich (EKZ), Einsiedeln (EKZ Einsiedeln), Fribourg and Neuchâtel (Groupe E), Northwestern Switzerland (Primeo Energie), Olten area (AVAG) and Gretzenbach (ELAG). In Austria, Belgium (Flanders, and Wallonia and Brussels), Germany, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg and the Netherlands it's the day-ahead market price (Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de, via energy-charts.info, CC BY 4.0); enter your supplier's add-on to see your own price. On a fixed-price tariff the colour doesn't change your bill, but it still shows when the grid has power to spare.
 whatwatt: with a whatwatt Go smart meter reader on your home Wi-Fi (with its Plus licence, wherever its adapter fits your meter), GridLoad also shows what your home draws right now and what that costs per hour.
 Peak load: some tariffs also charge for the month's highest 15-minute average (for example CKW's Home dynamic, Flanders, and Austria from 2027). With a whatwatt, GridLoad shows this quarter hour's projected draw against a limit (by default the month's highest, raised to what your biggest appliance needs and the least your tariff bills; each part, and a goal of your own, can be switched on or off) and how many kW are still free, and warns with a red bar and a vibration when it reaches the limit, with a Share button to tell your household. A history shows each day's highest quarter hour this month; tap it for a day's quarter hours and last month. Below it, your base load: what your home always draws, and what it comes to in a year. A small recorder script that GridLoad installs on the whatwatt saves every quarter hour on its SD card, also while the app is closed, and the app tells you exactly when it stops.
 Appliances: measure each appliance once with the whatwatt, and GridLoad says per appliance whether to switch it on now or wait, and until when: so it doesn't reach the limit, or, for a dishwasher or washing machine, because a later start is clearly cheaper. A waiting row sets a timer for the later start and says what waiting saves.
 Privacy: no account, no ads, no tracking. Internet access loads today's and tomorrow's prices from the utility or Energy-Charts. On Android 17 and later, the local network permission lets the app read your whatwatt; it's asked for only if you connect one.

fdroid:io.github.the_brotherhood_of_scu..name: Bugaoshan
fdroid:io.github.the_brotherhood_of_scu..summary: A campus assistant app for Sichuan University students
fdroid:io.github.the_brotherhood_of_scu..description:
Bugaoshan is a free and open-source campus assistant app designed for Sichuan University (SCU) students. It aggregates essential campus services into one convenient platform.
 Key features: 
• Course schedule management — Import your timetable from the academic affairs office, view daily schedules, and use the home screen widget for quick access
• Grade tracking — View grades, analyze pass rates, and track academic progress
• Exam schedule — Check upcoming exam dates and arrangements
• Physical fitness test records — View your fitness test results
• Classroom availability — Find empty classrooms across campus in real time
• Balance inquiry — Check campus card balance, network fees, dormitory electricity, and air conditioning balances with historical trend analysis

fdroid:net.af0.where.name: Where
fdroid:net.af0.where.description:
Where is a cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted realtime location sharing app.
Where is designed so the server learns as little as possible:
* No accounts. Identity is a device-scoped ephemeral key pair — no usernames, email addresses, or persistent IDs.
* End-to-end encrypted by default. Location payloads are encrypted with a Double Ratchet protocol before they leave the device. The server routes opaque ciphertext and cannot read coordinates.
* No social graph. Routing uses pairwise anonymous tokens; the server cannot reconstruct who is sharing with whom.
* Forward secrecy. Automated keepalives advance the ratchet even when only one party is sharing, so past sessions cannot be decrypted if a key is later compromised.
This build uses MapLibre and Android's built-in location APIs instead of Google Maps and Play Services. Map tiles are fetched from tiles.openfreemap.org, which sees the map area you view (but not your identity or shared locations).

 README .

 XposedUnifiedNlp
module , or your custom ROM must have org.microg.nlp added to the list of
network location services, otherwise https://f-droid.org/packages/com.google.android.gms would be more

 Suspend Games
 Pause cutscenes to read the subtitles, examine the scene, answer the door, etc.
 Pause games that can't normally be paused (single-player games like Dark Souls, Elden Ring, etc)
 Suspend games whose pause screens keep the system running hot or playing unwanted music
 Suspend inbetween checkpoints (example: Hollow Knight)
 Suspend Applications
 Nyrna can be used to suspend normal, non-game applications as well. For example:
 3D renders
 video encoding
 software compilation
 The CPU and GPU resources are being used by said task - maybe for hours - when you would like to use the system for something else. With Nyrna you can suspend that program, freeing up the resources (excluding RAM) until the process is resumed, without losing where you were - like the middle of a long job, or a gaming session between save points.

MuseScore is cross-platform, multi-lingual, open source music notation software. It features an easy to use WYSIWYG editor with audio score playback for results that look and sound beautiful. It supports unlimited staves with up to four voices each, dynamics, articulations, lyrics, chords, lead sheet notation, import/export of MIDI and MusicXML, export to PDF and WAV, plus online score sharing.
 MuseScore can upload scores directly to the score sharing site musescore.com. Program support is provided on musescore.org.
 Features supported by MuseScore include:
 Unlimited score length
 Unlimited number of staves per system
 Up to four independent voices per staff
 Score creation wizard and templates
 Automatic part extraction and transposition
 Repeats, including segnos, codas, and measure repeats
 Dynamics, articulations, and other expression markings, with playback support for most
 Custom text markings
 Lyrics
 Chord symbols
 Jazz notation, including lead sheets, slash notation and a “handwritten” font for text
 Swing and shuffle playback
 Mixer for instrument levels and effects
 Percussion notation
 Early music notation
 Cross-staff beaming
 Import of graphics
 Custom key signatures
 Additive time signatures
 User-defined score styles
 Most elements in MuseScore are laid out automatically but can also be positioned manually. The capabilities of MuseScore can be extended via plugins, and the growing repository on musescore.org contains many plugins submitted by users.
 MuseScore includes a set of sounds that reproduce common instruments (as defined by General MIDI) without taking up a lot of disk space or memory, but you can also substitute any SoundFont you prefer for a wider variety of sounds or for more realism.
 MuseScore can import and export MIDI and MusicXML files, and it can also import from Capella and several other programs. MuseScore can export to PDF, PNG, and other graphic formats, to WAV and other audio formats, or to Lilypond for an alternative layout and print option.

Its purpose is mainly for 3D games where accurate detection is needed between two non-simple objects. Features: * Works on any model, even polygon soups. * Uses bounding box hierarchies for fast detection. * Uses additional triangle intersection tests for 100% accuracy. * Provides (upon request) exact point of collision, plus the pair of triangles that collided. * Supports timeout setting, to limit detection time. * Model-Model collision test. * Ray-Model collision test. * Segment-Model collision test. * Sphere-Model collision test. * Ray-Sphere and Sphere-Sphere primitive collision tests. * Multi-object collision system with sweep-and-prune broad phase.

Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. fedora-packages:gifsicle/gifsicle.description: Gifsicle is a command-line tool for creating, editing, and getting information about GIF images and animations. Some more gifsicle features: * Batch mode for changing GIFs in place. * Prints detailed information about GIFs, including comments. * Control over interlacing, comments, looping, transparency... * Creates well-behaved GIFs: removes redundant colors, only uses local color tables if it absolutely has to (local color tables waste space and can cause viewing artifacts), etc. * It can shrink colormaps and change images to use the Web-safe palette (or any colormap you choose). * It can optimize your animations! This stores only the changed portion of each frame, and can radically shrink your GIFs. You can also use transparency to make them even smaller. Gifsicle?s optimizer is pretty powerful, and usually reduces animations to within a couple bytes of the best commercial optimizers. * Unoptimizing animations, which makes them easier to edit. * A dumb-ass name. firefox-addons:782160.name: Firefox Multi-Account Containers
firefox-addons:782160.summary: Firefox Multi-Account Containers lets you keep parts of your online life separated into color-coded tabs. Cookies are separated by container, allowing you to use the web with multiple accounts and integrate Mozilla VPN for an extra layer of privacy.
firefox-addons:782160.description:
About This Extension 
The Firefox Multi-Account Containers extension lets you carve out a separate box for each of your online lives – no more opening a different browser just to check your work email!
Under the hood, it separates website storage into tab-specific Containers. Cookies downloaded by one Container are not available to other Containers. You can even integrate individual Containers with Mozilla VPN to protect your browsing and location. With the Firefox Multi-Account Containers extension, you can...
 Sign in to two different accounts on the same site (for example, you could sign in to work email and home email in two different Container tabs.
 Keep different kinds of browsing far away from each other (for example, you might use one Container tab for managing your Checking Account and a different Container tab for searching for new songs by your favorite band)
 Avoid leaving social-network footprints all over the web (for example, you could use a Container tab for signing in to a social network, and use a different tab for visiting online news sites, keeping your social identity separate from tracking scripts on news sites)
 Protect your browsing activity in individual Containers using Mozilla VPN, so you can shop while travelling abroad but check your bank account from a server in your home country.
After installing the Firefox Multi-Account Containers extension, click the Containers icon to edit your Containers. Change their colors, names, and icons. Long-click the new tab button to open a new Container tab.
 For more information on how to use Multi-Account Containers, visit our help articles: 
 All about Multi Account Containers 
 Multi Container user - how to use Mozilla VPN 
 VPN subscriber - how to use Multi Account Containers

firefox-addons:2873939.name: Cunny Translate
firefox-addons:2873939.summary: The cute and funny translator that lets you easily translate Cunny Code as you browse the web.
firefox-addons:2873939.description:
Cunny Translate lets you easily translate to and from Cunny Code, a variation of Morse Code, while browsing the web.
Its functionality is fairly straightforward:
1. Select/highlight Cunny Code or regular texts with your cursor.
2. Click the extension icon or right click and choose "Cunny Translate" from the context menu.
3. The popup window for the extension should open and automatically translate Cunny Code to English and vice versa.
Cunny Translate also offers the ability to encrypt and decrypt messages with a password for those that want to keep their communications private.
Learn more about Cunny Code at https://sethclydesdale.github.io/cunny-code/code/ 
You can also contribute to the development of this extension on GitHub at https://github.com/SethClydesdale/cunny-translate

bluejetty:00013701:ios.description:
Yearly lets you systematically read your Bible in a year, with several plans and translations to choose from. It’s a simple app with a single main screen that focuses on one week at a time. Each day of the week is a swipeable card that features wood-engravings from the 19th-century artist Gustave Doré. You can read each day’s reading directly within the app, mark days as read, and keep track of your overall progress. Within Yearly's settings, you can customize your schedule’s start day to begin any day of the year. By default, your start date is set to the day you download and open Yearly for the first time. With just 15-20 minutes of reading each day, you can read the Bible cover-to-cover in a year!
Yearly’s base features are free, and you can enjoy a 1-month free trial for the premium experience. With Yearly premium, your progress and settings are securely saved in iCloud, so they’re always backed up and synced in real-time. Yearly premium sends an optional notification every morning, allowing you to see your day’s reading right from your lock screen. You can customize when you receive this notification and optionally keep a badge on the app icon until the current day’s reading is complete. With Yearly premium, you can also take secure notes on your daily readings.
We are committed to making the best bible schedule app on the market and welcome your questions and feedback! We’re honored to be part of your daily Bible reading journey.

bluejetty:00017929:ios.summary: The Fortis Private Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so
bluejetty:00017929:ios.description:
The Fortis Private Bank Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Fortis Private Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Fortis Private Bank Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a Fortis Private Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00090903:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Flirt, compete and couple up with other singles under a blazing island sun in this interactive story game. Who will you bring with you to Paradise?
Experience your own romance in the emotional pressure cooker of "Single's Inferno," the hit Netflix dating show that viewers around the world have fallen for. In this choice-driven game, you and a group of other highly eligible contestants live and look for love on a remote tropical island, where your decisions shape the story. As romances and rivalries heat up, can you find someone you'd walk through fire for?
LOCKED OUT OF HEAVEN
You and your fellow participants will sleep, cook and compete in challenges at the bare-bones Inferno beach camp. But you'll have chances to match with a romantic prospect and be whisked off for a night in Paradise — a luxurious resort where you'll share a suite (and swap secrets) with your potential sweetie.
DESIGN A DREAMBOAT
Customize your character with a huge array of options for gender, facial features, skin color, hair, accessories, outfits and more. You can date partners of any gender and select the job, hobbies and values that fit you best.
FAMILIAR FACES
Enjoy quippy commentary from a panel of MCs observing all the drama, just like the real-world reality show. "Single's Inferno" Season 3 favorites Ha-jeong and Gwan-hee appear as hosts alongside newcomer Jun-hee.
CUTE CORRESPONDENCE
Send anonymous letters to your love interests. You choose: Are you feeling romantic, flirty, funny or spicy? If you make a big impression on another Inferno resident, you might get a note in your own mailbox!
AN INTERACTIVE LOVE STORY
Decision points throughout the story impact your relationships with other characters — whether they're crushes, friends or foes. Check the Love Leaderboard after each chapter and episode to see how your choices influence connections.
- Created by XO Games.

bluejetty:00120999:ios.summary: Callbreak, Ludo, Rummy, Dhumbal, 29, Kitti, Solitaire, Jutpatti, Marriage, Block Puzzle, Spades and Gin Rummy are the most popular games among board/card games. These games are pretty easy to learn and play. We included all those games in a
bluejetty:00120999:ios.description:
Callbreak, Ludo, Rummy, Dhumbal, 29, Kitti, Solitaire, Jutpatti, Marriage, Block Puzzle, Spades and Gin Rummy are the most popular games among board/card games. These games are pretty easy to learn and play. We included all those games in a single game. 
Call Break, is played with 4 players. There are 5 rounds and the players must play the same suit. Spade is the default trump card. You can place your bid and the bid for every round to earn points. The player with the highest bid to win will be the winner. 
Ludo is a simple board game. You wait for your turn, roll the dice, and move your coins according to the number that shows up on the dice. You can configure the rules of Ludo and play with bots or other players.
Rummy (Indian and Nepali) is played between 2 to 5 players with 10 cards in Nepal and 13 cards in India. The aim is to form groups of sequences and trials/sets to meet the game requirements. Jokers can be used to form the sequences or sets if at least one pure sequence is arranged.
Dhumbal is played with 2 to 5 players. The aim is to have the lowest possible sum of card numbers. You can throw pure sequences or paired cards to get the minimal value. One can show the game if the total sum of card numbers is less than or equal to the required value.
Kitti (9 Cards) is played with 9 cards each between 2 to 5 players. In Kitti, you arrange three groups of cards, 3 in each. Just like Teen-Patti, but to win the round, you should win two shows consecutively. Once the Kitti cards are arranged in three groups of three cards each, you show one group at a time and compare it with the others. The Kitti game runs for three shows each round. If you win 2 or more consecutive shows, you win the game else cards are shuffled.
Solitaire is one of the most played card games. The game is easy, and the rules are simple. The version of Solitaire included in this game requires you to chain alternating cards. That means a red card can be chained with a black card. Arrange all the cards to win the game.
29 is a card game played with 4 players in 2 teams. The game starts with each player placing a bid until the highest bid is set. The player with the highest bid selects the trump card and can opt to play single-handedly excluding the teammate for that round. The game is won by the team that reaches a score of +6 points or when the opponent scores -6 points. 
Jutpatti is played with 9 cards each. The objective is to form pairs of cards where the joker card can be paired with any card. Players pick cards to make pairs. The first player to match all cards with valid pairs wins the game. 
Marriage is a popular card game played with 21 cards each and 3 decks. The goal is to arrange cards into sets, sequences, or seven pairs of twins (dublees) to unlock the Joker, called Maal. Winning depends on your arranged cards, Maal, and remaining cards' value, not just on declaring first. Currently, the game includes three popular modes: Classic, Murder and Kidnap. 
Block Puzzle is a simple puzzle game, perfect for relaxing your mind and sharpening your brain. Just drag and drop the colorful blocks to complete rows or columns and clear the board. Blast multiple lines at once to make combos and set high scores. 
Spades is a classic card game where you team up, bid smart, and win as many tricks as possible. Bid on how many tricks your team can win, play your cards wisely, and use the spade suit as trump to outplay your opponents. The first team to reach 250/500 points wins the game. 
Gin Rummy is a fun card game where you arrange your cards into sequences or sets, reduce your deadwood points, and be the first to score 100 points to win. The rules are simple, but the game is competitive. 
Please send us your feedback, and we'll improve the game for you. 
Thank you for playing Callbreak and more.

Block Puzzle is a simple puzzle game, perfect for relaxing your mind and sharpening your brain. Just drag and drop the colorful blocks to complete rows or columns and clear the board. Blast multiple lines at once to make combos and set high scores.  
 
Spades is a classic card game where you team up, bid smart, and win as many tricks as possible. Bid on how many tricks your team can win, play your cards wisely, and use the spade suit as trump to outplay your opponents. The first team to reach 250/500 points wins the game.   
 
Gin Rummy is a fun card game where you arrange your cards into sequences or sets, reduce your deadwood points, and be the first to score 100 points to win. The rules are simple, but the game is competitive.  
 
Please send us your feedback, and we'll improve the game for you. 
Thank you for playing Callbreak and more.

但由於難度較高，強烈不建議新手上來就挑戰困難難度。
【遊戲特點】
豐富的戰鬥陣形和技能，
在戰斗場景中山河、湖泊、城關等不同地形上有變化多端的戰術組合，
加上天氣系統對戰局的影響，使得戰場玩法極具特色。
根據面對敵人的情況不同，
不同戰術可以形成各自的打法流派，
常見的如搶城速攻流、近戰突擊流，單挑控制流、遠射連珠流等等。
數十萬字原創遊戲文本，全部源自製作團隊對相關史料的分析提煉，
各種武將列傳、軼事；各地的背景介紹，皆有可靠的依據出處。
玩家玩遊戲的同時能感受到那個時代的文化氣息、社會風貌，
從更豐富的層面帶玩家領略濃厚的歷史人文精神。
【玩家攻略社区】 
Facebook:三國志天下布武 
Line:sanguo15
【為什麼選擇開發這款遊戲】
我從小便沉迷於《霸王的大陸》和光榮的《三國志》，
但市面上很難找到類似玩法的手機遊戲。
於是我做了一個，只是沒想到，這個歷程是如此的艱難。
我常常跟同是做這類產品的朋友浪子交流，他說《漢末霸業》一路走來，一樣殊為不易，在這個年代想要有自己的堅持，必須付出相當的代價。
經常有朋友問我，“為什麼不去做別的更賺錢的遊戲？”
的確，我們的這款遊戲不怎麼賺錢，
不充值都可以玩的很開心，充個幾十能嗨皮幾個月。
朋友的這個問題，是對我的靈魂拷問。
因為我的年紀已經不小了，拖家帶口的，這個問題必須正視。
但朋友說的“那種賺錢的遊戲”，我不喜歡。
朋友不理解我對這種遊戲的感情。
在那個網吧還只有局域網的年代，
這個品類的遊戲伴著我度過了無數個日日夜夜。
為了統一全國殫精竭慮，以至於茶飯不思、夙夜難眠。
那時的我，是沉浸的，是幸福的。
而現在，我有機會能利用我的專業技能把這種感受發揚光大。
把我自己對這種遊戲的理解傾注到產品之中，
置於更大的平台之上，
讓更多跟我同樣喜歡這類游戲的玩家體會到這種快樂，
這是一種使命，一種榮譽。
能做這個遊戲，是我人生中最幸福的事情。
我還有很多關於它的想法，已經在心頭縈繞多年，
我想要呈現的，還遠不止之前大家曾看到的。
如果能賺錢，我會把這個遊戲一直做下去。
如果賺不到，我就先去做點別的，用賺來的錢把這個遊戲繼續做下去。
逝水東流，青山依舊，是非成敗，任人評說。
我素未謀面的朋友們，祝你們玩得開心。
——遊戲製作人：奶牛

bluejetty:00032394:ios.summary:

This magical world of unicorns has everything you need to dress up and get creative. Experiment wi
bluejetty:00032394:ios.description:
Are you ready to create your very own magical unicorns? Jump in to design glamorous unicorns with unique accessories and looks that sparkle!
This magical world of unicorns has everything you need to dress up and get creative. Experiment with a nearly endless combination of styles, accessories, colors, gems, jewels, and so much more!
Designed for preschoolers and toddlers to be creative. Your little one will love making glamorous unicorns, dressing them up, and taking fashion photos over and over again. It's creative screen time you can feel good about.
WHAT’S INSIDE THE APP
UNICORN CREATOR
- Choose a body and color; it could be pink with little hearts, dark purple with beautiful spots, or anything you can dream up.
- Pick out their hair, mane, and tail. There are so many different styles and colors to choose from.
- What makes a unicorn special? Its horn! It could be rainbow-colored, glittery, glowing, or a simple, classic style.
- Accessorize! Give your unicorns amazing eyes and makeup, and add some earrings, shoes, and even wings!
- Select background decorations when you’re ready to take the perfect photo; choose from hearts, bubbles, flowers, butterflies, balloons, snowflakes, and feathers.
NECKLACE MAKER & JEWELRY BOX
To really make your unicorns special, design a one-off necklace that is crafted exactly how you want it. Choose the chain and pendant, then add a photo to the pendant — using the photos you have already taken! Next add a nearly endless combination of different beads and trinkets, using all the colors of the rainbow. You can even add letters and make a personalized name necklace with your or your unicorn's name on it! All your necklaces will be displayed in your jewelry box.
PHOTO STUDIO & ALBUM
Don’t forget to take a photo! Frame your gorgeous unicorns in the photo studio, pick your favorite background decorations, and SNAP! All your fabulous photos will be saved in the unicorn photo album.
KEY FEATURES:
- Ad-free with no disruptions, enjoy uninterrupted play
- Promotes creativity and boosts imagination
- Non-competitive gameplay — just open-ended fun!
- Kid-friendly, colorful, and enchanting design
- No parental support needed, simple and intuitive gameplay
- Play offline, no wifi needed — perfect for traveling
ABOUT US
We make apps and games that kids and parents love! Our range of products lets kids of all ages learn, grow, and play. Check out our Developers Page to see more.
Contact us: hello@bekids.com
SUBSCRIPTION:
1. Once subscribed you can access all content and features of this app.
2. We offer 1 subscription method.
3. Subscription automatically renews unless auto renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
4. Manage your subscriptions and turn off automatic renewal in your Apple account settings.
5. Privacy Policy: https://www.bekids.com/privacy/en/privacy.html
6. Terms of Service: https://www.bekids.com/terms/en/terms.html

bluejetty:00075680:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate Nail Art Salon Makeover Game for Girls! This exciting game allows you to unleash your inner creativity and become a skilled nail artist.
Use your precision skills to apply each nail polish layer and add intricate details with various nail art tools, such as gems, stickers, and stencils. Don't forget to add a glossy topcoat to complete the look!
Why this Nail Art Salon Makeover Game for Girls is different?
Manicure: As players enter the Manicure View, they are presented with a virtual hand on the screen, complete with a range of tools and an extensive collection of nail polish colors, patterns, and accessories. With precise control and creativity, players can meticulously shape and file the nails, push back cuticles, and even apply nourishing treatments.
NailArt: Using an intuitive and user-friendly interface, players can choose from a vast collection of nail polish colors, including vibrant shades, pastels, neons, metallics, and more. They can also select from various nail art techniques such as gradient effects, marbling, stamping, or intricate designs using tiny brushes.
Jewellery: Jewellery in the nail art salon game introduces a touch of elegance and luxury to players' nail art creations. This feature allows players to enhance their nail designs with dazzling accessories and embellishments, transforming ordinary nails into miniature works of art.
What will you get?
Dive into a colorful and funky world of nail art where love meets mermaid magic and rainbow hues. Embark on a wild safari of creativity, painting vibrant designs that reflect your unique style in this nail art salon game.
Colourful: Get ready to unleash your creativity with a vibrant and colorful nail art game. Paint dazzling designs, mix bold shades, and create stunning masterpieces that will make your nails pop. With a rainbow of options at your fingertips, express your unique style and become the ultimate nail art virtuoso.
Funky : Step into a world of funk and boldness with this exciting nail art game. Let your imagination run wild as you experiment with unconventional patterns, edgy designs, and vibrant colors. Get ready to make a bold statement and unleash your inner funky artist!
Love: Indulge in a romantic journey filled with love and beauty in this enchanting nail art game. Express your affection with heartwarming designs, delicate motifs, and soft pastel shades. Immerse yourself in a world of love and create nail art that captures the essence of romance.
Mermaid : Dive into a mesmerizing underwater world with the mermaid nail art game. Create stunning designs inspired by mythical sea creatures, iridescent scales, and shimmering ocean hues. Unleash your inner mermaid and let your nails shimmer and shine with enchanting beauty.
Rainbow : Embark on a colorful journey with the rainbow nail art game. Paint your nails with vibrant hues of the rainbow, blending shades and creating stunning ombre effects. Let your creativity soar as you design rainbow-inspired nail art that spreads joy and positivity with every brushstroke.
Safari : Set off on an adventurous nail art safari through the wild savannah. Explore the beauty of nature and create captivating designs inspired by exotic animals, lush landscapes, and earthy tones. Unleash your artistic prowess and transform your nails into a safari-inspired masterpiece.
With easy-to-use controls and stunning graphics, Nail Art Salon is the perfect game for anyone who loves fashion and beauty. Download now and start creating your dream nail designs!

Why this Nail Art Salon Makeover Game for Girls is different?

Manicure: As players enter the Manicure View, they are presented with a virtual hand on the screen, complete with a range of tools and an extensive collection of nail polish colors, patterns, and accessories. With precise control and creativity, players can meticulously shape and file the nails, push back cuticles, and even apply nourishing treatments.

NailArt: Using an intuitive and user-friendly interface, players can choose from a vast collection of nail polish colors, including vibrant shades, pastels, neons, metallics, and more. They can also select from various nail art techniques such as gradient effects, marbling, stamping, or intricate designs using tiny brushes.

Jewellery: Jewellery in the nail art salon game introduces a touch of elegance and luxury to players' nail art creations. This feature allows players to enhance their nail designs with dazzling accessories and embellishments, transforming ordinary nails into miniature works of art.


What will you get?

Dive into a colorful and funky world of nail art where love meets mermaid magic and rainbow hues. Embark on a wild safari of creativity, painting vibrant designs that reflect your unique style in this nail art salon game.

Colourful: Get ready to unleash your creativity with a vibrant and colorful nail art game. Paint dazzling designs, mix bold shades, and create stunning masterpieces that will make your nails pop. With a rainbow of options at your fingertips, express your unique style and become the ultimate nail art virtuoso.

Funky : Step into a world of funk and boldness with this exciting nail art game. Let your imagination run wild as you experiment with unconventional patterns, edgy designs, and vibrant colors. Get ready to make a bold statement and unleash your inner funky artist!

Love: Indulge in a romantic journey filled with love and beauty in this enchanting nail art game. Express your affection with heartwarming designs, delicate motifs, and soft pastel shades. Immerse yourself in a world of love and create nail art that captures the essence of romance.

Mermaid : Dive into a mesmerizing underwater world with the mermaid nail art game. Create stunning designs inspired by mythical sea creatures, iridescent scales, and shimmering ocean hues. Unleash your inner mermaid and let your nails shimmer and shine with enchanting beauty.

Rainbow : Embark on a colorful journey with the rainbow nail art game. Paint your nails with vibrant hues of the rainbow, blending shades and creating stunning ombre effects. Let your creativity soar as you design rainbow-inspired nail art that spreads joy and positivity with every brushstroke.

Safari : Set off on an adventurous nail art safari through the wild savannah. Explore the beauty of nature and create captivating designs inspired by exotic animals, lush landscapes, and earthy tones. Unleash your artistic prowess and transform your nails into a safari-inspired masterpiece.

With easy-to-use controls and stunning graphics, Nail Art Salon is the perfect game for anyone who loves fashion and beauty. Download now and start creating your dream nail designs!

bluejetty:00014845:ios.name: USPS Mobile®
bluejetty:00014845:ios.summary: Access popular USPS.com® tools on the go with the “USPS Mobile® app: calculate shipping prices (limitations apply), find a Post Office™, look up a ZIP Code™, schedule a next-day pickup, request USPS to hold your mail, access Informed Delive
bluejetty:00014845:ios.description:
Access popular USPS.com® tools on the go with the “USPS Mobile® app: calculate shipping prices (limitations apply), find a Post Office™, look up a ZIP Code™, schedule a next-day pickup, request USPS to hold your mail, access Informed Delivery® to track packages and digitally preview incoming mail, and more.
WHAT CAN IT DO?
The USPS Mobile app allows you to:
• Check the status of shipments sent using Priority Mail®, Priority Mail Express®, Certified Mail®, and certain other delivery services. Nickname your shipments and sign up for text and email alerts to notify you of the delivery status.
• Calculate a Domestic or International Price to determine how much postage you will need when you ship a letter, card, large envelope, or package (limitations apply). Choose retail or online pricing, add any extra services you need, and view the total, too.
• Find USPS® Locations when you need to get to a Post Office™, Self-Service Kiosk (APC®) or collection box with an easy-to-filter locator. The USPS Mobile app uses your device’s GPS to show your closest options on a map, along with their Regular Hours, Special Hours and Last Collection Times, and provides mapped results with driving, walking, or transit directions. 
• Look up a ZIP Code™ for any U.S. or Canadian address.
• Schedule a free next-day pickup and have your Letter Carrier pick up Priority Mail®, Priority Mail Express®, Global Express Guaranteed®, or Merchandise Return Services shipments from your home or office during regular mail delivery. 
• Request Hold Mail Service while you’re away, and we’ll keep your mail at your local Post Office™ for you to pick up or be delivered by your carrier when you return.
• Scan the barcode on shipping labels with your device’s camera (Note: this function is not available on iPad 1 and iPod Touch models without rear-facing cameras). The app recognizes the shipment and stores the label number, so you can stay on top of delivery status.
Link to Informed Delivery to track packages and digitally preview your household’s incoming mail arriving soon; view grayscale images of the exterior, address side of letter-sized mailpieces.

bluejetty:00073097:ios.description:
ID Piauí é o aplicativo oficial de identidade digital do Instituto de Identificação da Polícia Civil do Estado do Piauí.
Agora você pode ter a sua ID Digital do Piauí sempre disponível no seu dispositivo celular. ID Digital Piauí é um aplicativo gratuito que proporciona maior privacidade de dados, segurança e praticidade ao se identificar.
IMPORTANTE:
Para utilizar o app ID Piauí, verifique se a sua carteira de identidade possui Código QR na parte interna (disponível no RG impresso emitido a partir de 10/2022).
A versão digital através do ID Piauí é válida em todo o território nacional e possui o mesmo valor jurídico da versão impressa.
Para a sua segurança, este aplicativo não pode ser utilizado em dois ou mais dispositivos ao mesmo tempo.
Confira os benefícios de se identificar no seu dia a dia através da versão digital:
Acesso ao seu documento de Identidade Digital, independentemente de conectividade à internet, após a conclusão da primeira validação do documento;
Armazenamento e transporte das suas informações de identificação com maior segurança por meio de proteção biométrica e senha;
A versão digital dispensa cópia autenticada em cartório, uma vez que é válida assim como o documento impresso;
Identidade digital na palma da sua mão através do dispositivo celular para ter acesso a serviços de instituições públicas e privadas;
Inclusão e gerenciamento de documentos de identificação de filhos e dependentes no aplicativo;
Possibilidade de compartilhar cópia segura, assinada digitalmente com certificado digital, compatível e adequado aos padrões ICP-Brasil.
COMO UTILIZAR O RG DIGITAL:
Passo 1: Instale o aplicativo ID Piauí no seu dispositivo celular. Para o primeiro acesso, é necessário ter em mãos a versão impressa emitida após outubro de 2022.
Passo 2: Identifique o Código QR na parte interna do seu RG impresso e siga as instruções para validação do código e verificação biométrica do seu rosto.
Passo 3: Pronto! Agora é só aguardar a confirmação dos seus dados.
Em poucos minutos, o seu RG Digital estará disponível no seu dispositivo celular para maior praticidade e segurança.
ID Piauí é um aplicativo oficial do Instituto de Identificação da Polícia Civil do Estado do Piauí desenvolvido através da prestação de serviço pela empresa Valid.
Saiba mais em: https://id.pi.gov.br/
Copyright: @VALID

Identidade digital na palma da sua mão através do dispositivo celular para ter acesso a serviços de instituições públicas e privadas;
Inclusão e gerenciamento de documentos de identificação de filhos e dependentes no aplicativo;

Possibilidade de compartilhar cópia segura, assinada digitalmente com certificado digital, compatível e adequado aos padrões ICP-Brasil.

Passo 2: Identifique o Código QR na parte interna do seu RG impresso e siga as instruções para validação do código e verificação biométrica do seu rosto.

Passo 3: Pronto! Agora é só aguardar a confirmação dos seus dados.

Em poucos minutos, o seu RG Digital estará disponível no seu dispositivo celular para maior praticidade e segurança.

Immerse yourself in a new mystical story full of secrets and puzzles! A severe storm and car accident force you to seek refuge in an abandoned Wax Museum. But an unknown force doesn’t let you leave it...

bluejetty:00153873:ios.description:
Welcome to the sizzling excitement of BBQ Sort: Matching Challenge! Step up to the grill and show off your matching prowess in this delectable puzzle adventure.
Start with chill jazz and a few orders, but as you grow, expect huge, time-limited orders. Special requests will need your careful attention and unique cooking skills. Prepare for dynamic challenges and have fun!
How to Master the Grill:
- Sort & Match: Tap and move 3 identical BBQ skewers onto the same grill to complete an order and clear the grill for the next match!
- Strategic Moves: Think ahead! Each level presents unique sorting challenges and a limited time and space. Plan your placements carefully to achieve your goals.
- Sizzling Power-Ups: Stuck on a tricky arrangement? Unleash awesome boosters to clear obstacles and heat up the action!
Why You'll Be Hooked on BBQ Sort: Matching Challenge:
- A Feast for the Senses: Explore a cornucopia of colorful and delicious-looking BBQ ingredients, from perfectly grilled chicken to exotic seafood delights.
- Engaging Puzzles: Test your sorting skills with a variety of level objectives, from clearing specific ingredients to working against the clock or limited skewer space.
- Boost Your Brainpower: Sharpen your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills as you figure out the optimal way to sort each BBQ masterpiece.
Whether you're a seasoned puzzle enthusiast or just looking for a fun and flavorful new challenge, BBQ Sort: Matching Challenge offers a satisfying and engaging experience. Are you ready to fire up your brain and become the BBQ Sort Champion? Let the matching begin!

bluejetty:00062340:ios.description:
The KCTCS App brings your college to your fingertips and helps you stay connected to your campus community. Keep up with your classes, assignments, and important dates with an integrated calendar, and receive timely notifications about deadlines, events, and announcements. Connect with others, explore resources, and stay in the know anytime, anywhere.
Some key features include:
• CLASSES: View your class schedule, assignments, and important academic information all in one place 
• CALENDAR & EVENTS: Stay organized with a centralized calendar, discover campus events, and set reminders so you never miss a moment 
• FINANCIAL AID & STUDENT ACCOUNT: Check your tuition balance, view financial aid details, and monitor any holds 
• FEATURED ACTIVITIES: Access important steps like orientation and enrollment 
• CAMPUS COMMUNITY: Connect with fellow students, ask questions, and stay updated through the campus feed 
• ACTIVITIES & ORGANIZATIONS: Explore ways to get involved and find groups that match your interests 
• STUDENT SERVICES: Learn about available support, including advising, financial aid, and counseling 
• PUSH NOTIFICATIONS: Receive important alerts and updates from your college 
• MAP: Navigate campus and find buildings, offices, and event locations with ease 
• CAMPUS EXPERIENCE: Track your involvement and share feedback in real time 
This is the official app of the Kentucky Community and Technical College System. Our colleges include Ashland, Big Sandy, Bluegrass, Elizabethtown, Gateway, Hazard, Henderson, Hopkinsville, Jefferson, Madisonville, Maysville, Owensboro, Somerset, Southeast, Southcentral, and West Kentucky.

Community Interaction: Like, comment, and connect with other users' emotional posts
Emotion History: Track your emotional journey over time with a visual history
Video Content: Access mood-enhancing video content for emotional well-being

With "Universal Remote ∞ TV Control", you can transform your smartphone into a universal remote control for any TV! Our app offers a sleek, multi-button design that ensures an intuitive and seamless user experience, putting the power of advanced TV control at your fingertips.
Easily stream your favorite shows, switch channels, or adjust the volume—Controlla is your go-to solution for effortless TV management.
This app gives you complete control over your Smart TV, including all the features of your old physical remote control plus some intelligent functions. To use Controlla, connect your mobile device and Smart TV to the same Wi-Fi network and start using it.
Watch your favorite TV shows and movies using our unique streaming buttons for all the popular channels, including Netflix, Prime, and YouTube. Controlla makes it easier to watch what you love, browse online, and access your favorite content.
BUTTONS
Turn TV ON and OFF (supported models only)
Home button
Return button
Numbers keyboard (enter a channel number to jump right to it)
Color buttons (red, yellow, green, blue)
Change channels (next and previous)
Increase or decrease volume (also using phone side buttons)
Mute sound (silent mode)
Change source (HDMI, PC, AV...)
Access 4 favorite buttons
Up / Down / Left / Right navigation + center button “OK”
Play / Pause / Reverse / Fast Forward
Dedicated Netflix, Amazon Prime, and YouTube buttons
Settings button
Menu button
Touchpad
FEATURES
No infrared equipment required—just a Wi-Fi connection
Auto-connect to your TV every time you open the app
Realistic and user-friendly app design
Light vibration feedback when pressing buttons
Connect to multiple TVs with one phone and switch between devices easily

bluejetty:00148771:ios.description:
Welcome to KE Live, the official self-service mobile app from K-Electric. Designed to bring effortless convenience to millions of customers across Karachi and surrounding regions, KE Live puts complete control of your electricity services right in the palm of your hand.
Say goodbye to long queues and hassle. Whether you want to view and pay your utility bill, submit your own meter reading, track real-time power updates, or lodge complaints, KE Live makes managing your power connection quick, seamless, and transparent.
Key Features You'll Love.
Live Power & Load-Shed Tracking
Stay informed about your area's power status in real time. View accurate load-shedding schedules, planned maintenance outage alerts, and live updates whenever you need them.
Instant Billing & Multi-Account Management
• View & Download Bills: Access your latest electricity bill, duplicate bills, and payment history instantly.
• Link Multiple Accounts: Easily manage and monitor multiple KE account connections (home, office, or rental properties) under a single login profile.
• Online Payment Options: Pay your monthly bills securely using your credit/debit card directly within the app.
Self-Reading
Take charge of your billing cycle! With our interactive Self-Reading feature, you can upload a photo of your meters and manually submit your reading to ensure accurate and transparent billing.
Complaint Registration & Real-Time Tracking
Report issues effortlessly without calling customer support.
• Lodge technical/electricity outages or billing complaints with a few taps.
• Track your technical complaint resolution history in real time.
• Report safety hazards or illegal power theft quickly and anonymously to keep your neighborhood safe.
New Connection & Account Management
Apply for new electricity connections, update personal account details, and request tax certificates directly through the app.
Why Choose KE Live?
• Instant Updates: Receive automated push notifications for upcoming bill due dates and outages.
• Secure & Verified: Protected by secure OTP mobile authentication and encrypted transaction.
• 24/7 Digital Convenience: Access all core utility services anytime, anywhere.
KE Loyalty & Offers
Enjoy exclusive discounts, cashback, and special perks from top partner brands just for using the KE Live app.
Auto-Pay & Saved Cards
Securely save your card for 1-click checkout or set up automatic monthly bill payments to never miss a due date.
Getting Started is Easy!
1. Download the KE Live App.
2. Register using your mobile number, CNIC, and basic details.
3. Add your 13-digit KE Account Number found on your electricity bill.
4. Enjoy total digital control over your power connection!
Have feedback or need assistance? Connect with us through our multiple 24/7 support channels:
• In-App Feedback: Share your thoughts directly in the app.
• WhatsApp Service: Save 03480000118 and send "HI".
• Email Support: customer.care@ke.com.pk
Download KE Live today and experience smart, hassle-free power management!

bluejetty:00161158:ios.description:
Your AI outfit maker.
Your closet — now you can talk to it.
Pronti is an AI outfit maker and closet organizer that helps you get dressed faster using the clothes you already own. With PAI, your closet-aware AI stylist, you can chat about outfits, plan what to wear, and get real fashion advice — grounded in your actual wardrobe.
It’s like having a stylist in your pocket… or Cher’s iconic closet, upgraded with AI.
An AI stylist that uses your actual wardrobe
PAI isn’t a generic fashion chatbot. It understands your closet items, saved outfits, and style history, so when you ask what to wear, the advice actually makes sense.
You can ask PAI things like:
What can I wear today with my black blazer?
Style my white sneakers for dinner.
Help me pack outfits for a weekend trip.
This is AI you can talk to about outfits — powered by your own wardrobe.
Generate outfits from your real closet
Upload your clothes using photos or online images. Pronti learns your style and creates outfit ideas you’ll actually wear — no more staring at your closet wondering what goes together.
Mornings are easier with an AI outfit maker built around your wardrobe.
Closet uploads are easy
Take a photo
Use your phone’s Gallery
Add items from store images or Google
Take a selfie
Forward emails with your shopping purchases
Built-in outfit planner & style diary
Plan outfits ahead and track what you wore, how it looked, and what worked. Over time, Pronti becomes a smarter outfit planner and style journal that helps you understand your personal style.
Get inspired by the community
See how others style their outfits and discover new ways to wear the clothes you already own.
Make fashion more sustainable
Rediscover forgotten clothes. Create more outfits without buying more. Pronti helps reduce outfit anxiety and encourages smarter, more intentional dressing.
Shop smarter, dress better
When you do shop, Pronti recommends pieces that actually fit your wardrobe and style — helping you buy less, but better.
Why users love Pronti
AI stylist that uses your real closet
Chat-based outfit advice you can trust
Easy outfit planning and wardrobe organization
Outfit diary to track what works
Smarter shopping with personalized recommendations
Pronti is free to use and supported by shoppable links, ads, and optional Premium features. When you shop through the app, we may earn a commission — at no cost to you. Your data stays private and secure.
Pronti: Less stress, more style.
Get dressed faster. Wear what you love.
Talk to your closet like never before.

- Pro version is ad-free and includes Apple Watch support!

bluejetty:00126930:ios.summary:
Intuitive, personalised and innovative: the MeteoSwiss app is your comprehensive companion for all weather information in Switzerland – compact and always up to date.
Get updates on weather forecasts, current measurements, and federal natu
bluejetty:00126930:ios.description:
Intuitive, personalised and innovative: the MeteoSwiss app is your comprehensive companion for all weather information in Switzerland – compact and always up to date.
Get updates on weather forecasts, current measurements, and federal natural hazard warnings. Subscribe to natural hazard warnings as push notifications for your locations, and customize the warning types and thresholds according to your preferences.
Stay informed with informative blog posts on weather and climate topics.
Detailed features:
Weather Forecasts
• Weather on-site with a 5-hour forecast for your location
• Local forecasts for all places/ZIP codes in Switzerland with an overview for the next 8 days
• Wind/temperatures at different altitudes
• Weather report for the three language regions of Switzerland, as well as possible developments for the following week, and European isobar map
Weather Animations
• Measurements and forecasts of precipitation, precipitation type, wind, temperature and clouds
• Hail reporting function
• Satellite images
Natural Hazard Warnings
• All warnings on natural hazards from the Federal Authorities (severe weather, floods, avalanches, earthquakes and forest fire)
• Warning area overview on an interactive map
• Federal natural hazard bulletin
• Subscribeable warnings as push notifications for locations and warning types with individual warning thresholds
Current Measurements
• Overview of weather stations on an interactive map and list view
• Selection of various measurement data with up to 10-minute updates
Your Locations
• Search for all places/ZIP codes in Switzerland
• An easy overview of your locations: The app keeps an organised list of your relevant locations.
Meteo Reports
• Display of submitted reports and images for specific weather events from users of the MeteoSwiss app
Sports & Health
• Pollen forecast
• UV index
• Air quality
• Snow depth and fresh snow forecast
MeteoSwiss Blog
• Daily updated posts and information on weather and climate
Aviation Weather (available through in-app purchase)
• METAR/TAF Switzerland
• Aviation weather warnings Switzerland
• Windanimations Switzerland on different FL
• GAFOR Switzerland
• Text forecasts for powered flight, gliding and ballooning
• Low Level SWC Alps and Europe
• Pressure difference
• QNH – Chart
• W / T – Chart
• Wind – Barbs
• Regtherm
• Trajectories
• Emagramms
Legal basis
https://www.meteoswiss.admin.ch/about-us/legal-basis.html
Privacy Statement
https://www.meteosuisse.admin.ch/portrait/informations-juridiques/declaration-de-protection-des-donnees-de-l-app-meteoswiss.html
Terms of use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00024968:ios.description:
Welcome to our latest wild animal deer hunting game. Do you want to become an expert in deer hunting games? Do you want to experience a sniper riffle while shooting deer in wild jungle games? Then come and download our latest wild animal deer hunting game and play with our latest feature sniper guns and another upgraded sniper rifle in this deer shooting game. You have to target a wild deer in the animal jungle and aim to deer and shoot him. You must find the wild animals, aim at wild deer in the wild jungle, and shoot them in time in wild animal hunting game. Before wild animals find you and hunt you, If you get haunted by wild animals, the mission will be over, and you will have to start with a new task.
In the sniper deer hunter game, there are different modes of hunting with different safari hunting shooting levels. Our latest wild animal deer hunting game includes many wild animals, such as lions, elephants, tigers, dinosaurs, and other wild animals. Wild animals may enter the city and start attacking to people of the town. You must save the city by hunting the jungle animals in this sniper animal shooting game. In this offline hunting game, you also experience with 4*4 jeep with a sniper gun and take a round of the city where you see a jungle animal. You aim and kill it to save the people of the town.
Features of Wild Animal Deer Hunting Game:
Easy controls in this sniper hunting game
Different locations in the deer hunting game
Realistic HD graphics in an animal shooter game
Special edition and upgraded guns for every task in the wild deer shooting game

bluejetty:00080101:ios.name: Dawn of Ages: Medieval Warfare
bluejetty:00080101:ios.summary:
No Dragons, No Magic, Just Pure Strategy! 
Join the other 2.5+ million players in our fast growing, worldwide community of kingdom building strategists! Be brave, calculated, and cold-blooded to thrive in this epic multiplayer auto-chess /
bluejetty:00080101:ios.description:
No Dragons, No Magic, Just Pure Strategy! 
Join the other 2.5+ million players in our fast growing, worldwide community of kingdom building strategists! Be brave, calculated, and cold-blooded to thrive in this epic multiplayer auto-chess / city-building medieval war game.
Step into the medieval era, progress your empire through the ages and engage in fierce battles. Lead mighty warriors, dressed in the finest armor, wielding lethal weapons, as you embark on a journey of exploration, and conquest.. Dominate in one of the most genuine and historically accurate war games ever made for mobile. Leave your mark on the annals of history, your troops await your command!
Every weapon, piece of armor, and tactic is based on real history. The game echoes tactical, cultural, and technological discoveries across many regions, from feral axe-wielding savages, to disciplined men-at-arms, & organized pike blocks, all inspired by the elite, regional warriors from around the world including: English Longbowmen & Billmen, French Knights & Men-at-Arms, Teutonic Knights, Byzantine Cataphracts, Swiss Pikemen, Viking & Norse Warriors, Mongol Hordes, Japanese Samurai, and many other inspirations.
The game features extensive historical military equipment such as: Kite shields, Heavy Dane axes, Longbows, Chainmail, Zweihänder greatswords, Javelins, Plate armor, Spears, Pikes & Halberds, Tower Shields, Lamellar armor, Maces, Cannons, Crossbows and many more!
Key Features: 
● Battle Simulation - Experience large-scale auto-chess battles where placement, equipment choice & agro / targeting decisions impact your overall success. Command your villagers and equip them with powerful weapons and armor to claim victory.
● Choose Your Starting Faction - Viking, Teutonic, Frankish, or Anglo-Saxon. These base nations come with a strong Commander who will shape the fate of your land through unique abilities, nation perks, and research trees reflecting their strengths.
● Civilization Progression - Expand your kingdom through the ages. Develop your key buildings, increase resource production, educate your population, and prepare for battle by training powerful fighters. Unlock advanced technologies, forge new tools, and discover new materials to advance your technological strength.
● Forge Clan Alliances - Fortify your shared city together, and conquer enemy lands in a rich late-game experience where the stakes are high. Real losses and enormous rewards await the brave participants.
● Engaging Gameplay with Easy Controls – Whether you're a seasoned strategist or a newcomer to war strategy games, take command with our simple drag and drop troop management and single tap agro mechanics on the battlefield.
Fans of traditional total war / civilization games will fall in love with our mix of city building, resource management, tactical warfare, and large-scale conquest available in this game. 
Join the Community and Shape the Future of Dawn of Ages.
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/VurN66EZYC 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DawnOfAgesGame 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/DawnOfAgesGame 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/DawnOfAgesGame
Download Dawn of Ages now and build your kingdom today! See you on the battlefield!
Terms of Use: https://boombit.com/tos/
IGRS rating: 13+

bluejetty:00144884:ios.name: Sunflower - Quit Any Addiction
bluejetty:00144884:ios.summary:
Sunflower is the ultimate Sober Quit Tracker!
It comes with a days clean tracker where for every day you stay sober, you earn a sunflower through what’s called Visual Progression Tracking. This helps your brain associate sobriety with rewa
bluejetty:00144884:ios.description:
Sunflower is the ultimate Sober Quit Tracker!
It comes with a days clean tracker where for every day you stay sober, you earn a sunflower through what’s called Visual Progression Tracking. This helps your brain associate sobriety with reward.
Sunflower supports all substance types. Use it to stop drinking alcohol, to quit smoking nicotine or weed, or any other kind of addiction.
Sunflower Features
• Sober Days Clean Tracker
Count how many days you’ve quit & stayed sober from alcohol, nicotine, weed, or any other substance. Every day you stay sober, you’ll earn a sunflower.
• AI Sponsor
Get an AI Sponsor to talk to 24/7 to help you stay sober. Walk through cravings, vent about life, get advice about sobriety, and celebrate milestones with Sam!
• Milestone Tracker
Track your sober milestones with Sunflower! Whether it’s one second, one minute, one day, one month, one year, or ten years - celebrate your milestones to stay motivated and keep going.
• Reset Quit Date
Relapse happens & it’s important to remember to be kind to yourself. You can easily reset your quit date when needed with Sunflower to start tracking days clean.
• Exercises
Sunflower comes with exercises to overcome cravings and help your mind associate sobriety with reward. Learn about the common fallacies of an addicted mind and how to overcome them to stay sober.
• Community
Celebrate your wins and share your challenges with other users of Sunflower.
This app is built around the core concept that it's not enough to simply "stop", but that you must learn new ways to seek reward, pleasure, and dopamine.
It's a little silly, but earning a Sunflower for every day you stay sober, is a strong way to reinforce the rewards of sobriety.
It's not a "digital make believe Sunflower".
It's a day sober. It's a dinner with your family. It's a paper you wrote for school. It's a new skill you improved. It's your body regaining its health. It's a step towards not just recovery, but to a better and improved life.
One Sunflower at a time.
The app comes with built in guided journaling exercises for activities and cravings. If you follow them, they are designed to help you associate activities like exercise, being social, and learning, with reward.
Learn to associate something like exercise with reward or pleasure, and watch as your cravings change from destructive to empowering.
Looking to stop drinking or smoking? I hope you find Sunflower the absolute best way to keep track of your sobriety.
Disclaimer: This app is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified healthcare provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition or health objectives.
This app is designed for informational and supportive purposes only and is not a substitute for professional mental health care. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider regarding any questions about your mental health.
Privacy Policy: https://sunflowersober.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://sunflowersober.com/terms-of-service
