bluejetty:00044274:ios.description:
Feeling tense? Let your phone melt the stress away. VibRelax turns your device into a powerful vibration massage tool with 18 distinct vibration modes — plus your own custom patterns — designed for real relaxation anytime, anywhere.
Whether you need relief after a long workday, help winding down before sleep, or a quick tension break between meetings, VibRelax delivers smooth, targeted vibrations that feel genuinely soothing. No gimmicks, no fluff — just a simple tool that works.
WHAT YOU GET
- Custom Patterns — Don't settle for presets. Build your own vibration pattern from scratch. Adjust intensity, rhythm, and duration to design something that fits your body exactly — and save it for next time.
- 18 Vibration Modes — From gentle pulses to deep, rhythmic patterns. Slow waves for sleep. Intense bursts for tension relief. Find the one that fits the moment.
- Screen Lock — Start your session and lock the screen. No accidental taps, no interruptions. Just place your phone where it's needed and relax.
- Instant Start — No complicated setup. Open the app, pick a mode, and go. Relief in under 5 seconds.
DESIGNED FOR REAL USE CASES
Neck & Shoulder Tension — Place your phone against tight muscles after sitting at a desk all day.
Pre-Sleep Relaxation — Low-frequency gentle vibrations to calm your mind and body before bed.
Stress Relief Breaks — A 5-minute session during your lunch break can reset your entire afternoon.
Post-Workout Recovery — Use targeted vibration on sore spots to ease muscle fatigue.
Headache & Eye Strain — Gentle temple vibrations after hours of screen time.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Open VibRelax
2. Browse 18 vibration modes or build a custom pattern
3. Tap to start — adjust intensity on the fly
4. Lock your screen and place the phone on the target area
5. Breathe, relax, recover
A SMARTER APPROACH TO DAILY WELLNESS
VibRelax isn't trying to replace professional massage therapy. It's a practical, portable wellness tool you already carry in your pocket. Use it daily as part of your stress management and relaxation routine.
FREE TO TRY
Download VibRelax and explore vibration modes for free. Unlock the full library of 18 modes, custom patterns, and advanced controls with a subscription plan that fits your routine.
Need a hand? Our live support team is here to help, right inside the app.
Your next moment of calm is one tap away.

bluejetty:00133592:ios.description:
Desh Bangla Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Bangla typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Bangla words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the language key
• Word predictions and spell-correct is available in English also
• Emoji button is available after pressing 123
Open the app and follow instructions to get your new Bangla keyboard:
• Enable keyboard from settings
• Activate the keyboard by holding the Globe icon and selecting "Desh Bangla Keyboard"
• Type Bangla everywhere!
Allowing full access:
• When enabling the keyboard, you may enable "Allow Full Access"
• This allows us to access crash reports and will help us improve the stability of the app
• We respect your privacy. No personal information is collected
• A standard warning is shown when you enable any downloaded keyboard app
How to access settings:
• Tap on the ⋯ button after opening the app and tap Settings. This option will be available after keyboard is activated
• Available settings: sound on key press, vibrate on key press, emoji row, number row
Using the clipboard:
• The clipboard lets you save text that you frequently use and paste them easily
• After you copy any text, it can be viewed from the clipboard by tapping on "Paste copied text". You can use the Pin button to save it permanently
• To show copied text automatically when clipboard is opened, you can change the "Paste from Other Apps" setting to "Allow"
Using stickers to make your chats more fun:
• Open the stickers page by clicking on the sticker icon on the keyboard. Click on any sticker you like to copy it
• Navigate back to your chat app and use your phone's Paste option in the message box
• The sticker will be pasted in the chat. Note that animations are currently sent as GIFs due to technical limitations
Do share your feedback and help us improve Desh Bangla Keyboard. And don't forget to leave a review if you like it.

bluejetty:00161247:ios.description:
Narrly is a powerful and intuitive text-to-speech reader that makes listening documents enjoyable, productive and hands-free!
Top Features:
- Reads PDF, EPUB, Word, RTF, Text and images
- Listen to any web page
- Natural sounding voices that are already on your device
- Export as audio files
- Listen offline and on-the-go
- Seamlessly import files from anywhere
- Supports TTS for 50+ languages
- Add bookmarks anywhere in the document
Privacy:
- No personal data is collected
- Files are stored directly on your phone and iCloud
- Speech is synthesized on your device
- Your documents are not uploaded anywhere
Other Features:
- Native app with intuitive controls
- Select from 100+ enhanced and premium voices for free!
- Customize your reading experience with speed controls
- Landscape mode for iPhone and iPad
- Fullscreen mode
- Set reading area to remove footnotes, headers, etc.
- Organize your files with folders
- Keeps track of your reading progresses
- Create or Copy / Paste your own text to listen
Narrly is your ultimate text-to-speech solution, designed to bring your documents and webpages to life with natural, AI-driven voices. Whether you're at home, commuting, or exploring remote areas with no internet access, Narrly ensures you can enjoy seamless reading and listening experiences. Our innovative app allows you to convert any text or PDF file into audio, letting you listen to your content aloud in a way that suits your lifestyle.
With Narrly, privacy and offline functionality are paramount. The app works entirely on your device, meaning you can enjoy its full range of features without needing an internet connection. This focus on on-device processing ensures that your personal data and documents remain secure and private, as nothing is uploaded or shared online. Your files are stored safely on your phone or iCloud, giving you peace of mind and total control over your content.
Experience the ease of saving webpages as PDF or text files directly within the app. This feature allows you to create an audio library of your favorite articles and documents, ready to be narrated whenever you desire. Narrly supports an impressive array of over 50 languages, providing you with the flexibility to listen to content in your preferred language, all with natural, lifelike voices that make listening a pleasure.
Narrly is not just about functionality; it's about enhancing your reading experience. With intuitive controls, customizable speed settings, and the ability to choose from over 100 enhanced and premium voices for free, Narrly makes it easy to tailor the app to your specific needs. Keep track of your reading progress, import files from any source, and even create or copy/paste your own text to listen to. Narrly's advanced TTS capabilities ensure that every word is heard clearly and naturally, making it the perfect companion for avid readers and multitaskers alike.
Embrace the future of reading with Narrly, where advanced AI meets user-friendly design to deliver an unparalleled text-to-speech experience. Download Narrly today and transform the way you consume written content.

bluejetty:00038792:ios.description:
Free account with a zero-fee card, investing, interest-free instalment payments and everyday banking in one app*. Chosen by over 6.5 million people: open your account in minutes from your phone, no branch visit needed.
Satispay is the free account to manage your money every day: a zero-fee Mastercard debit card, payments in shops and online, purchases split into 3 interest-free instalments, and investing from just €1. All in one app.
A free, 100% digital account
- Online account with IBAN and free SEPA transfers
- Receive your salary or pension with no strings attached and set up direct debits for your bills
- Open your account in the app in minutes, without visiting a branch
The Satispay Mastercard debit card
- Mastercard debit card with no monthly fees
- Virtual card ready to use instantly, physical card delivered in a few days
- Pay wherever you go and earn Cashback Points on your purchases
- Add your card to Google Pay and Apple Pay and pay with your smartphone or smartwatch
- Perfect for travel: exclusive cards with no extra fees on foreign currency payments, free withdrawals worldwide*** and access to over 1,400 airport lounges
- Freeze and unfreeze your card from the app at any time
Pay in shops, online and with friends
- Pay with your smartphone in shops near you and online, and earn Cashback Points
- Send and receive money with all your contacts, free and instantly
- Earn Cashback Points on transactions and spend them in over 450,000 shops
Pay in 3, interest-free
- Split your purchases into 3 monthly instalments, with no interest and no extra costs
- Available in physical shops on the Satispay network and online wherever the service is active
Investing made simple
- Invest in funds, stocks and ETFs: over 1,000 instruments directly in the app
- Start investing with as little as €1, thanks to fractional stocks and ETFs
- Set up recurring investment plans in one tap: daily, weekly or monthly
- €0 purchase fees on all Vanguard ETFs with a recurring plan
Save with the Earning Piggy Bank
- Earn a return on your savings
- Create a piggy bank for every goal: holidays, taxes, emergencies
- Set up automatic deposits and withdraw whenever you want, no strings attached
Meal vouchers and employee benefits
- Use your meal vouchers directly in the app, no cards or booklets needed
- Spend your company's benefits credit wherever you already pay with Satispay
Simplify every payment
- Pay your car and motorbike tax wherever you are**
- Pay MAV slips and public administration notices (pagoPA) in a few taps**
- Buy vouchers and gift cards from your favourite brands**
- Instantly top up your own or a friend's phone credit**
For your kids too
From 14 to 17, your child can have their own Satispay: digital pocket money, spending under control and more independence.
Safe and secure
- Satispay is an electronic money institution authorised and supervised by the CSSF
- App protected by a 5-digit PIN, face recognition or fingerprint
- No sensitive or personal data is shared with third parties
- Get a notification for every transaction and block your card from the app in one tap
What you need to get started
- An ID document
- Your Italian tax code (codice fiscale)
Download Satispay: account, card, payments, savings and investing in one app.

bluejetty:00171416:ios.description:
Devotional Readings — your daily time with God
A calm, beautiful home for your daily walk with God. Devotional Readings brings your morning and evening devotionals, a guided Bible reading plan, the weekly study lesson, and the full Bible together in one app — to read or to listen, wherever you are.
EVERY DAY
- Morning and evening devotionals, refreshed automatically each day
- A daily Bible reading plan to move through Scripture at your own pace
- Listen to any reading with built-in audio narration — perfect for your commute, chores, or winding down at night
STUDY DEEPER
- The weekly Sabbath School lesson, with Ellen White notes
- The full Bible built in — tap any verse in a reading to open it instantly
- Podcasts, episodes, and short meditations to go further
FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
- Weekly children's stories to read and share with your kids
MAKE IT YOURS
- Highlight verses and keep notes, synced across your devices
- Works offline — your readings are always with you
- Ask the in-app Bible study assistant when a question comes up
Rooted in the Seventh-day Adventist tradition and loved by Adventist families around the world, Devotional Readings is for every Christian who wants a steady daily rhythm with God — morning and evening, in the Word and in prayer.
Free to use. An optional subscription unlocks premium features such as verse highlighting, weekly children's stories, and the Bible study assistant (free to try).

bluejetty:00177755:ios.summary:
Have you ever wanted to take a photo in low light conditions?

The image
bluejetty:00177755:ios.description:
Have you ever wanted to take a photo in low light conditions?
Due to complex mathematical algorithms Night Eyes provides residual light amplification in real-time for your iPhone, iPad and iPod touch without additional hardware.
The image is illuminated in real-time (without delay). You can also switch the light amplification mode to exposure mode for better quality. With an exposure time of up to one second you will be able to view the smallest details. It's ideal for twilight situations.
The luminance histogram shows you the brightness level in real-time.
Zoom in inconspicuously using the 10x digital Live Zoom - and shoot your photos.
You've naturally got many different color filters to choose from.
The most important functions are:
- Three amplification modes
- Up to 1 second * exposure time
- Residual light amplification
- True low light enhancement
- Real-time luminance histogram
- Volume Up (+) Photo Capture
- 10x digital live zoom
- Tap to focus
- Color filters: green, red, blue, b/w, sepia, etc.
- Take HD photos
- Landscape and portrait modes
- Supports the front & back cameras
- Supports LED lights
- Supports EXIF-data
*) only on supported devices
A good camera and a powerful processor are required, to get the maximum picture quality.
All the screenshots listed were taken with an iPhone and iPad and are genuine!
Please note that this app does not provide true night vision functionality. The iPhone, iPad and iPod touch have no infrared amplifier, as a result no pictures can be taken in total darkness; a minimal level of light is still required, which can be ascertained by the camera's sensors. The preview will also be delayed in exposure mode. In addition the camera must be held stable for exposure time.

bluejetty:00093620:ios.description:
FNB Aspermont TX is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FNB Aspermont TX:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FNB Aspermont TX app, you must be enrolled as a FNB Aspermont TX digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00147052:ios.description:
Onchain Wallet is now Ult
The Onchain Wallet experience is expanding. Your Onchain Wallet is still its own wallet, still connecting to the networks you already use, and will continue to be at your fingertips when you need it.
And now we're expanding the experience by introducing Ult. Where you trade stocks, crypto, sports, predictions and commodities, 24/7, seamlessly inside of Ult.
Two different experiences that you toggle between based on what you're doing, all in one app experience.
START IN SECONDS
Sign in with Google, Apple, or passkey.
Fund your balance with Apple Pay, with crypto, or from an existing exchange balance.
One cash balance to trade crypto, tokenized stocks, predictions, and more. 
TRADE CRYPTO, TOKENIZED STOCKS AND MORE*
Major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH), Solana (SOL), XRP, Zcash (ZEC) and Hyperliquid (HYPE), Lighter (LIT), plus CRO and the wider Cronos ecosystem. 
Tokenized US stocks including Apple, NVIDIA, Tesla, Microsoft and Amazon.
Tokenized index and commodity markets including the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, gold, silver and crude oil.
Move between asset classes without switching apps, accounts or wallets.
Follow live prices and market moves on every asset you hold.
GO LONG OR SHORT
Perpetual futures up to 40x on crypto, stocks and commodities.
Set your take profit and stop loss before you enter.
See your liquidation price before you confirm.
TRADE THE GAME WHILE IT'S HAPPENING
Sports predictions priced as markets you can enter and exit mid-game.
Your position moves with the score.
A FEED BUILT AROUND YOU
News, price moves and what other traders are doing, on one card.
Filter to what you care about and the feed tunes itself to how you trade.
YOUR ONCHAIN WALLET IS STILL HERE
Nothing has moved. Your keys, your funds and your transaction history are exactly where you left them.
Switch between your wallet and Ult in one tap.
Ult is built on a non-custodial foundation, so your assets stay under your control.
Developed by Cronos Labs and built on Cronos network: fast transactions, low fees, transparent onchain ownership.
Ult brings crypto, tokenized stocks and global markets into one trading app.
Ult Terms and Conditions: https://ult.trade/terms-and-conditions/
Spot trading is powered by third party decentralized exchange aggregator services. Ult does not exchange digital assets. Tokenized stock trading is available only in select jurisdictions.
Perpetual futures are available to eligible users in select jurisdictions. Trading with leverage can substantially increase the risk of loss and may not be suitable for everyone. Nothing in this listing is investment advice or a recommendation to trade a particular asset or to employ a particular strategy. Returns are not guaranteed.
Cronos and Crypto.com are separate and independent legal entities. No Crypto.com account is required to use Ult.
Product availability, including trading features, supported assets and payment methods, varies by country.

Zervo isn't just an app; it's a community where friendships bloom, romances spark, and some even find their lifetime partners. 
It's a canvas for stories that you'll remember forever.
- Global Topic: Embrace the World
In today's interconnected world, globalization is more important than ever. With Global Topic, you don't need to be multilingual to join discussions in various languages. Picture breaking cultural barriers and fostering global understanding, all in one place.
- Roleplay: Unleash Your Creativity
Zervo is a Roleplayer's Paradise, is your sanctuary. 
Our extensive OC (Original Character) system is a playground for role-play enthusiasts. Let your imagination soar in a space where creativity meets community.
- Groups & Worlds: Create Your Space
Zervo lets you craft themed groups and multi-channel worlds. It's your space to shape as you see fit, a platform to share your interests and passions.
- Meet: Connect Across Borders
With Zervo, make friends in every country. Our platform helps you find and connect with people who share your interests, regardless of where they are.
- OC & Expressive Communication
Our platform is equipped with a vast OC system and a myriad of meme materials. Add a personal touch to your chats and enjoy innovative ways of expressing yourself.
Join the Next-Generation Social Sphere
Step into Zervo, immerse yourself in an environment rich with anime, gaming, music, and more, shared by young, energetic people from every corner of the globe.
Be a part of our ever-growing community and help shape the future of social engagement. Join us on this exciting journey!

bluejetty:00015915:ios.description:

IMAGE OF THE DAY: We surprise you with a beautiful homepage image every day.
GET THE BACKSTORY: Browse to the hosts of the images you find. Explore news and Wikipedia articles, Flickr, Pixabay, Unsplash, Pexels and PxHere photographers as well as Pinterest photo or gallery pages.

bluejetty:00022084:ios.summary:

Experience the
bluejetty:00022084:ios.description:
FighterPilot: HeavyFire is an arcade fast paced action-adventure game, where you step into the boots of a fighter pilot, and fly some of the most iconic modem-era jet combat airplanes loaded with some real heavy fire power. 
Experience the thrill of commanding some of the most lethal machines ever built, as you swat baddies with a click of your button while you lord over the skies of the battlefield. The game is completely free-to-play, runs offline , and has great features like:- 
Iconic Aircraft
- Cold war era favourites like the Jaguar and the Su-25.
- Swing wing ‘go faaasst’ airplanes like the Mig-27 and the Tornado ! watch those wings fold back as you zoom away !
- And the iconic A-10, the best close air support aircraft in the world that is considered nothing less than a flying tank !
Progressive Hangar system
- Progress across the base tier of airplanes and unlock more advanced tier.
- Expand the performance of the airplane by fine-tuning engine, armour and gunnery parameters.
- Load the airplane with real-world inspired weaponry, from rockets, to missiles, to some large area damage bombs ! 
Immersive visuals
- Fly around a wide variety of environments across mountains, deserts and beaches.
- Unlock different skins for your favourite airplane - inspired by real-world liveries of these aircraft from their operators.
Progressive levels
- As you become more comfortable with handling your airplanes, the levels will become harder to test your newly acquired skills.
Enjoy an experience that lets you grow with the game in terms of your skills and abilities, opens up more and more airplanes and levels, and even lets you accelerate that pace through in-app-purchases, rewarded ads, or even by referring friends.
Take your time exploring the beautiful hand-crafted levels, while you keep improving your skills of handling the aircraft and becoming the baddest, fastest, most accomplished fighter pilot out there.

- Select from a list of suggested questions or write your own
- Send announcements and see which students have read them
- Follow up student replies directly or in groups.
- Share access to your class with other teachers
- Track changes over time with data visualisations
Student Features:
- Reply to questions in seconds
- Replies can only be seen by teachers
- Quick and easy to use interface
- Sign in to get a notification when you have a new question

Know Where Your Products Come From – Instantly!
Scan a product's barcode to uncover: 
• Parent Company Details – See who really owns the brand and where their headquarters are. 
• Manufacturing Insights – Find out if the product was actually Made in Canada or just branded as Canadian. 
• Canadian Alternatives – Get recommendations for locally made products that support Canadian businesses.

Make informed shopping choices and support local industries by downloading BuyCAN.

bluejetty:00087586:ios.name: G1 Driver's Test Ontario 2026
bluejetty:00087586:ios.summary: G1 Driver's Test Ontario is a complete study app for the Ontario G1 written knowledge test. It has 440 practice questions with explanations, 30 tests, a mock exam in the real G1 format, road sign flashcards, a study guide, illustrated visua
bluejetty:00087586:ios.description:
G1 Driver's Test Ontario is a complete study app for the Ontario G1 written knowledge test. It has 440 practice questions with explanations, 30 tests, a mock exam in the real G1 format, road sign flashcards, a study guide, illustrated visual guides and narrated audio lessons. All content is based on the Official MTO Driver's Handbook.
WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone preparing for the G1 knowledge test at a DriveTest centre in Ontario, Canada: new drivers, teens getting their first licence, newcomers to Canada and drivers exchanging a foreign licence.
ABOUT THE G1 TEST
The G1 test has 40 multiple-choice questions in two sections: rules of the road (20 questions) and road signs (20 questions). You need at least 16 correct in each section to pass. The mock exam in this app uses the same format and the same pass mark.
PRACTICE QUESTIONS AND TESTS
• 440 questions: 198 rules of the road, 124 fines and penalties, 118 road signs
• 20 topic tests: 8 Rules tests, 6 Fines tests, 6 Road Signs tests
• 10 full practice tests with 40 questions each
• Mock exam: 40 random questions, scored per section like the real test
• An explanation with every answer
• Review every question after a test and bookmark the ones to revisit
SMART REVIEW
• Weak Spots: practise only the questions you got wrong
• Spaced repetition flashcard review that brings cards back when you are about to forget them
• Readiness score that shows how close you are to passing, by section
• Quick Blitz: 5 questions in 2.5 minutes
• Marathon Mode for long study sessions
• Daily Challenge: 5 questions a day with streaks
LEARN THE HANDBOOK WITHOUT READING ALL OF IT
• Study Guide: 49 cards in 6 chapters, each one read aloud
• 45 illustrated visual guides covering right-of-way, parking, speed limits, demerit points, penalties and more
• Listen & Remember: 5 narrated audio lessons (about 36 minutes) with 33 memory pictures that help the numbers stick
• Audio player for studying on the bus or on a walk
• 161 flashcards for road signs and key facts
• Fines and demerit points reference
BUILT FOR TEST DAY
• Set your test date and see a countdown
• Test-day checklist: what to bring to the DriveTest centre
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: Sign of the Day, Fact of the Day, Fintdown
• Siri and Shortcuts: start the Daily Challenge, review weak spots or ask what a road sign means
STAY MOTIVATED
• Earn XP, level up from Learner to Road Legend and collect badges
• Study reminders and daily streaks
Works offline. No ads.
This app is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with the Governmry of Transportation or DriveTest. Source: Official MTO Driver's Handbook,ontario.ca/document/official-mto-drivers-handbook
Terms of Use: https://praveenyuva.host/Terms
Privacy Policy: https://praveenyuva.host/privacy

The G1 test has 40 multiple-choice questions in two sections: rules of the road (20 questions) and road signs (20 questions). You need at least 16 correct in each section to pass. The mock exam in this app uses the same format and the same pass mark.

PRACTICE QUESTIONS AND TESTS
• 440 questions: 198 rules of the road, 124 fines and penalties, 118 road signs
• 20 topic tests: 8 Rules tests, 6 Fines tests, 6 Road Signs tests
• 10 full practice tests with 40 questions each
• Mock exam: 40 random questions, scored per section like the real test
• An explanation with every answer
• Review every question after a test and bookmark the ones to revisit

SMART REVIEW
• Weak Spots: practise only the questions you got wrong
• Spaced repetition flashcard review that brings cards back when you are about to forget them
• Readiness score that shows how close you are to passing, by section
• Quick Blitz: 5 questions in 2.5 minutes
• Marathon Mode for long study sessions
• Daily Challenge: 5 questions a day with streaks

LEARN THE HANDBOOK WITHOUT READING ALL OF IT
• Study Guide: 49 cards in 6 chapters, each one read aloud
• 45 illustrated visual guides covering right-of-way, parking, speed limits, demerit points, penalties and more
• Listen & Remember: 5 narrated audio lessons (about 36 minutes) with 33 memory pictures that help the numbers stick
• Audio player for studying on the bus or on a walk
• 161 flashcards for road signs and key facts
• Fines and demerit points reference

BUILT FOR TEST DAY
• Set your test date and see a countdown
• Test-day checklist: what to bring to the DriveTest centre
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: Sign of the Day, Fact of the Day, Fintdown
• Siri and Shortcuts: start the Daily Challenge, review weak spots or ask what a road sign means

STAY MOTIVATED
• Earn XP, level up from Learner to Road Legend and collect badges
• Study reminders and daily streaks

Works offline. No ads.

bluejetty:00039242:ios.description:
With more than 100,000 downloads and a monthly audience of 55.000 users, BoosterAgro App offers on-demand access to climate data, crop health satellite imagery, agronomic, financial advisory and pest & disease alert management.
* Multiple Weather Forecasts: Compare the most popular weather forecasts side-by-side in one place. 
* Accurate Forecast: A combined forecast of the ones compared. This is the statistically most likely forecast. 
* Crop Health Imagery: Free access to high resolution NDVI imagery to see crop performance across a field at a single point in time. A divergent scale (red-yellow-green) provides a contrast of colors, which makes it easy to find and investigate areas that are showing poor growth. 
* Satellite Weather Station: Remote access to in-field current weather conditions (rain, temperature, wind gusts, humidity, dew point, atmospheric pressure), without needing to install any equipment, hardware or sensor.
* Long-term forecast (3 months) with climatic trends (El Niño / La Niña) in each area of the region.
* Rainfall Map: Allows you to visualize the cumulative rainfall of the last 7 days in the area of your farms. The data comes from the user's rainfall raingauge records.
* Pests Map: Allows you to visualize alerts of insects, weeds and diseases that are affecting crops in different areas.These alerts are provided by the same users. 
* In-field Records: Keep records of the last precipitations, hail, frost or other weather-related events happened in the field.
* Spray Smart: Sprayer recommender to view the most and least favorable spray weather conditions for each field according temperature, humidity, wind gust and rains.
* Collaborative Information: Farmers can exclusively share fields data with their team operations (agronomists, advisors, employees and contractors).
* Secret Key: It works offline, it's super friendly, simple and easy to use!

bluejetty:00152529:ios.description:
Help Vanessa Rossi uncover the secrets of the cursed movie and escape alive!
Play a hidden object detective adventure from the Chimeras series and reveal the truth behind the Chimera’s curse!
Will you manage to uncover the secrets of Chimeras 14: The Final Take? Step into the role of detective Vanessa Rossi and investigate the strange events surrounding a mysterious film where the cast vanished without a trace.
Dragged into the world of cinema itself, Vanessa must face supernatural dangers, solve thrilling puzzles, and find out who is truly behind the nightmarish attacks. Only the bravest detective will be able to survive this deadly movie!
Note: This is a free trial version of the hidden object game.
You can unlock the full version via an in-app purchase.
STOP THE CURSE OF THE CHIMERA
On premiere night, the movie screen reveals a terrifying Chimera demanding vengeance on the film crew. Moments later, everyone disappears into the silver screen. Vanessa follows the trail and soon finds herself inside the cursed movie, where shadows come to life and danger lurks behind every scene.
INVESTIGATE A MAFIA CONSPIRACY
Together with Damien, a loyal bodyguard, Vanessa must protect Katarina, the daughter of a mafia family, from mysterious attacks. Inside the grand palazzo, secrets and betrayals await. Gabriel, Katarina’s fiancé, is hiding something—and Vanessa’s search uncovers ghostly traces of a monster trying to cover its tracks.
UNCOVER THE SCREENWRITER’S PLAN
The deeper Vanessa digs, the clearer it becomes: Rafael, the film’s own screenwriter, orchestrated the curse and unleashed the Chimera. To escape alive, she must confront him in his lair and expose the truth behind his sinister plot.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play a bonus adventure and discover what becomes of Vanessa and the other survivors once the credits roll. New mysteries, hidden dangers, and unexpected twists await!
Chimeras 14: The Final Take is a hidden object adventure where you must solve puzzles and uncover the truth. Explore cinematic worlds brought to life, face supernatural dangers, and reveal the fate of those trapped inside the cursed movie!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use hints if you get stuck.

bluejetty:00028879:ios.description:
The original Tesla app notifies you only when the car alarm goes off. To receive notifications for all Tesla Sentry Mode events you need this app!
No more surprises when you return to your vehicle - stay connected and safe by receiving notifications on Sentry events. With Sentry Pro, you'll always be in the know, anytime and anywhere. You can also program the vehicle to automatically honk or flash the lights in order to deter threats.

- Real-time Notifications: Receive instant notifications when Sentry Mode activates.
- Automatic actions: Program your vehicle to automatically honk the horn or flash the lights when a threat is detected.
- Scheduled Sentry Mode: Automatically turn Sentry Mode on and off at set times every day to reduce battery drain during low-risk hours.
- Stay Safe: Stay one step ahead of potential incidents or threats.
- Peace of Mind: Ensure your Tesla's protection and your peace of mind.
- Privacy Protection: Rest easy knowing that safeguarding your privacy is our top priority.
* Sentry Pro support multiple vehicles with a single subscription!
We don't collect any personal data from you - no names, emails, passwords or phone numbers required. You authenticate directly with Tesla, and Sentry Pro never handles your password. Notifications arrive anonymously directly to your phone.
* Sentry Pro is developed by Sentry Brain S.M.P.C., an Approved Tesla Fleet API developer *
Try it for free!
Questions or need help? Reach out to us at support@sentrypro.app

bluejetty:00070054:ios.description:
Hyper Cleaner is the ultimate storage cleaner to optimize and organize your phone gallery. Clear up redundant stuff. Compress videos. Crystallize memories.
Imagine opening your phone to a delightful reminder of a memory from this day last year. A birthday celebration, a sunset at the beach, a candid moment with loved ones – each photo takes you back to that cherished time. But of course, you took too many shots you might want to sift through. 
You swipe left to delete unwanted photos and right to keep the ones you love. You review your choices at the end of each session, ensuring you only keep what truly matters. Spend just two minutes each day reliving memories, having fun, and decluttering. 
With Hyper Cleaner, you clean up your iPhone in a meaningful, comprehensive way. The Memories feature organizes your photo gallery by months and days, allowing you to stroll down memory lane daily. Turn photo management into an enjoyable ritual, where reminiscing bright moments becomes part of the process.
Hyper Cleaner also helps you:
- Delete duplicates and similar images. Easily sift through the clutter of repeated and unfortunate shots and keep only the best and the dearest ones. Our intelligent photo cleaner selects the best pictures from similar shots and identifies blurry or redundant images for easy deletion.
- Compress large videos. We are all shooting gigabytes of footage day in and day out, yet rarely (if ever) take time to watch it more than once. Clean gallery by effectively compressing large videos while still having all the precious moments close at hand. 
- Find and delete screenshots. Screenshots are often a one-time thing that, however, tend to sit on our phones for years cluttering up space and popping up out of the blue. Time to get rid of them. Let our phone cleaner find those once-useful screenshots and send them straight to the trash.
- Get rid of useless files. Too often our gallery is full of long unwanted videos, and there's never a perfect moment to search, review, and delete them on your own. With Hyper Cleaner, the perfect moment is now, as is any other moment! Let our phone cleaner do the chores for you and keep only the media you need and like.
- Complement your phone with versatile extras. Hyper Cleaner is a lot more than a duplicate photo cleaner. Features like an ad blocker, secret space for sensitive files, contact organization, battery widget, and easy family sharing keep your phone organized, clutter-free, and secure.
Want a simpler, smarter, more comprehensive care for your phone and your memories? Download Hyper Cleaner today.

- Weekly at $3.99 with a 3-day free trial; weekly at $4.99; weekly at $4.99 with a 3-day free trial; yearly at $29.99.

- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.

Arizona's Sports Station is an Arizona sports fans' home for the most in-depth coverage on their favorite teams. Arizona Sports is the flagship station for the Arizona Cardinals, Arizona Diamondbacks, Phoenix Suns, and Arizona State Sun Devils. Watch or listen to live talk shows, get podcasts, on-demand segments and interviews, and read the latest from ArizonaSports.com. 
Arizona Sports always keeps you informed with the latest news on the teams. The biggest decision makers and sports stars can be heard and seen here. 
ARIZONA SPORTS
Listen or watch for free, anytime of day with crystal clear audio quality. 
Catch live game broadcasts from the Arizona Cardinals, Arizona Diamondbacks, Phoenix Suns, and Arizona State Sun Devils.* 
On-DEMAND 
Missed a show? No problem. Watch highlights, listen to podcasts from all your favorite shows, and pick up where you left off. Share video Shorts, interviews, and podcast episodes with your friends. 
NEWS 
Get the latest updates on the Arizona Cardinals, Arizona Diamondbacks, Phoenix Suns, Arizona State Sun Devils, and more. Stay up to date with breaking news and get inside analysis from Arizona Sports experts on the game. 
ALERTS
Turn on notifications to get breaking news, game updates, and must-see moments as they happen.
INTERACT 
Be part of the conversation. Connect with the shows via text, voice message, social media, or email. Share your love for Arizona teams with others who share your same passion. 
Join our community!

Instagram: @arizsports 
Twitter: @AZSports 
YouTube: /ArizonaSports987 
Website: arizonasports.com

bluejetty:00121813:ios.name: Pet World - My Animal Shelter
bluejetty:00121813:ios.summary: Welcome to the 3D world of the Animal Rescue Sunflower! Whether they're cute hamsters or guinea pigs, sweet bunnies, playful cats or cuddly dogs: they all want to be cared for with love and adopted by the right owners. Take on lovable horse
bluejetty:00121813:ios.description:
Welcome to the 3D world of the Animal Rescue Sunflower! Whether they're cute hamsters or guinea pigs, sweet bunnies, playful cats or cuddly dogs: they all want to be cared for with love and adopted by the right owners. Take on lovable horses and a cute young foal, as well as lots of different farmyard animals such as cheeky goats, sheep and pigs at the Sunflower Animal Shelter! Care for fascinating reptiles like snakes and tortoises and look after other wild animals including fish, deer, hedgehogs, a sly fox, a nimble squirrel and colorful parrots! Your animals want to be loved and cared for! 
ANIMAL CARE
Many of your rescues didn't always have it easy in their lives, but luckily they at least found their way to you. After an initial examination to determine current health conditions and to establish any necessary treatment, life in the animal rescue can begin. Take care of your little friend with food and water and make sure that they always have fresh litter. When they have everything they need, pretty soon they'll feel fit as a fiddle again!
FIND A NEW HOME
Of course the animals are in the best possible hands with you, but they do eventually need a real home. As soon as the head of the animal rescue, a grumpy professor, puts you in charge of the animal adoption process, it's your job to find the most suitable new animal owner. When you pay attention to the animal's needs and the owner's preferences, nothing can stand in the way of their happiness.
FANTASTIC 3D GRAPHICS
PetWorld 3D: My Animal Rescue" is not only a lot of fun and addictive, it's also visually pleasing. Navigate through the shelter by swiping with your finger, decorate it with beautiful accessories, or play with dogs and cats in the large outdoor enclosure! When you visit the animals you can also of course see them at close range and can observe how the hamsters clean themselves or how the bunnies hop around. You'd rather keep your rescues forever!
OTHER TYPES OF ANIMALS
In "PetWorld 3D: My Animal Rescue" you have the opportunity to take care of lots of animals such as hamsters, guinea pigs and bunnies. In addition, you can purchase in-apps, which include dogs, cats, foals, sheep, goats, pigs, turtles, birds, squirrels and reptiles thereby opening new playing options. And of course new surprises are waiting for you, based on how well you care for the animals and how often animals are successfully adopted.
So: Go to the Animal Rescue Sunflower, your new friends are waiting for you!
SUPPORT
If you have questions or problems related to the app or in-app purchases, please contact apps@tivola.de per email.
The following tips may also be helpful:
If you don't know what to do, just tap on the professor and he will help you.
To ensure that the app runs optimally on older devices, please close all apps running in the background.

RIDER DASHBOARD:
- Use the Live Rider Dashboard while riding and keep track of all important riding data
- Shows you live motor power, rider power, battery level, speed and current cadence
- Record distance traveled, duration of ride, calories burned and average speed if needed

- Create your own personal riding experience and change the assist mode settings in line with your individual needs and preferences.

- All of your profiles are saved in the FAZUA App - where you can access them at any time to select just the right one for you next ride.
PROFILE STORE:
- Browse through different public profiles and get inspired!
- Access a selection of profiles developed by FAZUA for various riding experiences and usage scenarios.
- Use the Store to download new profiles that match your individual needs and ride like a pro!

bluejetty:00091029:ios.name: Al-Anon Family Groups
bluejetty:00091029:ios.summary: Al‑Anon Family Groups is a mutual support program for people whose lives have been affected by someone else’s drinking. By sharing common experiences and applying the Al-Anon principles, families and friends of alcoholics can bring positive
bluejetty:00091029:ios.description:
Al‑Anon Family Groups is a mutual support program for people whose lives have been affected by someone else’s drinking. By sharing common experiences and applying the Al-Anon principles, families and friends of alcoholics can bring positive changes to their individual situations, whether or not the alcoholic admits the existence of a drinking problem or seeks help.
The Al-Anon program is based on the Twelve Steps (adapted from Alcoholics Anonymous), which we try, little by little, one day at a time, to apply to our lives, along with our slogans and the Serenity Prayer. The loving interchange of help among members and daily reading of Al-Anon literature thus make us ready to receive the priceless gift of serenity.
The official mobile app of the Al-Anon Family Groups is designed to provide an easy way for anyone affected by someone else’s drinking to find hope and help, whether they can attend a face-to-face meeting or not.
Features include:
- Al-Anon meetings powered by Zoom with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) compliance enabled. In the app you will see this added security is identified by a green shield inside the meeting. The HIPAA compliance provides the following additional securities:
-- Disallows cloud recordings
-- Forces out of meeting chat encryption on
-- Forces encryption for 3rd party endpoints
-- Disables streaming to any service that only supports RTMP
-- Prevents copying or saving meeting chats
- An opportunity to connect with Al-Anon friends and chat privately with them
- A built-in private journal, which you can use to track your recovery
- A news feed where you can share with your Al-Anon friends what is on your mind; you can also view what’s on your friends’ minds. 
- An opportunity to subscribe to a daily dose of Al-Anon members’ experience, strength, and hope.
- An opportunity to easily contribute to the World Service Office.
Premium Content 
- Annual Subscription $19.99/yr -Auto-Renewing
-- Premium content is available through an annual subscription which is associated to your Apple ID and is automatically renewed unless canceled. Subscription may be canceled through your Apple ID Subscriptions. Early cancellations do not result in a refund, the member will continue to receive premium content until the end of the subscription period.  
Terms Of Use: www.al-anon.org/mobileapp/termsofuse

bluejetty:00065224:ios.description:
PocketGuard is an award-winning Budget App, Spending Tracker & Money Manager trusted by 1.7M+ users. Plan your budget, track expenses, manage bills, and know what’s safe to spend.
RECOGNIZED AMONG THE BEST BUDGET APPS OF 2026
• Forbes Advisor — Best for Managing Recurring Expenses
• Kiplinger — Best for Debt Management
• NerdWallet — Featured among The Best Budget Apps for 2026
• Experian & Investopedia — Featured among the Best Budgeting Apps of 2026
“PocketGuard is the best budgeting app for tracking spending. PocketGuard makes it easy for users to analyze their spending habits through custom reports and allows them to create a fully customized budget and a personalized debt payoff schedule.”— Forbes
Always Know What's in Your Pocket
• Track all your income and expenses
• Safe-to-spend amount after bills, goals, and essentials
• How much you can safely contribute, save, invest 
Budgeting Features
• Custom categories
• Budget limits
• Overspending prevention
• Rollover budgets
• Spending Prediction
Spending Pace — Predict Your Spending 
Spending Pace analyzes your spending habits to predict whether you’ll stay on budget before the month ends.
Choose your budgeting method
• Zero-based budgeting
• Envelope budgeting
• 50/30/20 budget rule
• Build your own custom budgeting system.
Smart Transaction Rules — Automatic Expense Categorization
• Detect merchant names, keywords, amounts, categories, and accounts
• Rename merchants, fix categories, and add hashtags for tracking
• Apply rules to every new transaction
Spending Insight & Monthly Budget Review
• Visual spending reports
• Categories, budgets, bills and merchant breakdowns
• Month-to-month budget 
• Spending trend analysis
Bills organizer and Subscription manager
Connect your bank and PocketGuard automatically identifies bills, subscriptions, and recurring payments.
• Never miss a due date
• Spot and cancel forgotten subscriptions
• Lower bills using a built-in bill negotiation service
Build Your Debt-Payoff Plan
PocketGuard builds a personalized debt payoff plan based on your balances and repayment strategy, helping you reduce interest costs, see your debt-free date, and track every payment along the way.
Bank-Level Security
Your data is protected with 256-bit SSL encryption, biometric login (Touch ID & Face ID), PIN codes, and industry-standard privacy practices.
FAQ
You need a budget to track every dollar?
PocketGuard connects to your bank accounts via secure data connectors (Plaid, Finicity, Salt Edge, Apple Wallet), automatically categorizes transactions, identifies bills and subscriptions, and calculates leftover which you can contribute to any budgeting category or spend guilt-free, setup a goal, save or invest.
Which budgeting methods are supported?
PocketGuard is a category budgeting but the app lets you budget your way. Use zero-based budgeting, envelope budgeting, the 50/30/20 rule, or create your own custom budget — without being locked into one budgeting method.
Who is PocketGuard best for?
Anyone who wants to plan a budget, track spending, stop overspending, pay off debt, manage subscriptions or build savings.
Is it safe to connect my bank?
Yes. PocketGuard uses 256-bit SSL encryption, biometric login, PIN protection, and MFA. Your credentials are never stored — read-only access only.
Which countries and banks are supported?
PocketGuard Budget App connects to financial institutions in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.
Can I use PocketGuard without connecting to a bank?
Yes. You can add transactions manually or manage cash accounts. 
PocketGuard Plus Subscription
Start a 7-day free trial and choose a plan: Monthly — $12.99 Annual — $74.99. Prices may vary by region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited once a subscription is purchased.
Privacy Policy: https://pocketguard.com/privacy/. Terms of Use: https://pocketguard.com/terms/.

- Filter jobs by keyword, like Security, Technology, or Finance.
- Search by the job tit
bluejetty:00061269:ios.description:
Gov Job Search allows you to search for government jobs and employment information provided by the United States Office of Personnel Management (OPM).
- Filter jobs by keyword, like Security, Technology, or Finance.
- Search by the job title you want, such as Doctor, Specialist, or Engineer.
- Add multiple search filters, for example Mission Critical, Military Status, or Hiring Path.
- See jobs by departments or organizations, like NASA, Treasury, or FAA.
- Browse a list of search results.
- Pull to refresh and load more search results.
- View jobs by location on a map.
- Tap on a job to get more details.
- Tap Apply Now to link directly to the job application
Apperdashery LLC is not affiliated with, connected to, or endorsed by OPM. Jobs are open to the public and data is not copyrighted. The data presented is for Public Job Opportunities.
** Special Notes **
Government jobs unavailable to the public are not included in the search results. This is not an official USAJobs app. Some jobs are available in multiple locations, cities, or states. For several reasons, including privacy and security, you still need to apply and submit your personal information through the USAJobs website usajobs.gov. If you want to apply for a job opening, this app will link you directly to the jobs details page of the official USAJobs website where you can Apply Online. This app utilizes Job Opportunity Announcement (JOA) information provided by the OPM and USAJobs Program as part of the Open Data Digital Strategy.

Get ready for Color Block Out — the ultimate color block jam experience where you grind, slide, and solve your way through jammed paths using colorful strategy!
This isn’t just any puzzle game — it’s a fresh, satisfying take on the classic block puzzle genre. Slide the blocks, clear the jam, and unlock the path! Whether you're a casual player or a puzzle master, Color Block Out offers the perfect balance of brain-teasing fun and smooth gameplay.
【How to Play – Simple, But Strategy is Key!】
Just slide the blocks to move them around the grid. Your mission: match each color block with its corresponding color gate. But it’s not that easy — some blocks are stuck, and you’ll need to grind through color gates or move other blocks out of the way first.
Every level offers new challenges with unique mechanics that will stretch your thinking. The more you play, the more your brain adapts. It’s the perfect blend of logic, strategy, and brain training — in a highly satisfying format!
【Game Features – Built for Puzzle Lovers】
- A one-of-a-kind color block jam system with both sliding and grinding gameplay
- Over 1,000 handcrafted block puzzle levels – each carefully designed to provide fun, challenge, and flow
- Classic sliding puzzle controls enhanced with innovative new puzzle twists
- Stunning visuals: vibrant color blocks, smooth animations, and polished effects
- A deeply satisfying ASMR-style feedback system – feel the grind and hear the snap of every solved puzzle
- Play at your own pace: from calm, relaxing levels to intense, brain-teasing challenges
- Built-in brain training to improve your logic, memory, and spatial awareness
- Strategically layered gameplay that rewards smart thinking and forward planning
- Unlock new puzzle elements, special blocks, and surprising interactions as you progress
- Easy to pick up, hard to master – perfect for fans of color puzzles, tile games, and casual logic titles
- Conquer tricky block puzzle levels to earn exciting rewards and unlock even more challenging stages. Each success takes you deeper into the world of color block jam, where solving every block-filled puzzle brings unmatched satisfaction and pushes you closer to puzzle mastery.
* Why Players Love Color Block Out:
If you enjoy mobile games like tile match, sliding puzzles, or classic wood block games, you’ll love the refreshing mechanics and flow of Color Block Out. The intuitive design, combined with deep strategic layers, makes it a go-to puzzle game for players of all skill levels.
Whether you're looking to relax or sharpen your mind, this game delivers. Each puzzle is more than just a visual treat — it's a genuine brain-teasing challenge that gets more rewarding the further you go.
* Ready to slide, grind, and conquer?
Explore over 1,000 levels packed with unique color block jam puzzles, clever layouts, and endless fun.
Slide the blocks, unlock stuck paths, and solve your way to victory.
It’s time to join the ultimate block puzzle adventure!
Join Color Block Out and enter the colorful, brain-teasing world of color block jam puzzles!

- Solve uniquely themed word puzzles
- Find as many words as you can in Speed Rounds
- Now featuring crossword puzzles and mystery word games
- Word games that will test your word building skills
- Claim entries & redeem for real rewards! 
- Challenge your word puzzle skills with Daily Challenge

bluejetty:00095717:ios.description:
A smart photo cleaner and privacy manager that also supports custom home screen shortcuts. Free up space, declutter your gallery, and take control of your personal content — all in one lightweight and secure app.
This app is designed to solve everyday issues like messy photo libraries, limited storage, and scattered personal files. Alongside smart cleaning features, it also offers simple tools to customize shortcut icons and organize private content, all with full on-device privacy.
Key Features
• Smart Photo Cleaner 
Quickly identify and group similar or duplicate photos, helping you reclaim storage space with one tap. 
Ideal for clearing out clutter before importing sensitive or private media.
• Private Album 
Store selected photos and videos in a local, app-only space — separate from the system album. 
You can freely create custom categories to better organize personal media and improve browsing clarity.
• Custom App Shortcuts with Personalized Icons 
Create shortcut links for apps like TikTok, Tinder, and Camera. 
Use the “Add to Home Screen” feature to assign unique names and icons. 
- Fully customizable icon and label 
- Adds shortcut access only; original apps remain unchanged 
- Supports preset templates or uploading your own images
• Optional Shortcut Access Control 
Set numeric passcodes to limit access to selected shortcuts. 
Helps prevent unintentional use when sharing your device.
Data Privacy 
All content stays securely stored on your device. Even custom icons are processed locally using Base64 encoding — no uploads, no cloud storage, and no third-party access.
---
Privio offers an auto-renewable subscription option:
* Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase. 
* Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
* Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of renewal. 
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. 
* Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00045174:ios.name: PackLight for Backpacking
bluejetty:00045174:ios.summary:
Keep your pack weight down and never forget crucial gear with PackLight, the packing list app for backpackers. Get PackLight today and be confident that you have exactly what you need - and only what you need - on your next adventure.
CORE
bluejetty:00045174:ios.description:
Keep your pack weight down and never forget crucial gear with PackLight, the packing list app for backpackers. Get PackLight today and be confident that you have exactly what you need - and only what you need - on your next adventure.
CORE FEATURES 
(100% free / no sign up / no ads)
- Organize Your Gear -- Inventory your gear by name, weight, and category.
- Build Packing Lists -- Use your gear to build weight-aware packing lists.
- Keep Your Backpack Light -- Instantly see how your gear choices impact pack weight.
- Packing Checklist -- Check off items as you pack to ensure nothing is forgotten.
- Share Packing Lists -- Post your list on packlightapp.com and share a link or send a CSV of your list to anyone.
- Visualize Weight Distribution -- Use the bar graph to compare gear categories.
- Custom Categories -- Organize items your way with your own categories.
- Import From LighterPack -- Don't start from scratch - import your LighterPack lists (unaffiliated).
- Offline Access -- Access your data even off the grid. Works without internet.
ADVANCED FEATURES (Supporter Edition)
Supporter Edition is a one-time purchase that supports ongoing maintenance and improvements to PackLight and grants permanent access to these advanced features:
- Kits for Quick Packing -- Create kits to group items that you normally pack together, like a first aid kit or cooking gear, so you can add them all to a list at once.
- Unlimited Base Lists -- Create new packing lists based on any combination of your other lists and kits.
- Inventory Search -- Quickly find gear in your inventory.
ABOUT PACKLIGHT
PackLight was originally built for my own use and published free on the App Store to share with other backpackers. All of the core features are still free and always will be and it's been great to see PackLight become a favorite for so many! Thank you!
If you think PackLight has earned it, I'd really appreciate your honest rating and review. They help a lot and I read every last one.
Got an idea for improvement? Email me any time with feedback or feature requests at packlightapp@gmail.com.

The most incredible free team-based battle royale.
The World's Survival depends on you - crush anyone who is part of the Kurtz army kingdom!
Participate in Daily Events, Gauntlet Mode and Boss Raids!
Take charge by shooting and switching between heroes, or use auto-play for idle gameplay!
Gear up for the best free third person shooter rpg game on mobile!
JOIN THE HUNT
• Cover-based, third person shooter experience with amazing console-like graphics
• Quickly swap between Heroes during battle in real-time, team-based combat wars
• Modern and futuristic weaponry makes playing each hero a distinct experience; fire sniper rifles and energy guns
• Deploy jaw-dropping special abilities that can quickly turn the tide of battle.
• Hone your skills by controlling your heroes or play idle when on the move.

• Collect exclusive heroes, each with their own legendary weapons and special abilities.
• Assemble the right team to take on the enemy. Mix up your roster to find the perfect combination - keep your tanks and healers on overwatch while your assassins and assault classes take down the enemy.
• Play as your favorite hero and dynamically switch between heroes at any time during gameplay.
• Plunder loot after each battle, level up your heroes, upgrade your abilities and perfect your loadout.
• Immerse yourself in the single-player campaign as you fight against raiders, bandits and worse in a post-apocalyptic cityscape.
• The battle is never over. Watch your hero squad dominate the battlefield. 
REAL-TIME PvP TACTICAL BATTLE MODE
• Challenge your skills against other players in real-time multiplayer action-packed tactical PvP combat 
• Craft a tactical squad of up to 5 heroes and dominate the leaderboards and leagues
• Join forces with your friends to build an unstoppable military alliance 
• Beat your rivals in intense time-based event competitions focused on both solo and strategic group play. 
• Become one of the highest ranked lords of PvP!

bluejetty:00177954:ios.description:
Hello, little farmer boys and girls! Are you ready to enjoy farm life and take care of all animals? Visit a farmhouse, barnyard, feed animals, and collect all the eggs! Let's help bees to make honey or harvest the fields!
With the My Town: Farm game, you will experience authentic village life and join many farmer boys and girls who adore our farm game!
FARMING GAMES FOR FARMER BOYS AND GIRLS
Play dress-up games and choose a perfect costume for your farmer! Meet his family, wife, and kids! Prepare food in the kitchen or go out and drive a tractor in the barnyard! Expand farm game experience in this village game by bringing the witch or the old farmer to your farmhouse.
You can easily interact with the environment as the My Town: Animal Farm games for kids allow you to move items and characters between them seamlessly. My Town Farming games will help kids to improve creativity and imagination!
Touch anything you want and make your own farming game story! Just use your fingers and imagination and have fun! The opportunities are endless on your dream little farm full of animals!
MY TOWN FARM GAME FOR KIDS FEATURES:
• Experience life on the farm with many animals
• 6 farm game locations: barnyard, field, market, and more!
• New farm game characters for your My Town collection
• Play village games and take care of all animals
• Mix N Match – create new items from the products you collected by farming
• New farm game-themed clothing, new food, and lots of fun
• Multi-touch feature – Enjoy farming games with your friends on the same device!
• Create your own animal farm life story
• No rules, just a lot of fun village games for all kids!
• Drive a tractor, plant, and be a great farmer
You can create your own animal farm life story by playing the My Town Farm game! Explore the barnyard and the farmhouse and take care of animals. Be the best farmer you could be!
TAKE CARE OF ANIMALS IN THE BARNYARD AND LEARN NEW THINGS!
Pack your bags, roll up your sleeves, and experience the best animal farm game adventure! The village is counting on you! Take care of animals, harvest the field and be proud of your hard work! Living in the countryside in the farmhouse can be fun! Farmer boys and girls can enjoy the village life and create their own stories using only creativity and imagination!
And not only that, experience a farm life kids can learn a lot about animals! They will learn how to take care of animals and what they eat, gather vegetables and what life in the village looks like in general! There is a lot of fun waiting for you in this animal farm game for farmer boys and girls!
FARMHOUSE – AMAZING DOLLHOUSE HOME IN THE COUNTRYSIDE
You will experience authentic village life on an animal farm and have fun in the countryside by playing our animal farm game! Farming games were never more accessible or more fun! Download the best farm game for farmer boys and girls and experience unique farm life!
Little farmer boys and girls will have a unique farming experience!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.
ABOUT MY TOWN GAMES STUDIO
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse games that promote creativity and open-ended play for all kids worldwide. My Town games introduce experiences for hours of imaginative play. For more information, visit www.my-town.com.

Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com

bluejetty:00028673:ios.name: Mr. Mine: Idle Dig Incremental
bluejetty:00028673:ios.summary: Mr. Mine is the idle miner game with an incremental mechanic where you manage a mine full of various precious metals. Dig deep to get more rare treasure - Earn more money & upgrade faster! This idle clicker game is a unique mining simulator
bluejetty:00028673:ios.description:
Mr. Mine is the idle miner game with an incremental mechanic where you manage a mine full of various precious metals. Dig deep to get more rare treasure - Earn more money & upgrade faster! This idle clicker game is a unique mining simulator - Start your digging adventure now!
Originally released in 2012, Mr.Mine was played more than 20 million times and has now been remastered for mobile.
Developed by the team behind Clicker Heroes Mr.Mine if you love to play idle clicker games you won't be able to put down Mr.Mine. 
Mr.Mine approaches incremental games in a novel way by emphasizing adventure and discovery.
Manage a team of miners and upgrade your drill to idle your way through the mines and discover mysteries and treasures in the depths below.
There are over 100+ drill upgrades to unlock as you progress through the mines!
You are starting the game with a humble pickaxe for digging. When you grow your mining business, you earn more, and you can upgrade to advanced digging and mining tools!
Main features of Mr. Mine Idle Miner:
- Mining Quest - 90+ quests to complete and achievements to unlock in this amazing idle clicker game!
- Mysterious Challenges - There are many secret encounters. Dig deep to find them all.
- Chests - Reach the underground city and find chests with hidden upgrades.
- Dig Deep - Unlock new features the deeper you go. Discover them all and gather rare ores - Welcome to the idle craft world!
- Idle Miner Adventure - Afraid of federally induced inflation? Mine tons of precious gems and ores to make your billions! Klang Gang!
- Trading Post - When you reach the needed level of resources, you can create a new trading post where you can trade for minerals and find new chests!
- Updated Artwork - Updated artwork & re-balanced progression from the original! Enjoy the unique mining simulator game!
Upgrade and grow your mining business - Build a mining empire from the scratch! Dig deep to extract natural minerals and valuable ores and isotopes. Incremental digging simulator for the real clicker experience - Just tap to play!
Hire workers & enhance mining machines - Automate the process and generate huge profit! Produce resources for selling - Coal, Copper, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Uranium, and more! Become an underground mining tycoon!
How to play
- Mine for resources
- Complete quests
- Buy and sell ores and minerals
- Upgrade your drill
- Upgrade your labor
- Upgrade your life
Download our idle clicker game and mining simulator to experience the world of Mr. Mine - An idle miner adventure for all fans of incremental games! Dig deep to make sure that you are exploiting the full potential of the mine - Start your digging adventure!

“Clients love how easy and straightforward it is to book online and the experience in the salon with the iPad is so easy. Everyone understands iPads and loves them. It makes us look more organised, which adds to the experience of visiting a professional salon.”
 - Stevie Vincent Studios

bluejetty:00064356:ios.description:
Met de VRT MAX-app kijk én luister je helemaal gratis naar het strafste aanbod van VRT. Waar en wanneer jij het wil, live of op het moment dat jij er even voor kan gaan zitten. Geniet van je favoriete programma’s, bekijk de leukste extra video’s en beluister de meest uiteenlopende podcasts. Laat je maximaal verrassen door onze suggesties en extra’s. Download de app, zet je gemakkelijk en geniet hoe jij het wil. VRT MAX da's de max :
- de beste verhalen verslinden met Vlaamse en internationale topseries.
- de actualiteit op de voet volgen door live of op aanvraag naar het journaal, Terzake en andere VRT NWS programma’s te kijken.
- een beetje nostalgisch worden door ons uitgebreide archief.
- geen seconde van Thuis missen en je favoriete personages nog beter leren kennen.
- inspiratie opdoen dankzij de allerbeste docu's.
- je kinderen met een gerust hart in de Ketnetzone kijkplezier bezorgen.
- luisteren én kijken naar de radio en al onze streams.
- de meest uiteenlopende podcasts beluisteren.
- berichtjes ontvangen over je favoriete programma’s.
- verrast worden door onze geselecteerde pareltjes.
- lekker handig een persoonlijk lijstje maken.
Hoe kijk en luister je VRT MAX? 
- Op je smartphone, tablet, tv of in de auto
- Live of wanneer je tijd hebt
- Helemaal gratis

bluejetty:00177684:ios.summary: If fashion is all you dream about, Indian Fashion Dressup Stylist is the game for you! Revel in the latest fashion trends, styles & makeup looks inspired by the Indian fashion landscape. Rise to fame by styling your versatile clientele in s
bluejetty:00177684:ios.description:
If fashion is all you dream about, Indian Fashion Dressup Stylist is the game for you! Revel in the latest fashion trends, styles & makeup looks inspired by the Indian fashion landscape. Rise to fame by styling your versatile clientele in stellar looks & become the ultimate Indian Fashion Stylist!
Witness the grandeur of Indian Fashion where desi meets the west. Take up design assignments and create tons of stylish looks for clients in the game. Enhance your fashion design skills as you build a dream wardrobe with different trendy clothes. Add amazing makeup, hair, and jewelry to your inventory for a wholesome experience.
Indian Fashion Dressup Stylist not only brings to you the top fashion trends in India but also allows you to create your own style and share them with your friends and peers. If you love all aspects of fashion, from stylish dress-up to make-up trends to hairstyles, this is the perfect fashion game for you.
Embrace Indian magnificence with over 1500 outfits, accessories & backgrounds inspired by the vibrant Indian culture with a tinge of western touch! Become a "Fashion Stylist Icon" and cater to a wide range of models right from businesswomen to brides and doctors to fitness enthusiasts in this dress-up game.
Show what a fab stylist and fashion curator you are by taking up "Style Challenges". Create a dream inventory for various dress-up scenes, fashion models, and style events by adding tons of designer clothes, make-up styles, hair styles, and trendy accessories for free. If you covet Indian fashion trends, this dress-up game is your "one destination to style them all"!
Check out the features in this fashion stylist game:
• Special Events - Enjoy latest fashion trends for new seasons and festivities with specially curated levels. Create your style throughout the year and show your fashion prowess.
• Style Album - This game mode allows you to take up fashion design projects and create the perfect makeover for a wide range of clients. Choose the best combination of dresses, makeup, hairstyles, and accessories to dress up super models.
• Style Challenges - You get to compete with other fashion designers, to dress up a supermodel with similar requirements. Show the best of your skills and win against other stylists in this mode.
• 7 Stylish Themes - Enjoy a wide range of themes from Wedding, Party, Festive, Work Global, Work Indo, Casual Global & Casual Indo and get a wholesome fashion game experience.
• Styles You’ll Love - Collect 1400+ Indian-inspired outfits, jewelry, shoes, bags, accessories & more and create a dream inventory for everything fashion. Create your own super stylish wardrobe.
• Global Fusion - Get mesmerized with sarees, lehengas, kurtas, and also with chic western wear!
• Makeup Magic - Elevate your glam game & complete your looks with over 100 eye makeup, lip colors, hairstyles & skin tones!
• Stunning Sceneries - Choose from over 150 backgrounds to go with your fashion designs to create a complete look!
Indian Fashion Dressup Stylist brings you a wholesome experience of a fashion girl game for free! Create your very own virtual dress-up studio and makeup & hair salon, to enhance your fashion skills.

bluejetty:00060721:ios.description:
Bismillaahirrahmaanirrahiim.
Assalamu'alaikum Warahmatullah Wabarakatuhu.
Al Quran app with translations in three languages: Indonesia, Melayu and English, user friendly interface, can be accessed without an internet connection, there is a salat times schedule and Qibla direction feature to support salat, and this app without/no ads.
Features:
- Attractive design, slide the screen to change surah or juz.
- Surah Index (list of Surah).
- Juz Index (list of Juz).
- Rasm / writing (IndoPak and Uthmani style).
- Latin writing (Transliteration).
- Translation in Indonesia, Melayu, English.
- Tafsir in Indonesia, Melayu, English.
- Word for word translation from Arabic to Indonesia, Melayu, English.
- Copy verses of the Al Quran.
- Share Al Quran verses.
- Bookmark verses of the Al Quran.
- Last reading marker.
- Colored Tajweed.
- Audio mp3 murattal 30 Juz (8 choices of qori, including: Shaykh Hani Ar Rifai, Shaykh Mishary Rashid, Shaykh Fares Abbad, Shaykh Mahmud Khalil Al Husary, Shaykh Maher Al Muaiqly, Shaykh Saad Al-Ghamdi, Shaykh Muhammad Jebril and Shaykh Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais).
- Audio control to listening murattal (play, pause, stop, next, previous).
- Search for verses based on keywords in the translation.
- Salat Times Schedule (along with notification of salat times when they arrive).
- Salat Times Schedule Widget (for iOS 14 and latest).
- Qibla direction.
- Hijri calendar for the next 30 days (fasting schedule and imsak schedule).
- Support dark-mode (for iOS 13 and later).
* And further features are currently under development.

bluejetty:00019552:ios.description:
Sit back, relax and play Deep Clean Inc. The cleanup game designed for people who get satisfaction from cleaning. Scrub, wash and wipe to relieve stress in this highly satisfying cleaning game where every level is unique. You might be asked to clean the fridge or you might need to wash a car but one thing is for sure - you’re going to have a satisfying cleaning experience!
Grab a power washer, a vacuum cleaner or a mop and get to work! Whatever it takes to get the job done. In this cleaning game, you’ll find all sorts of dirty objects you need to wipe clean. Are you up to the task?

If you love ASMR games, OCD games, organization games, organizing games, chores games, or washing games, you’ll definitely enjoy Deep Clean Inc. clean up game.
Get ready to…
- Experience calming ASMR cleaning gameplay
- Organize kitchen appliances like dishwashers and refrigerators. Just like in fill the fridge and organize the fridge games!
- Work your way through countless levels offering a wide variety of clean up games, tidy up games and OCD games
- Unlock special cleaning items
- Earn mystery boxes with even more special cleaning items!
- Spin the daily bonus wheel and win additional coins
So, if you’re looking for a fun way to relieve stress, download Deep Clean Inc. chores game- the best cleaning app around and make dirty objects clean and shiny again.

bluejetty:00171043:ios.description:
Leap Math is an AI-powered math learning app for students in grades K-12 who wish to learn with fun. We offer personalized, interactive, and immersive learning experiences powered by GPT-4. 
Leap Math has always been committed to providing the best math learning experience possible. Thanks to the top team of educators from Harvard, Princeton, and Ivy League, learners can have fun while exploring the charm of math by going through bite-sized animated video lessons and AI-powered adaptive practice that are crafted and polished with heart.
KEY FEATURES
- AI math tutor helps you solve all math problems.
- AI Photo Recognition: Easy question input and instant response.
- Interactive and immersive video courses.
- AI-powered adaptive practice & assessment.
- Personalized and self-paced learning plan.
- Exciting math challenge game.
HOW does AI Leap Math Tutor work?
【Help you solve math problems efficiently】
- AI interactive and step-by-step guidance help you understand 'how' and 'why'.
- AI Photo Recognition: Simply scan the problem and get an instant response.
【Provide immersive and interactive learning experience】
- Immersive courses with animation simulate real class scenarios.
- Interactively explain complex concepts with real-life examples.
【Offer personalized and adaptive learning experience】
- Adaptive questioning by artificial intelligence GPT-4.
- Design a self-paced learning plan through personalized assessment.
【Systematically integrate math concepts】
- Integrate 1,000+ math topics, 8,000+ math skills, and 60,000+ engaging practice questions.
- School-aligned curriculum designed by Ivy League educators. 
WHY do children like Leap Math？
【Exciting Math challenge & game】
- Challenging activities help to sharpen students' skills and keep students interested.
- The opportunity to engage in friendly competition with students all over the world.
【Lively and interesting course format】
- Stories, animation, and interactive graphics inspire a love for learning.
- Keep a rewarding streak and cultivate study habits.
WHY do parents trust Leap Math?
【Rich content for each grade】
- Contain math concepts from all grades and provide key recommendations.
- Include arithmetic, numbers, pre-algebra, geometry, algebra1/2, geometry advanced, probabilities & statistics...
【Safe and convenient environment for study】
- Lightweight and stress-free learning experience.
- Access with your smartphone or tablet anytime, anywhere.
- No worries about screen time and ads.
At Leap Math, we care for your differentiated learning purposes! You are the one to decide what to learn: dive deeper into intriguing topic-centered courses or follow a scientifically-designed learning path. Unfold your Math adventure in your own way.
