bluejetty:00074018:ios.summary:
Enjoy the excellent Killer Sudoku puzzle game for both beginners and advanced Sudoku lovers! Download and start the daily challenge now!
Thousands of killer sudoku puzzles here for you to solve. Come to play this new killer sudoku game, an
bluejetty:00074018:ios.description:
Enjoy the excellent Killer Sudoku puzzle game for both beginners and advanced Sudoku lovers! Download and start the daily challenge now!
Thousands of killer sudoku puzzles here for you to solve. Come to play this new killer sudoku game, and train your brain. Have fun!
[New] Dark Theme is available now! Perfect for you to play Killer Sudoku before bed.
[New] Color Theme. Playing games could be colorful!
[New] Casual Mode. 4*4 and 6*6 boards bring you more fun!
Killer Sudoku is a logical puzzle number game & brain game. To complete a puzzle, like the classic sudoku game, you can fill the grid with numbers; unlike the classic sudoku puzzle, you have to make sure that the sum of numbers in each cage (areas surrounded by the dotted lines) is equal to the number in the upper left corner of the cage.
If you are interested in playing number games or math puzzle games, this Killer Sudoku is exactly for you! If you'd ever played number games, such as Sumdoku, Addoku or Cross sum, come to try this one, too! It is an amazing combination of a sudoku puzzle, a KenKen and a Kakuro puzzle game.
Killer Sudoku may be a little bit harder than a classic sudoku puzzle game, no worries! We offer several balanced difficulty levels for beginners and advanced players! The game has the function to add or remove notes during gameplay. Did you make a mistake at the beginning? No worries, there are undo and hint functions! Get it back fast!
How to play:
1. Place numbers 1-9 into each grid cell exactly like in a classic Sudoku puzzle;
2. Different cages - groups of grid cells indicated by dotted lines;
3. The sum of all numbers in each cage should be equal to the number in the upper left corner;
4. The sum of all numbers of each 3x3 block, row, or column always equals 45;
5. Each cage, row, column, or 3x3 block cannot have the repeated numbers.
Features:
- Turn on the note mode to take notes like solving puzzles on a piece of paper. The memo is automatically updated while you fill in the cell.
- Find your mistakes and challenge yourself or use auto-check to see your mistakes in real-time.
- Complete daily challenges and earn special trophies!
- Use free hints when you are stuck.
- Thousands of killer sudoku puzzle games
More functions and highlights:
- Statistics. Track your killer sudoku progress.
- Unlimited Undo. One tap to remove the mistake.
- Autosave. If you leave Sudoku incomplete, it will be saved. Keep playing anytime.
- Eraser. Eliminate all of the mistakes if you made any.
- Sharing functions. You can share this sudoku game with your friends via Facebook, Twitter, etc.
- Four perfectly balanced difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert.
Train your brain anytime and anywhere and keep your mind sharp in this Killer Sudoku puzzle game. With its easy control, intuitive interface, and perfect selection of different levels, this killer sudoku app will help you to enhance your logical ability and learn more Sudoku skills. Come and try it out! Challenge yourself how quickly you can solve problems and improve your memory!
We always carefully check all reviews. Please feel free to leave your ideas, feedback, suggestions, or any questions about Killer Sudoku for further improvements! We are always here for you. Thank you and have fun with Killer Sudoku, Sudoku Puzzle!
Privacy policy: https://killer-sudoku.gurugame.ai/policy.html
Terms of use: https://killer-sudoku.gurugame.ai/termsofservice.html

Swarm by Foursquare is the original check-in and travel app that turns your daily journeys into a personal location history, social map, a
bluejetty:00174382:ios.description:
Check in anywhere. Find amazing places. Save favorites to revisit later — and see your life on a map.
Swarm by Foursquare is the original check-in and travel app that turns your daily journeys into a personal location history, social map, and travel journal you’ll actually love using.
CHECK IN FAST
 • One-tap check-ins at any place you visit.
 • Add photos and friends to capture moments and memories.
 • Stay private or share publicly — your check-ins, your choice.
SEARCH & DISCOVER PLACES
 • Find coffee shops, restaurants, parks, and hidden gems near you using powerful place search.
 • Explore cities through Foursquare’s verified maps and local guides.
 • Turn your check-ins into a travel log of every city you explore.
BOOKMARK & SAVE PLACES
 • Bookmark favorite restaurants, cafes, and landmarks for later.
 • Build custom lists like “Weekend Spots,” “Tokyo Trip,” or “Best Pizza.”
 • Your saved places become a personal travel planner and city guide.
YOUR LIFE TIMELINE
 • Each check-in adds to your personal timeline of places you’ve been.
 • Scroll through days, weeks, or years to relive memories.
 • Search your location history and see your journey on a map.
TRAVEL JOURNAL & MEMORIES
 • Automatically build a visual record of every trip and adventure.
 • Add notes and photos to remember every moment.
 • Share your travels and inspire friends to explore.
SOCIAL MAP WITH FRIENDS
 • See friends’ check-ins live on a shared social map.
 • Comment, react, and plan meetups in real time.
 • Discover new cities and travel spots together.
EXPLORING MILESTONES
 • Earn badges for daily check-ins, new cities, and new places.
 • Celebrate milestones and track your most-visited spots.
 • Keep your streak alive and make every day count.
SMART NOTIFICATIONS
 • Get reminders to check in when you arrive somewhere new.
 • See when friends are nearby and plan spontaneous meetups.
 • Stay connected without constant manual tracking.
POWERED BY FOURSQUARE
 • Every place comes from Foursquare’s verified global POI database.
 • Accurate locations, categories, and maps trusted by millions worldwide.
 • The same data that powers Uber, Apple, and Airbnb — now in your pocket.
Start your check-in journey today and discover every place that shapes your world.
A Note on Battery
We’ve spent *years* developing the location technology that powers Foursquare Swarm, making it extremely power efficient. But, as with all apps of this type, continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life

bluejetty:00067882:ios.summary:
Create logos, illustrations, graphics and more. Illustrator on the iPad works intuitively with your Apple Pencil so you can design on the go from anywhere, even offline - it’s never been easier to take your creativity to new places.
Design
bluejetty:00067882:ios.description:
Create logos, illustrations, graphics and more. Illustrator on the iPad works intuitively with your Apple Pencil so you can design on the go from anywhere, even offline - it’s never been easier to take your creativity to new places.
Design with precision, as naturally as you would with pen and paper. Create vector lines, shapes, type, gradients, and effects. Merge or cut graphics with quick, intuitive Pencil gestures to remove unwanted areas. Make your graphics pop with effects, and access over 18,000 fonts, 20+ color palettes, up-to-the-minute live streams from famous creatives, and guided tutorials.
Work on a project across Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Fresco. Plus, your Illustrator work is automatically synced to the cloud, so you and your team can always access the latest version from your desktop or iPad.
This app is part of Adobe Creative Cloud. It’s free for Creative Cloud members who have a plan that includes Illustrator.
INTUITIVE AND PRECISE DRAWING WITH APPLE PENCIL 
• Natural ways to draw — Make lines and curves using the Pen, Pencil, and Brush tools
• Art and Calligraphic Brushes — Create and apply brush strokes to add artistic elements to your artwork.
• Pinpoint editing — Create perfect graphics without quality loss with Smart Delete, Simplify Path, and more
• Point precision — Edit graphics down to the point, radius, or angle level
NEW WAYS TO MAKE STUNNING PATTERNS AND SHAPES
• Vectorize — Convert raster images or paper sketches into vector images.
• Radial, grid, and mirror repeat — Turn graphics into sophisticated patterns
• Polygon shape creation — Make objects out of circles, triangles, squares, and stars
• Transform as Shape — Transform paths and curves without manual manipulation of anchor points.
• Blend Tool — Smoothly blend one shape into another across a specified number of steps.
THE MOST COMPREHENSIVE TYPE TOOLKIT FOR IPAD 
• 18,000+ fonts — Use one of the thousands of high-quality fonts included in the Adobe Fonts library
• Fonts of your own — Upload and design with any of your own licensed fonts and use them on both desktop and iPad 
• Type on a path — Bend and flow text onto the surface of lines and shapes 
• Outlined text — Turn text into an editable format that can be modified without limits
• Variable fonts — They’re infinitely customizable
• Color fonts — Explore gorgeous color variations and gradients that are built into the font
BRILLIANT COLORS AND GRADIENTS
• Point gradients — Drag and drop colors to create dynamic blends of diffused colors
• 20+ color books — Use industry-standard color swatches or incorporate your own
SEAMLESS MOVEMENT BETWEEN DEVICES AND APPS
• File syncing between Illustrator on the desktop and on the iPad — Projects are automatically synced and accessible across devices
• Photoshop import — Easily place a Photoshop image into your Illustrator design
• Standard file format export — Create, save, and open Illustrator (AI) files with no loss of quality, and export in the most common formats, including SVG, PDF, PNG, and PSD.
KEEPING TABS ON THE LATEST CREATIVE TRENDS
• Livestreaming — Watch and learn from top design-industry creatives daily, right within the app
• Trends to discover — Explore projects by other creatives

Customer Insights & Data

bluejetty:00151919:ios.summary: Open Sea: Fishing Simulator is a unique and relaxing fishing game where you control your own fishing boat, explore open waters, and catch a wide variety of fish. Built from the ground up, the game offers a fresh and original take on boat fi
bluejetty:00151919:ios.description:
Open Sea: Fishing Simulator is a unique and relaxing fishing game where you control your own fishing boat, explore open waters, and catch a wide variety of fish. Built from the ground up, the game offers a fresh and original take on boat fishing, with smooth controls, satisfying progression, and beautiful ocean environments.
Start your journey in a small boat with basic gear. Cast your line, catch fish, sell your haul, and upgrade your equipment. Improve your boat, engine, nets, and fishing rod to travel farther, fish faster, and catch bigger, rarer species.
As your fishing skills increase, your player rank rises. Each rank unlocks new fishing locations, including deep-sea zones filled with rare fish, high-value catches, and unique open-ocean challenges. From calm coastal waters to vast open seas, every area offers new opportunities and rewards.
Bigger fish bring bigger risks — but also bigger profits. Upgrade wisely, improve your fishing tools, and prepare for exciting battles with giant sea creatures.
Created for fans of fishing games, boat simulators, and relaxing ocean adventure games, Open Sea: Fishing Simulator features intuitive gameplay, engaging progression, and a world designed specifically for this title.
Game Features
- Relaxing fishing gameplay with a satisfying upgrade system
- A large variety of fish to catch, collect, and sell
- Boat upgrades, engine improvements, and better fishing tools
- Unlock new fishing locations as your rank increases
- Deep-sea zones with rare and high-value fish
- Smooth boat controls and beautiful ocean environments
- Perfect for fans of fishing games, boat games, and fishing simulators
Set sail, explore the open sea, and build your fishing empire in Open Sea: Fishing Simulator — a uniquely crafted boat fishing game for mobile.

bluejetty:00064884:ios.description:
Free. Secure. Anywhere. Mobile Banking from First National Bank of Brookfield, lets you easily view and manage your accounts right in the palm of your hand anytime, anywhere! Best of all, it's free.
Mobile Banking is available to all registered Internet Banking customers; just download the app and enroll or log in with your Internet Banking Access ID and Password for a secure Mobile Banking experience. 
FEATURES
• View account balances and transaction history
• Pay your bills and view scheduled and recent payments 
• Pay other people with Zelle
• Transfer money between your FNBB accounts 
• Set up and receive account related alerts 
• Deposit checks – snap a photo of your checks and deposit them remotely
SAFETY FEATURES
• Account information is never stored on your phone 
• Data transmissions are encrypted with the same secure technology as Internet Banking 
HOW TO GET STARTED
• Mobile Banking is free from FNBB (but your mobile carrier’s message and data rates may apply) 
• Download the app and log in with your Internet Banking Access ID and Password 
RESTRICTIONS
• Deposits are subject to verifications and may not be available for immediate withdrawal 
• See the Terms and Conditions in the app for limits/availability and other restrictions

bluejetty:00166842:ios.description:
Translate Live - Voice to Text: Unlock Global Conversations
Whether you’re a frequent traveler, language enthusiast, or simply a global citizen, Voice Translator is your go-to app for seamless communication. Say farewell to linguistic challenges and embrace seamless translation, whether you're discovering new cultures, studying abroad, or connecting worldwide. Break down language barriers effortlessly with our powerful features:
1. Voice-to-Text Translation:
- Convert Spoken Words into Written Text: Imagine you’re having a conversation with someone in a foreign language. With Voice Translator, you can simply speak, and the app will transcribe your spoken words into written text. It’s like having an instant note-taker for any language! 
- Instantly Translate Your Voice Messages: Suppose you’re chatting with someone who speaks a different language. Instead of struggling to find the right words, use Voice Translator to record your voice message. The app will swiftly translate it into the recipient’s language, ensuring smooth communication.
- Communicate Freely in Any Language: Whether you’re traveling, working, or connecting with friends globally, Voice Translator empowers you. Break down language barriers effortlessly—speak naturally, and let the app handle the translation. Communicate freely, no matter which language you’re using!
2. All Languages Supported:

크로켓에 입점된 2만여 명의 해외 현지 셀러들과 즐겁게 채팅하며 상품을 거
bluejetty:00038400:ios.description:
▶전세계 커넥팅 쇼핑 크로켓
크로켓은 전 세계에 거주하는 셀러들과 1:1로 소통하며 상품을 거래하는 크로스보더 플랫폼이에요. 오늘 뜬 핫한 해외 상품은 물론 국내 미출시 상품, 해외 아울렛 상품까지. 전세계 89개국 2만 명의 셀러들과 연결될 준비 되셨나요?
▶해외 쇼핑 그 이상의 커넥팅 쇼핑!
복잡한 해외쇼핑, 해외 직구와는 GOOD BYE~! 
크로켓에 입점된 2만여 명의 해외 현지 셀러들과 즐겁게 채팅하며 상품을 거래해보세요.
일반 쇼핑몰에서 구매하는 것처럼 쉽게, 직접 상품을 수령하기 전까지는 거래 대금이 보호되는 안심결제시스템으로 안전하게!
크로켓과 함께 쇼핑의 영역을 넓혀보세요 :) 
▶국내 미출시템, 품절템까지 1:1 요청으로 쉽게
국내에서 구하기 어려운 상품은 현지 셀러에게 1:1로 구매요청을 해보세요.
해외 거주자, 유학생, 여행자, 빠삭한 할인 정보로 구매 대행을 해주는 드롭쉬퍼까지!
크로켓의 다양한 전세계 셀러들이 원하는 상품을 반드시 찾아줄거에요.
▶전세계 핫트렌드 모음 zip
세상에서 가장 핫한 패션, 뷰티, 명품, 리빙, 스낵, 취미 아이템까지! 
크로켓만의 글로벌 MD 테마전을 통해 가장 핫한 글로벌 트렌드를 만나보세요. 
내가 알고 있던 취향을 넘어 내가 몰랐던 새로운 취향까지 발견하게 될거에요! 
▶혜택까지 즐거운 크로켓과 커넥팅 쇼핑!
- 크로켓이 처음이라면, '웰컴 쿠폰팩'을 통해 첫 번째 거래를 할인받아 경험해보세요! (빠지면 못헤어나올 거에요.) 
- 핫하고 트렌디한 상품과 브랜드를 모아둔 크로켓 'MD의 추천 상품' 들을 만나보세요.
- 내가 좋아하는 상품과 마켓들을 찜해두고 알림까지 받아보는 '찜 기능'을 이용해보세요. 
- 쓰면 쓸수록 쌓이는 재미가 쏠쏠한 '크로켓 크레딧' 까지! 똑같은 혜택도 더 즐겁게 누려보세요. 
크로켓 VIP들을 위한 혜택도 준비되어있으니 자주 이용해주세요 : )
▶믿고 사고, 믿고 거래하는 커넥팅 쇼핑
전세계와 커넥팅 되는 쇼핑의 즐거움이 흔들리지 않도록,
상품 오배송, 배송 중 파손, 정품에 대한 문제 발생에 대해 100% 환불이 보장되고 국내 결제를 통해 쉽게 해외 상품을 구매할 수 있어요. 직접 구매자분들이 수령을 하기전까지는 셀러에게 정산이 되지 않으니 해외 상품도 믿고 살 수 있어요. 
또한 크로켓에선 좋은 상품을 추천하고, 사다주고 싶은 마음만 있다면 누구나 간편한 셀러등록을 통해 셀러가 될 수 있어요. 
지금 바로 크로켓에서 전세계의 모든 사람, 취향과 연결되어 보세요 :) 
▶크로켓 거래 금지 품목
(거래금지품목)
- 의약품
- 통관이 불가능한 성분이 포함된 건강제품 및 식품, 화장품 등
- 술/담배
- 주민등록증 / 각종 신분증 
- 수제 음식, 수제 화장품 등
- 출처가 불분명한 중고/빈티지 제품
- 출처가 불분명한 해외 제품
- 기타 인터넷에서 거래 시 법에 저촉되는 모든 상품에 대해서는 요청을 포함한 판매까지 모두 제재 대상이 될 수 있어요.
▶크로켓 서비스 접근권한 안내
크로켓에서는 유저분들의 편의를 위해 다음과 같이 최소한의 디바이스 권한을 받고 있어요.
아래 기재된 [선택] 접근권한에 동의하지 않아도, 해당 권한을 제외한 서비스 이용이 가능합니다.
왜 이러한 디바이스 관련 권한이 필요한지 설명해드릴게요. 
[선택] 저장 권한 - 휴대폰 스토리지 접근 권한 / 카메라, 앨범 권한
크로켓에서는 유저분들이 1:1 대화를 통한 사진 전송이나 1:1 구매요청 / 마켓 상품 판매 등록 / 리뷰 작성 등의 서비스 이용시, 사진을 올리면 data 전송 비용을 아끼기 위해 해당 사진을 스토리지에 저장 후 최적화된 사이즈로 캐시 영역에 다시 저장한 뒤 서버로 전송하게 됩니다. 그래서 읽기 쓰기 권한을 받고 있어요. 
[선택] 어플 푸시 알림 권한
크로켓은 구매자와 셀러간의 대화 혹은 서비스 이용 시 꼭 필요한 거래 관련 알림을 드리기 위해 푸시 알림 권한을 사용하고 있어요. 동의하지 않는 경우에는 알림이 울리지 않아요. (마이페이지에서 알림 권한 변경이 가능합니다.)

bluejetty:00161854:ios.description:
Ranked as the Best Bank in the Philippines in Forbes’ World’s Best Banks 2026 list, MariBank PH (formerly SeaBank PH) is now a BSP-licensed digital bank offering simple, reliable, and rewarding ways to save, pay, and earn every day—proudly part of the Sea Group, the same group behind Shopee.
Open an account in 5 minutes and enjoy daily interest earnings, unlimited free transfers, free money, and cashback rewards that make everyday spending more rewarding. Join millions of Filipinos saving smarter with MariBank! 
EVERYDAY BANKING MADE SIMPLE: HIGH INTEREST EARNINGS & FREE TRANSFERS
• Earn up to 3.75% p.a. on your savings, credited DAILY.
• Unlimited FREE transfers via InstaPay and PESONet.
• No maintaining balance, no lock-in period, and no account fees.
ENJOY CASHBACK, FREE MONEY, AND EVERYDAY REWARDS
• Claim up to ₱588 pamasko when you refer friends to MariBank, up to 100 referrals monthly!
• Enjoy up to 10% cashback with your MariBank Card: 10% on train rides, 5% on ride-hailing apps, 3% on gas, 3% at select supermarkets, and 1% on all other local spend!
• Get ₱5.00 cashback on each merchant QRPh transaction.
• Get up to 10% off on Load & Mobile Data promos when you buy via the MariBank app.
• Get up to ₱50 cashback monthly when you pay bills via the MariBank app.
EVERYDAY PAYMENTS, NOW CONNECTED: LINK SHOPEEPAY AND SPAYLATER
• Link your ShopeePay and SPayLater accounts to the MariBank app in minutes.
• Scan to pay with MariBank, ShopeePay, (or SPayLater for select users) and earn cashback.
• Transfer funds between ShopeePay and MariBank more easily & repay your SPayLater loans with fewer steps.
• Pay less with available Vouchers in your QR purchases when you link your ShopeePay and SPayLater accounts!
GROW YOUR SAVINGS WITH UPFRONT TIME DEPOSIT
• Interest earned instantly upon successful placement.
• Get 3.75% p.a. on a minimum of ₱100 in a 1-month or 3-month deposit.
• Choose auto-rollover to renew automatically when your time deposit matures.
SHOP ANYWHERE WITH CONFIDENCE
• Get a MariBank Card and enjoy 0% Foreign Transaction Fees when you use your card to shop in-store abroad.
• Enjoy FREE ATM withdrawals abroad and cash out at ATMs nationwide.
• Feel secure with the numberless MariBank Card, with transaction controls and limits easily and instantly configurable in the MariBank app.
• Use your Mari Credit Card on Shopee Checkout and enjoy 2% coins cashback & 0% interest.
FLEXIBLE LOAN OPTIONS
• Selected users may access Mari Loan with competitive interest rates of as low as 0.95% per month and flexible repayment terms.
SECURE, REGULATED, AND PROTECTED
• Your account is secured with multi-factor authentication and encryption.
• MariBank Philippines, Inc. is regulated by the BSP. 
• Deposits are insured by PDIC up to ₱1 Million per depositor.
MariBank PH is part of Sea Limited (NYSE: SE) — the global consumer internet company behind Shopee and Garena.
FOLLOW US TO STAY UPDATED WITH OUR PROMOS & SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENTS
• Facebook: facebook.com/MariBankPH/
• Instagram: instagram.com/maribank.ph
• Tiktok: tiktok.com/@maribank.ph

bluejetty:00184244:ios.description:
Download the CaixaBank app and manage your money from your phone, without visiting a branch or ATM.
A fast, stable and reliable mobile banking app: access what you use most in seconds and enjoy a smooth experience whenever you need it.
With CaixaBank, manage your money independently, every day.
With a 4.7* rating on the App Store, more than 90% of users rate us positively. CaixaBank stands out among mobile banking apps with the best reviews in the Spanish market.
We listen to our users and build a fast, reliable and hassle-free app.
Why is the CaixaBank app different from other banks?
Fewer steps, more control
Everything you need from your bank, right from your phone. We've redesigned the app to reduce steps and give you more control: transfer money, check your accounts and manage everything without calls or branch visits.
Artificial Intelligence built into your everyday banking
Includes a smart search powered by semantic and generative AI: find what you need and complete tasks using natural language. Looking for a financial product? An expert AI assistant helps you compare options, answers your questions and helps you choose the one that best suits you. If you'd rather speak to someone, your personal manager takes over without losing context.
Cashback: earn money back on your purchases
Pay with your CaixaBank card and automatically earn real cash back, with no coupons, codes or hassle. With more than 100 partner brands, cashback is one of our most valued benefits.
Facilitea: find the best financing
Homes, cars and electronics with the best financing options, all from the app. No paperwork or hassle.
Security and reliability without friction
Access with biometric authentication (fingerprint and facial recognition) and integrated digital signature. 
Stable, fast, always up to date
A technologically advanced app built for stability, with continuous fixes and improvements.
What can I do with the CaixaBank app?
- Send money instantly with Bizum directly from the app, quickly and securely, in just 2 steps from your mobile banking app.
- Make transfers in 3 steps with built-in verification.
- Check and manage your accounts and cards in real time: transactions, categorized spending and personalized alerts to help you stay on top of your money.
- Take out more than 40 financial products from one place with AI assistance. Find the best option without calls or branch visits.
- Earn money back on every purchase with Cashback. Use your CaixaBank card at more than 100 brands and receive automatic refunds into your account.
- Manage your insurance, mortgage, investment funds and loans from your mobile banking app.
- Use the AI-powered smart search to answer questions, complete transactions and access what you use most in seconds using natural language.
- Find nearby ATMs and branches with the app's built-in map.
CaixaBank, an internationally recognized app.
Global Finance has recognized CaixaBank as Western Europe's Most Innovative Bank at the Innovators Awards 2026, highlighting the app as one of its key innovations.
CaixaBank, your online bank always with you. Easy, simple and fast mobile banking.
At CaixaBank, we will process your data to manage your comment and, if we can identify you as a customer, to contact you by phone for the same purpose.
For more information about how we process your data and how to exercise your rights, please visit https://www.caixabank.es/particular/general/privacy-policy.html
CaixaBankNow, S.A. is the banking institution that owns this application.

An All-New Smart Experience -
Create a home that works for you. The DTE Insight app helps you understand, manage and control the energy that powers your home, and your life. Make your home smarter and more efficient now.
The More You See, the More You Save -
How much energy does your home use each day? What does it cost? Where can I save in my home? DTE Insight shows you exactly how much energy you are using and gives you the tools to take control. Use less energy and save more money with DTE Insight. 
Control Your Home From Anywhere -
Is your furnace working? Did you shut off the curling iron? How much does it cost when the kids play video games all night? When connected to the Energy Bridge, the DTE Insight app delivers real-time energy data.
A Smart Home That Works for You -
Can your porch light turn on automatically at dusk? Can you change your thermostat at home to save when you are away? DTE Insight gives you a single, secure place to efficiently manage your home’s smart devices. 
Get the Premium Experience - Free for 6 Months -

Some features require connected smart devices and an Energy Bridge. Need help after downloading the app? In-app chat lets you talk with our support specialists!

bluejetty:00180895:ios.description:
Important Update for Our Community:
We're excited to announce that the next evolution of our GPS Drive Tours is now available. We encourage you to explore the enhanced experience available in our latest travel app.
Search for "Revealed Travel Guides" in the App Store to discover:
• More Detailed Maps
• Our Drive Tours and Travel Guides in One App
• Even More Locations
This transition represents our commitment to providing you with the best possible travel experience. Thank you for being part of our journey.
Revealed Tours: Brought to you by the world’s best-selling travel experts loved by millions!
Explore Maui at your leisure with Revealed Travel Guides’ GPS driving tour and audio guides.
Get access to AMAZING tours that span the entire island, from the resort area of Ka‘anapali to the posh south shore and Wailea, all the way around the Road to Hana, and everywhere in between.
Our audio tours — narrated by Andrew Doughty, local travel expert — span the entirety of Maui, detailing the hotspots and best hidden gems, as well as local legends & stories that have defined the spirit of Hawaii.
Sightseeing Maui has never been easier!
HIGHLIGHTS
•Travel at your own pace while having all the benefits of a local tour guide! Available offline
•Hundreds of guided audio driving tours
•Choose between listening to guided audio narrations as you drive or browse the guides from the comfort of your own home
•Learn of the incredible stories & legends of Hawaii
•Turn-by-turn directions that help you find the best sights, hotspots, and recommendations
•Listen to your own music between narrations
YOUR LOCAL TOUR GUIDE
Using the app is like having a local friend drive you around!
We offer REAL insights that only experts who live on Maui can offer. We know these beaches, businesses and sights because we eat, sleep and breathe them!
You decide where to drive and we’ll tell you everything you need to know along the way!
DISCOVER WHERE TO GO
Our app gives you access to all of our guides & narrations across all of Maui.
Tours encompass Maui’s famous Road to Hana, including the town of Hana, the black- and red-sand beaches nearby, and all the waterfalls and scenic pull-offs along the road.
You’ll also find detailed tours of Haleakala National Park and West Maui, as well as plenty of stories and legends from all over the island.
Disc

bluejetty:00064602:ios.description:
L’app Banque Populaire en ligne avec vos attentes.
Retrouvez les principaux services de votre banque au quotidien* dans votre téléphone. 
Avec l’application Banque Populaire, c’est facile de gérer votre budget
- Contrôlez facilement vos dépenses grâce à la géolocalisation et les intitulés simplifiés de vos transactions. 
- Avec notre moteur de recherche performant, retrouvez vos opérations jusqu’à plus de 26 mois.
- Visualisez tous vos comptes, même ceux d’autres établissements bancaires sur un seul écran pour avoir une vue d’ensemble de vos finances avec le nouveau service d’agrégation de comptes.
- Optimisez la gestion de votre budget. Avec la « catégorisation des opérations », « le top catégories des dépenses », « entrées et sorties d’argent », vous repérez plus facilement les mouvements de votre compte et les postes budgétaires les plus onéreux. 
C’est rapide 
- Connectez-vous rapidement en toute sécurité avec Touch ID et Face ID.
- En un coup d’œil, vous consultez le solde de votre compte, sans avoir à vous connecter.
- Suivez votre situation financière en direct : comptes, produits d’épargne…
Effectuez des virements en temps réel. Accédez directement à l’historique de vos opérations : dépenses, recettes, virements à venir…
- Visualisez vos contrats et vos documents électroniques.
- Vous avez perdu le code de votre carte ? Retrouvez-le instantanément**.
C’est pratique 
- Quelques clics suffisent pour effectuer toutes vos opérations instantanément ** (virements, ajouts de bénéficiaires de virement), modifier vos plafonds de carte bancaire, activer/désactiver vos paiements par carte à l’étranger, à distance… 
- Plus besoin d’IBAN pour envoyer et recevoir de l’argent, avec Wero, un numéro de téléphone suffit.
- Gérez et consultez vos prélèvements.
C’est sûr 
- Achats par carte en ligne, virements, ajouts de bénéficiaires de virement… : lorsque vous vous authentifiez avec Sécur’Pass vous bénéficiez d’un niveau de protection renforcé et vous pouvez effectuer vos opérations à distance en toute sérénité.
- Carte volée ? Vous pouvez faire opposition à tout moment 24 h/24, 7 j/7.
- Vous ne savez plus où se trouve votre carte ? Verrouillez-la le temps de la retrouver. 
C’est convivial
- Grâce votre appli, restez en contact avec votre banque.
- Géolocalisez les agences bancaires et les distributeurs autour de vous.
- Vous pouvez prendre RDV avec votre conseiller, lui envoyer un email, l’appeler.
Mais encore ?
- Pour accompagner vos enfants en douceur dans leur apprentissage de la banque et de la gestion de leur argent, votre banque vous propose des cartes bancaires à autorisation quasi systématique. Le plus : grâce à l’appli Banque Populaire, vous gardez un œil en permanence sur les comptes de vos enfants. C’est plus sécurisant pour eux… et pour vous.
L’application Banque Populaire est également réservée aux clients entrepreneurs individuels abonnés à Cyberplus Entrepreneurs individuels. 
Pour vous permettre d’utiliser ces services, l’application doit pouvoir accéder à : 
- Vos notifications pour vous informer en temps réel
- Vos photos pour scanner des documents et les partager avec votre conseiller
- Votre position pour vous indiquer les distributeurs les plus proches
- Votre téléphone et vos appels pour contacter votre conseiller et veiller au bon fonctionnement de l’appli
- Vos contacts pour vous proposer prochainement une solution de paiement innovante
Si vous n’avez pas iOS 15 et versions ultérieures rendez-vous sur https://www.banquepopulaire.fr/ 
* Vous devez être détenteur d’un abonnement de banque à distance
.** Pour utiliser ces fonctionnalités instantanément, vous devez avoir activé Sécur’Pass.
*** Si vous avez souscrit au service « e-Documents ».

Ask AI MathGPT any questions, all problems could be solved quickly within a few seconds, and all answers are accompanied by step by step instructions, detailed explanations.

- Solve problems with multiple methods, so find the method that makes sense to you.

- Progress history and bookmark tracking to identify areas where you need more practice
AI MathGPT is your friendly personal tutor that can help you learn, achieve high grades and pass all examinations with flying colors.
► Here are some specific examples of how MathGPT can help you:

bluejetty:00097043:ios.description:
From the original creators of Choices: Stories You Play® comes your next obsession – a sweeping romantasy epic filled with spells, secrets, and the thrill of falling in love!
Love & Magic™: Spellfyre is the #1 romantasy story game where your choices shape everything. Featuring:
• 6 unique love interests
• Deep character customization (play as a girl or a guy)
• Stunning original artwork and animation
• Cinematic storytelling with real emotional stakes
• Story updates 3 times a week
• Choices that truly matter
THE STORY SO FAR…
20 years ago, the dark arcane Andros Dreadbane led a violent rebellion that killed thousands.
In the wake of that tragedy, Elderwood University was established to guide the next generation of arcanes toward wisdom, control, and peace.
But now Elderwood is being put to the ultimate test. The heir of Dreadbane has just enrolled… YOU!
LOVE IS MAGIC
Romance 6 powerful and complex love interests – each with their own path and their own potential.
• TALYN — a haunted rebel who wields fire magic with fury
• BARDRIC — a golden boy with charm, ambition, and deeply held grudges
• CATO — a brilliant scholar hiding his heart behind logic
• IRIDESSA — the glittering social butterfly
• LEONA — a fearless adventurer chasing griffons and second chances
• NIEL — your new best friend, still reeling from her tragic past
EMOTION IS MAGIC
Wield powerful spells fueled by your emotions – Love, Fear, Anger, Sorrow, Curiosity, and Joy – to solve the mystery at the heart of Elderwood University and explore the magical world of Austerea.
NEW CONTENT DROPS EACH WEEK!
WE ARE ALL MAGIC
Candlelight Games® was founded to create immersive narrative games that surprise, excite, and can delight. We believe in the power of games to unite people through shared experiences. We’re committed to creating entertaining games that foreground empathy and understanding. 
This game was made with love, by real people, for you.

bluejetty:00169218:android.description:
Embark on an enchanting journey with Watcher of Realms, the real-time tactical RPG that fits in your pocket! Over 3 million downloads globally, Watcher of Realms is now available. Download now for free!
It's time to explore the mystical continent of Tya and immerse yourself in a magical world with 100+ unique heroes! To save this chaotic land engulfed in madness, assume the role of a tactical commander with a plethora of resources at your fingers. Build your camp, collect and manage heroes of diverse factions and races, unlock powerful faction lords, and challenge the evil Ancient Gods.
Game Features:
1. High-quality audio-visual effects. Incredibly immersive.
Realistically magical 3D models of heroes fleshed with exquisite details. Top-tier motion and facial capture technologies make your heroes incredibly vivid and lifelike.With premium CG and character designs in 360°, players will fall in love with customized animations which bring each hero to life.
2. Experience 100+ heroes to collect and upgrade!
Unlock and augment 100+ unique heroes from 30+ races and eight factions, forming a powerful team to resist an onslaught of countless monsters and demons. Every hero is worth upgrading, and collecting heroes of the same faction significantly impacts a battle.
3. Refreshingly diverse RPG elements.
Obtain rare resources from dungeon levels where gruesome monsters await. Strengthen and improve your hero's attributes by collecting gear, artifacts, and legendary skill dust to get the edge.Reinforce your camp and explore multiple game modes while leading your heroes to ultimate victory on the grandest battlefield of all.
4. User friendly and deeply strategic gameplay.
The diverse continent of Tya includes vast deserts, chilling dungeons, colossal mountains and more. With each stage posing new challenges, commanders must choose the best faction and hero combinations to survive. Charge into battle with your fearless heroes and activate their ultimate skills, AOE/magic damage, and healing spells with precision timing to defend your position!
5. Grand worldview, rich storylines.
Explore a range of chapters, maps, and levels. Epic faction and hero lore will provide you an immersive experience into the world of Tya’s magic. Each hero has a unique backstory waiting for you to discover!
6. More exciting BOSS battles.
Team up with guild partners to challenge the epic dragon and rush to the top of guild rankings.
7. Massive multiplayer PvP battles.
Original tower defense PvP mode will showcase your skills. With multiple PvP themes, you can climb player rankings and fight your way straight to the top!
Official Website: www.watcherofrealms.com/zh/

4. Rich materials and resource to be collected and processed

Lead your exclusive team to live and fight in the difficult and dangerous environments with your unique and extraordinary leadership skills!

bluejetty:00025384:ios.summary:

HOMEPAGE DASHBOARD
Your personalized home
bluejetty:00025384:ios.description:
Introducing a new travel resource for planning and booking personal ferry travel. Book sailings, manage your trips, and check schedules and current conditions in a flash with the BC Ferries app.
HOMEPAGE DASHBOARD
Your personalized home screen features an at-a-glance view of your upcoming bookings, travel preferences, deals and offers and more.
TRAVEL PREFERENCES
Get quick access to schedules, current conditions and a faster booking experience on your frequently travelled routes by setting up travel preferences. Give your travel preferences nicknames, set departure and arrival terminals and add passenger and vehicle details on bookable routes.
BOOK AND MANAGE YOUR FERRY TRAVEL
Make your booking experience easier with personalized travel preferences. Quickly jump to the next available sailing with the new Express book feature, and change or cancel existing bookings on-the-go.
SEAMLESS CHECK-IN AT THE TERMINAL
Get quick access to your upcoming trips right from your home screen for seamless check-in with the app at the terminal.
SCHEDULES
Plan your trip with confidence with enhanced features on daily and seasonal schedules for all BC Ferries routes. Easily check sailing times for your favourite routes with travel preferences, and book directly from the schedules pages for bookable routes. Daily schedules now show the next sailing being ticketed and estimated deck space available.
CURRENT CONDITIONS
Route sailing status and estimated deck space are now easier to check with the updated Current Conditions layout. Travel preferences make it easier to find your frequently traveled routes, check which sailing is being ticketed, and view status of upcoming sailings.
ALERTS
Never miss any updates on the routes that matter the most to you. Opt-in to receive timely push notifications for service notices and upcoming booking reminders on your device.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES AVAILABLE
• Foot passenger bookings
• Request accessibility products: boarding assistance, wheelchair at the terminal
Note: Tablet landscape view is currently not supported in the app. If you are using a tablet, use the app in portrait view only.
VISIT BCFERRIES.COM TO ACCESS THE FOLLOWING FEATURES
• Booking BC Ferries Vacations packages
• Commercial vehicle bookings
• Group bookings of 10 or more passengers
• To create an account

bluejetty:00116605:ios.description:
Race through Heartlake City with the LEGO® Friends and their pets! Play as Aliya, Autumn, Nova, Leo, Liann, and more. Customize rides, collect treasures, and dodge obstacles! 
Collect and customize with the LEGO® Friends in Heartlake City! Drive through the colorful streets with your favorite characters and their adorable pets. 
• Dodge traffic, roadblocks, and surprises on thrilling missions! 
• Collect coins, ice cream, fruit, flowers, gifts, and more cute surprises! 
• Customize your cars with cool colors, decals, tires, toppers, and trails! 
• Complete exciting missions to unlock amazing rewards and level up! 
• Earn daily rewards to keep the fun going! 
• Transform your car into a jet with Zobo the robot! 
• Unlock new LEGO® Friends characters, each with their unique pet! 
• Mix and match characters and custom cars for endless fun! 
Race, explore, and discover a world full of adventure with LEGO® Friends! 
FEATURES
• Safe and age-appropriate
• Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age
• No third-party advertising
SUPPORT
For any questions or assistance, please reach out to us at support@storytoys.com.

Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.
PRIVACY & TERMS
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy.
Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms/

bluejetty:00123634:ios.description:
Welcome to The Velvet Room!
The Velvet Room™ loyalty program is all about making your life easier while earning free stuff just for eating tacos. You’ll earn points with every purchase and get rewarded with free tacos, swag, and experiences.
App Features Include:
1. EXCLUSIVE REWARDS & OFFERS: Unlock a world of exclusive rewards and offers that are only available through our app.
2. EFFORTLESS MOBILE ORDERING & PAYMENT: Skip the lines and order ahead with just a few taps. Choose your preferred dining method - whether it's dine-in, take-out, or delivery.
3. EARN REWARDS: Make every taco count, download the Velvet Taco app and start earning points on every purchase and redeem them in our Rewards Marketplace.
4. QUICK REORDER OF YOUR FAVORITES: Have a go-to order? Easily access your previous orders and quickly reorder your favorites.
5. GIVE SHOUT OUTS & FEEDBACK: Share your thoughts and experiences with us. Rate your recent orders with a simple tap and give us valuable feedback to help us improve.
Terms and conditions apply.
A little bit about us…Velvet Taco is set out to elevate the taco through globally inspired recipes and the freshest ingredients. Visit us to find a sampling of international tastes and inventive combinations, delivering flavors that are as memorable as they are delicious. And never forget about the Weekly Taco Feature (a.k.a. the WTF) where we introduce a new taco each week. To get to know us better, visit www.velvettaco.com and follow us on Facebook and Instagram.

bluejetty:00145136:ios.description:
Lasoo helps Australians save time and money. By providing a single platform to discover, compare and buy the top deals from Australia’s best retailers - including BigW, Coles, Woolworths, Toymate, Carlton & United Breweries (CUB), Pillow Talk, Shiels, Camera House, Autobarn, and Stratco and exclusive retailers such as BBQ Galore, Lincraft, Chemist Warehouse, and Direct Chemist Outlet – we’ll help you save time and time again.
With a wide range of daily catalogues and promotions across Beauty, appliances, toys, health, fashion, pets, furniture, homewares, baby, electronics, groceries, sports, office, games, automotive, tools, photography and more, Lasoo empowers Australian shoppers with all the information needed to make better shopping decisions.
Don’t pay fool price. Whatever you’re looking for, try and Lasoo it (on special) first.
Our new platform provides an easy & interactive experience with helpful features to make shopping specials easier such as: 
- Location based searches: so you can find specials available to you
- Wishlist: to follow and track the products you love when they come on special
- Alerts: which let you know when your favourite products are on sale or reminds you before they come off
- Filters: so you can see specials by category, price range, retailer and even brand
- Discovery: browse digital catalogues and promotions to discover and shop the top specials form Australia’s best retailers
- Comparison: specials from across retailers to make sure you’re getting the best deal 
We’re motivated by our goal to provide our users with the most frictionless specials shopping experience available. Driven by our core beliefs of honesty, transparency and value, we endeavour to be the trusted source for all your specials shopping needs and help you save on the products you love. 
Join us on our quest for shopping empowerment!

bluejetty:00180665:ios.summary: O Super App é a solução definitiva para a gestão de pessoas e controle de ponto, combinando as funcionalidades da Sólides em uma única plataforma poderosa. Ideal para empresas que buscam eficiência e inovação na administração de recursos hu
bluejetty:00180665:ios.description:
O Super App é a solução definitiva para a gestão de pessoas e controle de ponto, combinando as funcionalidades da Sólides em uma única plataforma poderosa. Ideal para empresas que buscam eficiência e inovação na administração de recursos humanos, o Super App oferece uma experiência integrada e intuitiva para colaboradores e gestores.
Funcionalidades Principais:
Gestão de Desempenho e Talentos
Avaliação de Desempenho: Realize avaliações de desempenho periódicas com feedbacks estruturados, metas claras e acompanhamento de resultados.
Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI): Crie e acompanhe planos de desenvolvimento personalizados para cada colaborador, promovendo crescimento e evolução dentro da empresa.
Matriz de Competências: Mapeie as competências dos seus colaboradores, identifique os gaps e crie estratégias de desenvolvimento eficazes.
Controle de Ponto Simplificado
Registro de Ponto Digital: Permita que seus colaboradores registrem seu ponto de forma rápida e segura através de reconhecimento facial ou por geolocalização.
Relatórios de Ponto: Acesse relatórios detalhados de horas trabalhadas, faltas, atrasos e horas extras em tempo real.
Aprovações e Ajustes: Gestores podem aprovar ou ajustar registros de ponto diretamente no app, facilitando a gestão do dia a dia.
Comunicação e Engajamento
Feed de Notícias: Mantenha sua equipe informada com um feed de notícias corporativas, atualizações e comunicados importantes.
Pesquisas: Realize pesquisas de clima organizacional para entender o nível de satisfação dos seus colaboradores e identificar áreas de melhoria.
Benefícios do Super App:
Eficiência e Agilidade: Centralize todas as operações de RH em uma única plataforma, economizando tempo e recursos.
Acesso Remoto: Com o Super App, colaboradores e gestores podem acessar informações importantes de qualquer lugar, a qualquer hora.
Segurança de Dados: Todos os dados são protegidos com criptografia avançada, garantindo a segurança e privacidade das informações da sua empresa.
Transforme a maneira como você gerencia seu time com o Super App. Experimente a combinação perfeita de funcionalidades de controle de ponto e gestão de pessoas em um único aplicativo inovador.
Baixe agora e descubra a revolução na gestão de recursos humanos!

bluejetty:00163966:ios.summary:

Play content fr
bluejetty:00163966:ios.description:
Smart View App Lets you enjoy multimedia content from your mobile and PC on your Smart TV as well as letting you control the Smart TV with your mobile. With Smart View you can easy to watch your favorite content on your TV.
Play content from your mobile
TV Assist, easy to connect your mobile to the TV and select videos, pictures, or even music. Your content will instantly play on the Smart View TV Cast.
Create Playlists
Create personalized playlists to access all of your favorite videos, photos, and music in one place.
Play content from your PC
Add content files or even a whole folder from your PC into Smart View, and play everything on the list in one go!
Features
• Smart Things Smart View App
• Mirror Smart View, Allshare, Allcast
• Phone screen on a large smart TV
• Support for all media files, pictures, videos, etc.
• Cast media files and mirror screen to TV and Windows
• Screen Mirroring - Smart Share - TV
• Cast photos, music & videos to Chromecast
• Cast To TV: Screen Mirroring for Smart TV
• Control your Remote, Smart Remote
• Watch your movies on Chromecast TV
• Easy to connect from the Smart Share App
How to use Mirroring
1. Make sure your phone/tablet and smart TV are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
2. Enable “Wireless display” on your phone.
3. Enable “Miracast” on your smart TV.
4. Search and pair the device.
SmartThings
With Smart View, you can cast your photos on your TV. Easy cast music from your Chromecast app to your Smart TV. Cast your camera video to your TV screen! Smart share app for all smart TVs. Stream the phone's camera to Chromecast.
Smart Things Smart View app is the best smart view app. By using the SmartThings app, Smart View is a free screen mirroring, with Castto you can broadcast any files to your Smart TV. With SmartShare you can make screen mirroring of any photos, video files, audio, and other content to your Smart TV in real-time and without any delay.
Smart View Smart TV enables you to cast images, videos, and music to all TV or other DLNA Devices. With a smart TV cast, you can stream any content to your device. Smart Share is a screen casting that allows you to easily open any media on the big screen, including mobile games, photos, music, videos, and e-books.
With TV Cast you can control what you watch on your TV without interrupting the playback. Smart View's interface is pretty simple, designed so you never lose sight of whatever you're watching at that moment. All you have to do is connect your TV and smart device to the same network. After that, you're ready to start controlling playback.
All Screen Mirroring App smart view TV screen mirroring assistant for screencasting, Cast Phone to TV with Wi-Fi. Smart Share is the perfect casting app for all smart TVs without Wi-Fi just by using dongles or adaptors. SmartShare provides phone to TV, cast To TV, and TV mirror, all connected with the smart cast.
Smart View Screen Mirroring - use the Costo feature from supported applications. Smart View Free App is able to play games and videos with a screen mirror. Smart View - Cast Phone to TV based on Miracast TV mirror technology is your best choice!

bluejetty:00039474:ios.description:
نهدف في ضوء الخريج بمساعدة الطلاب على اختيار تخصصاتهم الجامعية وفق رغباتهم وإمكانيتهم وتحديد مسارهم المهني بثقة ووعي. 
كيف يساعدك ضوء الخريج؟
 • تعرف أكثر على التخصصات (240+ تخصص) والجامعات (+30 جهة تعليمية). 
 • معلومات تفصیلیة لکل تخصص، مثل: نبذة تعريفية، عدد سنوات الدراسة، المجالات الوظيفية، الخطة الدراسیة، النسبة المطلوبة، شروط القبول، مقر التخصص.
 • حاسبة النسبة الموزونة. يمكنك حساب نسبتك الموزونة حسب متطلبات التخصص المحدد. قارن بين نسب القبول المطلوبة للجامعات، مع إمكانية حفظ حسبتك والرجوع إليها في أي وقت. 
 • مرشد مهني ذكي وسريع. مطور باستخدام أحدث تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي؛ يعطيك وصف للوظائف والمتطلبات التعليمية لها، يعرفك على المهام المطلوبة في العمل، والجدارات السلوكية والفنية للنجاح في الوظيفة.
 • مقارنة تفصيلية بين أهم التخصصات اللي في بالك لتحديد أي التخصصات هو الأنسب لك. 
 • مواعيد التقديم على الفرص التعليمية. يمكنك معرفة التواريخ المهمة لبداية ونهاية التقديم، رابط التقديم. يمكن أيضا تفعيل التنبيه للحصول على تذكير بموعد التقديم. 
فريق ضوء الخريج يعمل على مميزات أخرى لخدمة الطلاب الغالين، خلك قريب!

bluejetty:00183076:ios.description:
Bridge Constructor Medieval has been voted as one of the "Best of 2014" games in the App Store in 13 countries!
Dive into the Middle Ages and play the successor to the worldwide #1 hit, Bridge Constructor
Bridge Constructor Medieval turns back the clock a few centuries to the time of knights and castles. Build sturdy bridges to supply your city with provisions - or cunningly constructed bridges that collapse under the weight of attacking troops, sending the horde of enemies into the abyss below. You won’t even be safe from cannon fire in the 40 brand new levels. Protect your foot soldiers and your horse-drawn carriages with covered bridges and stable pillar structures. 
There are a total of five materials available to help you build the perfect bridge: wood, heavy wood, stone and ropes, along with the new addition of the bridge roof.
The exciting background story allows you to familiarize yourself with the various materials on a step by step basis, and learn everything you need to know so that your bridges meet the requirements of the different levels. 
Innovative game modes in store for you!
Besides building stable bridges, there's also plenty on offer for veterans to discover in the new game modes. 
In the siege level, your bridge is bombarded by enemy catapults. Strengthen your bridge so that it doesn't collapse, and protect your own troops on the bridge with a bridge roof. 
In another new game mode, you build your bridges so that they collapse under the load of enemy units to send as many of them as possible into the abyss. 
In addition, the unique bonus challenges will leave even the most experienced players at their wit’s end. That way, both bridge-building professionals and novices will face a challenge in Bridge Constructor Medieval.

- For the first time: Build bridges in the Middle Ages!
- Brand new levels and game modes for a completely new gaming experience
- Design sturdy bridge roofs to protect yourself from enemy catapults

- Exciting and funny background story
- Enjoy beautiful medieval landscapes
- Game Center Achievements and rankings
- iCloud implementation to have game progress available across different devices

bluejetty:00175641:ios.description:
A simple tool for background removal that makes your pictures look free from imperfections does exist. Background Studio is designed to help you delete the background that ruins your image. Use the app in different ways. You can make a transparent background, remove the existing one and add something else, or even erase the background to boost your sales with seamlessly looking product images. Whichever goal you have, Background Studio has everything you need to transform your picture.
Here is a short overview of all tools you get from downloading the app:
• Cutout tool. This is the very essence of the app. We made sure the entire background removal mechanism works in a convenient and fast way. Just select the unneeded area that you want to erase and make it transparent in one simple click.
• White and solid background. Minimalism is truly timeless. You can delete the existing background and add white background or the one with any solid color instead.
• Background templates. In case you need not only to remove the background but also to change it into something better, we prepared the background gallery with various templates so that you can pick the one that fits your picture most.
• Shadows & Outlines. Apart from the background cut-out, you can also add shadows to the necessary object or outline it. Adjust shadow intensity, the thickness of the outline, and the degree of the object opacity easily. Highlight important aspects to help the image look outstanding.
• Stickers & Fonts. Looking for something less boring than just a minimalistic background? We added stickers and a variety of fonts to choose from so you can adorn your image and make it stand out. 
Simple yet efficient — this is the best way to describe Background Studio. Besides, the app is perfect not only for social media lovers but for retailers as well. In case you sell products via popular marketplaces such as Amazon, Shopify, or any other online store, you can easily create great product images in just a few simple steps. Use all tools it offers to remove far from a perfect background and make the image look truly flawless. 
Don’t forget to check our privacy policy and terms of service:
https://yalex.org/terms.html
https://yalex.org/privacy.html
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
• Subscription for Background Studio AI for full access to all features.
• Subscription length: one week, one month, 12 months and lifetime.
• Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
• Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00137023:ios.description:
CREATE YOUR ULTIMATE THEME PARK
Welcome to Roller Coaster Life, where the excitement of building your dream theme park awaits! Become the ultimate theme park tycoon and craft an amusement wonderland that will delight visitors from every corner of the globe. Prepare for a journey filled with fun, strategy, and boundless creativity.
ENJOY ANYWHERE, ANYTIME
Experience the thrill of Roller Coaster Life: Theme Park without the need for an internet connection! Construct your perfect park from any location, whether you're at home or on the go.
EXPAND YOUR PARK EMPIRE
Starting with a vast, empty land and building it to a bustling paradise, the power is in your hands. Select from a variety of captivating themes like Spooky, Sci-Fi Galaxy, Wild West, and more. Design rollercoasters, pathways, cultivate greenery, and build themed zones that will enchant your guests.
THRILLING COASTERS AWAIT!
Choose from a diverse array of rollercoasters, ranging from heart-stopping adventures to gentle rides suitable for all ages. Rollercoasters are the stars of your park, enhancing nearby attractions and facilities for maximum enjoyment! We are curious what will be your favorite rollercoaster.
 DELIGHT YOUR GUESTS BY MANAGING THEIR NEEDS
Ensure a memorable experience for your visitors by addressing their needs and desires. From hunger and thirst to excitement and queasiness, provide amenities like restaurants, beverage stands, and rest areas to keep everyone happy.
MASTER PARK MANAGEMENT
Effective management is the cornerstone of success in the theme park world. Maintain your rides, monitor popularity, and increase revenue to keep your park thriving. Don't forget to ensure your infrastructure is powered and your guests are content!
CONQUER CHALLENGES
Face a variety of challenges and milestones that will test your managerial prowess. Overcoming these hurdles unlocks special rewards, enriching your gameplay experience with new opportunities.
JOIN EXCITING EVENTS
Stay engaged with frequent updates and seasonal events, each introducing fresh themes, exclusive rides, and thrilling challenges. Keep your park ahead of the curve by participating in these dynamic activities.
CONNECT WITH FRIENDS
Add friends, explore their parks, and share ideas to elevate your own. Engage in friendly competition as you strive to create the ultimate theme park and climb the global leaderboards.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR PARK
Dive deep into customization options by upgrading rides, designing layouts, and adding decorative elements. Craft a theme park that reflects your unique style and vision down to the smallest detail.
IMMERSIVE YOURSELF IN THE STORY
Embark on captivating story chapters and challenge yourself to earn incredible rewards. Let the immersive simulation experience guide you on your journey to becoming a top-tier park manager!
START YOUR ADVENTURE NOW
Don't miss out on the excitement! Begin your Roller Coaster Life journey today and let the fun begin!
Download Roller Coaster Life: Theme Park now and dive into the thrill of building your own theme park empire!

bluejetty:00016713:ios.description:
Using the Magic Call App you can make fun calls, prank your friends, and surprise your friends on call. MagicCall lets you change your voice during phone calls in real-time. You may want to call in a female voice, or the voice of a male, a kid, or even a cartoon character, this app is there for you.
Our voice changing effects and background sounds like traffic noise and birthday song can fake the whole environment of the call. Once you choose the background effect, anyone you call will believe that you are trapped in a traffic jam, enjoying a concert or you can wish your friend with the birthday song background.
“The funniest and smoothest way to ask a girl out!”
The sound emoticons feature of MagicCalls works in real time during a phone call. We have sound emoticons like kiss, slap, clap, fart, and many more emojis that give extra effects to your calls to make your friends laugh out loud or maybe blush. Any call can become magic by choosing a unique combination of voice or background and sound emojis!
“MagicCall’s traffic noise helps me make excuses to my boss whenever I am running late”
“Wishing people on their birthdays is a hit with MagicCall’s birthday background!”
“Pranked my classmates by sounding like my professor! Total chaos!”
With MagicCall, making your call enjoyable, increase the joy of speaking to a friend or loved one. It is not only a voice changer for calls, but a bucket full of fun with our female voice changer, AI robot voice, kid voice that not only allows you to select and speak in a funny voice but also gives you the freedom to switch your voice during the call. MagicCall generates a human voice for any character you select and surprises the call receiver.
“Thank you Magic Call! You made me the best parodist ever.”
Features of Magic Call App - Voice changer during call 
1. Enjoy a REAL-TIME voice changer on call. Use female voice changer, kid voice changer, cartoon voice changer, etc.
2. Switch between voices during the call
3. Earn FREE credits on first-time registration
4. Test your voice before making the call 
5. The cheapest way to make a funny call
6. Play sound emoticons like kiss, clap, etc. during the call
7. Make funny international calls for nominal rates
Voices and Backgrounds available on MagicCall:
1. Male to female voice changer
2. Female to male voice changer
3. Kid voice changer
4. Grandpa voice changer
5. Robot voice changer
6. Rain background
7. Concert background
8. Birthday Song
9. Traffic Background
10. RaceCar Background
11. Mountain Background
How to make a call using Magic Call Voice Changer:
1. Select a voice type: Male, Female, Cartoon, or others. Alternatively, pick a background theme: Happy Birthday song, Traffic, Raining Background, or Music Concert.
2. Choose the person you want to laugh with by selecting a contact or dialing a specific number.
3. Initiate the call using Magic Call Voice Changer.
4. Once connected, your voice will change into the selected voice or background theme.
5. Use any of our sound emojis to add extra fun to your call
6. Have a blast listening to your friend’s unexpected and funny reactions!
About In-app Purchases:
To further enjoy our service, choose from any of our weekly, monthly or quarterly subscriptions. 
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. There are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. 
In case, you exhaust the calling credits before the subscription period gets over, you can opt for our non-renewal top-ups. You can choose from our Mini, Super & Bumper packs. The pricing for non-renewal top-ups starts at $0.99. 
Privacy policy: http://app.magiccall.co/privacy.html
Terms of use: http://app.magiccall.co/termsofuse.html

bluejetty:00018907:ios.description:
Beat Street is the first beat 'em up with intuitive single touch controls and is a love letter to the 90s beat 'em up genre! 
Evil gangs are terrorizing Toko City and the citizens need your help! Fight your way through hordes of enemies and become the new hero in town. 
Features:
• Online co-op mode: up to 2 players!
• Story driven gameplay
• Simple controls - anyone can play a beat 'em up! 
• Unlock fighters with unique martial art skills
• Gorgeous handcrafted pixel art
• Retro music by Maxo
• iPhone X support 
We recommend iPhone 5S or higher for an optimal experience.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
V.I.P Elite Fighter Subscription offers a weekly subscription, you will have a 3-days FREE trial period, after this period you will be charged $5.99. After buying this subscription, you will unlock following features: Gem & Coin Rewards, No forced in-game advertisements, and all available VIP characters for the duration of the subscription.. This is an Auto-renewable subscription. Payment will be charged to your Apple App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hours before the period ends. Your account will be charged for renewal as well. You can turn it off in your account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be fortfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
• This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
• Payment will also be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of the free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling trial or subscription:
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes account. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period cannot be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use elements offered in your chosen Subscription Option.
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at support@lucky-kat.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.lucky-kat.com/games-privacy-notice/

Your story lives in the Opelika-Auburn News. From reporting on all of your favorite teams to the news that matters most in the community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from the area and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts.
Plus, subscribers have the ability to upgrade to News+, our premium ad-free experience! That means faster-loading pages and an uninterrupted reading experience. 
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right.
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Follow author – get notifications whenever your favorite writers post a story
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access

Have you ever thought about hunting down the very legend of cryptozoology? Sasquatch, or Bigfoot, has stirred the consciousness of mankind since the end of the last century, but still could not get into the hands of scientists.
Now, after all these years, Sasquatch has been spotted in the snow forests of Alaska. Should you miss the chance to become the most famous hunter in the world?

The game features:
- exciting chase after the Sasquatch with a dog;
- unique winter hunting atmosphere;
- crisp graphics;
- AI weapon customization.
Enjoy thrilling Bigfoot hunts, three rifles, a stunning winter location, a loyal husky companion, numerous quests & achievements in the free version. Load your tranquilizer gun, feed your loyal dog, and venture forth towards the eternal glory of Sasquatch hunting!

bluejetty:00092476:ios.name: Gorilla Car Wash
bluejetty:00092476:ios.summary: Since 1991, locally-owned and operated Gorilla Car Wash has always been committed to providing a clean, dry and shiny car with exceptional customer service every time you visit one of our 11 metro-area locations. We pride ourselves on bein
bluejetty:00092476:ios.description:
Since 1991, locally-owned and operated Gorilla Car Wash has always been committed to providing a clean, dry and shiny car with exceptional customer service every time you visit one of our 11 metro-area locations. We pride ourselves on being selected as the best car wash option year after year.
We now offer two unlimited-wash membership options:
Multi-Car Family Membership: Our new multi-car family membership option provides multiple washes for multiple vehicles. With our new app-based family membership you receive one wash per day to wash any car. Wash one car one day and another family vehicle on a different day. This new phone-based mobile app simply improves our already exceptional service and advances our commitment to always provide more. 
Single Car Membership: If you only have one vehicle, Gorilla continues to offer a single-car membership that provides one wash per day, every day, at a slightly lower price. The single car membership, which requires a barcode sticker on your windshield, can be purchased for any vehicle. This is the preferred option for commercial and fleet operations.
Wash Options: Gorilla offers a variety of wash options but we highly recommend “The Works” for a clean and shiny car front to back, top to bottom.
Easy to Find: Our eleven locations – four in Council Bluffs and seven in Omaha – are spread across the metro area providing a location close and convenient for you. 
Always Open: Open 24-hours a day, we’re ready whenever you’re ready, day or night.
Getting started is super easy. Simply download the new red and yellow Gorilla Car Wash app and complete the easy-to-follow purchase instructions. There’s no one to call, you do everything on your personal phone. You can cancel your membership at any time by simply opening your Gorilla Car Wash app. 
Gorilla offers all the above and more. So, get started now and we’ll see you, and everyone in your family, driving clean and shiny cars!

bluejetty:00065925:ios.description:
How far can you go before the drop?
Dead Slope 3D is a straightforward, high-speed runner where your reflexes are the only thing keeping you on the track. No complicated menus or confusing upgrades—just you, a ball, and a steep midnight descent through a neon city.
Master the Tilt and screen touch
The controls are as simple as it gets: tilt your phone or screen touch to steer. But don’t let the simplicity fool you. As the speed picks up, dodging obstacles requires precise timing and a steady hand. One wrong move and it’s game over.
Why you’ll keep playing:
- Pure Reflex Gameplay: No fluff, just fast-paced slope racing 3d action.
- Stunning 3D Visuals: Race through a stylized midnight city environment.
- Infinite Challenges: The further you go, the harder the slope run becomes.
- Global Competition: See how your skills stack up on the world leaderboards.
- Pick Up and Play: Perfect for quick sessions or long marathons.
Join the Leaderboard
Dead Slope 3D isn’t just about survival; it’s about dominance. Practice your lines, learn the patterns, and beat your friends' high scores. This ball slope game is designed for players who love a "just one more try" challenge.
Think you have the focus to reach the top of the rankings in Dead Slope 3D?

bluejetty:00141168:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00141168:ios.description:
Start tracking followers, unfollowers, and see who doesn't follow you back with UnfollowGram. Download, check in, and the app begins tracking, so you can see who unfollowed you over time and understand your account like never before.
FOLLOWER TRACKER & REPORTS
UnfollowGram is a follower tracker app that compares your followers list between check-ins and highlights what has changed. You can see:
• Who is not following you back
• Who unfollowed you since your last check-in
• New followers gained between sessions
• Lost followers over time
• Ghost followers with zero interaction
• Accounts engaging without following you
The app does not show past unfollowers from before your first check-in. Tracking begins when you start using the app.
RECENT FOLLOW TRACKER
UnfollowGram includes a recent follow tracker that shows who you recently followed and who recently followed you. Recent follow data is based on comparing publicly available following lists between check-ins. You can use recent follow tracking to monitor activity, discover new accounts, or simply stay informed.
UNFOLLOW CHECK & REPORTS
The unfollow checker compares your current followers to previous check-ins. If an account disappears from your followers list, UnfollowGram flags it. Reports include follower and unfollower counts, not-following-back lists, mutual followers, and engagement breakdowns.
This Instagram follower tracker app goes beyond simple numbers. UnfollowGram provides clear reports and visual breakdowns, including:
• Mutual followers and verified followers
• Audience composition and historical growth trends
• Engagement activity summaries
• Who unfollowed me: tracked between sessions
All insights are generated by comparing account data across multiple sessions.
HOW FOLLOWER TRACKER WORKS
1. Open UnfollowGram and check in
2. The app saves a snapshot of your followers and following
3. Check in again later (hours or days)
4. UnfollowGram compares the two snapshots and shows what changed
5. Repeat to build a full history of follower changes over time
Follower tracking works by comparison, not by real-time monitoring. Results depend on how often you check in.
LIMITATIONS

bluejetty:00069391:ios.name: NowPlaying: Music Discovery
bluejetty:00069391:ios.summary:
Music, made more fun. Find records you'd never have run into on your own, then learn everything about them. Who played bass, where it was recorded, what it samples.
Featured on TechCrunch, MacRumors, iMore, 9to5Mac, DailyTekk, BGR, and mor
bluejetty:00069391:ios.description:
Music, made more fun. Find records you'd never have run into on your own, then learn everything about them. Who played bass, where it was recorded, what it samples.
Featured on TechCrunch, MacRumors, iMore, 9to5Mac, DailyTekk, BGR, and more.
● Who it's for
Anyone who wants to hear more new music, and know more about the music they already love.
• Anyone hunting for their next favourite album, not another playlist
• People who want a new record to try every day
• Everyone who hears a great song and needs to know more, right now
• Crate diggers and collectors who read every sleeve
• Apple Music and Last.fm fans who keep track of what they play
• Vinyl fans who want a proper display for the record that's spinning
● See more of your music
SongDisplay turns your iPhone or iPad into a display for whatever's playing. Artwork, facts, and the story behind the song, updating as the music changes. Prop it up next to the turntable and let it run.
• Album art or artist art, full screen
• Kiosk Mode hides the buttons so only the music shows
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• Send it to a TV or monitor over AirPlay
• Every session saved, so you can find that one song again
• Read great insights about the song that’s playing
● Skip the algorithm
A new Album of the Day, picked for the genres you actually listen to. Swipe through Album Discovery to find records nothing else would serve you, drawn from the Rolling Stone 500, 1001 Albums, the Apple Music Top 100, new releases, and your own library. Read Pitchfork reviews and Bandcamp Daily picks in the same place, plus music books worth reading. Come back tomorrow for the next one.
● Know the whole story
Liner notes, verified facts, band members, samples and the songs they came from, awards, recording locations on a map, photography, set lists from the tour, and full lyrics. Translate any of it into your language, or let Song Story read it aloud.
● Find any song
Catch what's playing around you with Shazam. Scan the barcode on a CD or record. Photograph an album cover to identify it. Point Visual Intelligence at a sleeve. Or search all of Apple Music.
● Keep it all together
Save songs to Favourites and to your Apple Music library or a playlist. Scrobble to Last.fm. Add records to Discogs and songs to MusicThread. See your rated albums, On Repeat, and Heavy Rotation in one place. Build your Best of the year list and share it as an image.
Open anything in Apple Music, Spotify, Tidal, YouTube Music, Deezer, Amazon Music, or Pandora.
● Everywhere you listen
Five Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Control Center controls for listening, playing today's album, and scanning, plus Siri Shortcuts and Handoff between devices. NowPlaying also runs on Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro, in the same download.
● NowPlaying Gold
No ads, Last.fm scrobbling, your full search and SongDisplay history, extra details like awards and band members, Kiosk Mode, and app icons you unlock by listening and exploring. NowPlaying works without it. Gold makes it better and keeps it going.
Terms of use: https://nowplaying.page/terms
Privacy policy: https://nowplaying.page/privacy

bluejetty:00115098:ios.description:
Turn your ideas into videos and drop yourself into the action.
Sora is a new kind of creative app that turns text prompts and images into hyperreal videos with sound using the latest advancements from OpenAI. A single sentence can unfold into a cinematic scene, an anime short, or remix of a friend's video. If you can write it, you can see it, remix it, and share it. Turn your words into worlds with Sora.
Explore, play, and share your imagination in a community built for experimentation.
What’s possible with Sora
Create Videos in Seconds
Start with a prompt or image and Sora generates a complete video with audio inspired by your imagination.
Collaborate & Play
Cast yourself or your friends in videos. Remix challenges and trends as they evolve.
Choose Your Style
Make it cinematic, animated, photorealistic, cartoon, or entirely surreal.
Remix & Make It Yours
Take someone else’s creation and put your spin on it - swap characters, change the vibe, add new scenes, or extend the story.
Find Your Community
Community features make it easy to share your creations and see what others are making.
