bluejetty:00144645:ios.description:
Discover the convenience of managing multiple phone numbers with Text Call. Whether for business, travel, or everyday communication, Text Call provides additional phone numbers to help you organize your personal and professional conversations in one place.
Choose from over 60 area codes and activate local numbers in minutes. Stay connected through calling and messaging without the need for extra devices or complex phone plans.
Key Highlights:
Multiple Phone Numbers: Easily manage separate lines for work, business, or personal organization.
Flexible Plans: Choose options that fit your short-term or long-term communication needs.
Easy Setup: Simple and intuitive interface for quick activation and management.
Privacy Focused: Keep your primary number separate when communicating with clients, marketplaces, or new contacts.
Global Connectivity: Make and receive calls internationally using Wi-Fi or mobile data.
Top Use Cases:
Business & Freelancing: Manage customer communication from one device.
Travel Communication: Stay reachable while abroad.
Online Marketplaces: Separate buyer and seller communication.
Everyday Organization: Keep work and personal calls organized.
App Features:
- Access over 60 area codes.
- Call and message from additional numbers.
- Manage multiple lines in one app.
- Works on Wi-Fi or mobile data.
Subscription Details: 
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The user can manage subscriptions by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Important:
Text Call is a subscription-based app, please review our pricing before purchasing. Text Call does not support emergency calling (911).

bluejetty:00040574:ios.name: CAG in Images
bluejetty:00040574:ios.summary: The Picture Exhibition of the Appearance and Work of Almighty God is an online exhibition that has been carefully created to give those who wish to seek and explore the true way a deeper understanding of the return of the Lord Jesus—of the
bluejetty:00040574:ios.description:
The Picture Exhibition of the Appearance and Work of Almighty God is an online exhibition that has been carefully created to give those who wish to seek and explore the true way a deeper understanding of the return of the Lord Jesus—of the appearance and work of Almighty God, Christ of the last days. This app features everything from the exhibition and delivers it in an easy-to-use mobile format. The exhibition brings together hundreds of hand-drawn artworks that faithfully and vividly portray each stage of the origins and development of The Church of Almighty God. They include the background to Almighty God's appearance and work, a record of the appearance and work of the incarnate Son of man as it happened among the house churches, the first six steps of Almighty God's work of judgment that began with the house of God, and how the gospel of the kingdom of heaven has spread overseas amidst persecution from the CCP government. Through these images, you will gain an understanding of God's work of purification and salvation during the last days, feel the authority and power of His words, and come to understand God's true love and salvation of mankind during this time.
Why Use CAG in Images?
The app is completely free. Its intuitive, easy-to-use interface allows you to easily browse paintings and audiovisual resources.
The app is clearly organized into different sections of illustrated content that recreate the origins and development of The Church of Almighty God, teaching you about the cherished history of Almighty God's work and words among man.
Users can listen to popular hymns from each stage of God's work. These hymns will give you an in-depth understanding of every detail of God's work and a sense of His love and salvation.
Also included is the entirety of The Word Appears in the Flesh, the millions of words expressed by Almighty God when He appeared and began to work. Reading these words, you can enjoy the rich provision of the life.
Features
Reading settings: The font size of texts can be adjusted for easier reading.
Online chat: Our online chat service is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Please contact us at any time if you would like to find out more about The Church of Almighty God.
Hotline: The Church of Almighty God has churches in 37 countries and regions. You can call the hotline of your local church to seek and explore Almighty God's work of the last days or ask any questions.
Push notifications: Turn on push notifications so you don't miss exciting new content from The Church of Almighty God.

bluejetty:00145884:ios.summary:
Podz is one private place for families and groups to plan together, do more together, and remember it together.
Bring calendars, tasks, conversations, photos, meals, trips and everyday planning into one shared space so everyone knows what’s
bluejetty:00145884:ios.description:
Podz is one private place for families and groups to plan together, do more together, and remember it together.
Bring calendars, tasks, conversations, photos, meals, trips and everyday planning into one shared space so everyone knows what’s happening, who’s going and what comes next.
**EVERYDAY FAMILY & GROUP ORGANIZATION**
Everything your family, friends or group needs to stay connected and organized:
• Share calendars and events with Snapshot, Day, Week, Month and Agenda views. 
• Create to-dos, reminders, shopping lists, packing lists and more. 
• Chat privately with end-to-end encrypted messaging and share photos with the people in your Pod. 
• Create shared photo galleries and collections for trips, events and everyday moments. 
• See where family or group members are at a glance when they choose to share their location. 
• Create polls and make decisions together. 
• Plan meals, save recipes and organize shopping. 
• Keep shared notes, directories and useful information in one place. 
• Translate conversations when language gets in the way. 
• Bring outside calendars into Podz with device calendar sync, calendar subscriptions and imports.
**TRAVEL FROM IDEA TO MEMORY**
Podz goes beyond everyday organization and brings the whole trip together: Discover. Plan. Book. Enjoy.
Not sure where to go? Destination Discovery can suggest places based on your group, dates, budget and interests.
Know where you’re going? Build an itinerary, refine it with Ask Podz, and explore recommendations for places to stay, restaurants, activities and things to see.
Then keep the real trip organized together—with stays, transportation, reservations, activities, expenses, notes, packing lists, photos and more all in one place.
And when the trip is over, your itinerary, conversations, photos and shared photo collections remain part of your Pod’s history.
**ASK PODZ WHEN IT HELPS**
AI is woven thoughtfully into Podz to make planning, discovery, translation and organization easier.
Ask Podz can help discover destinations, build and refine itineraries, find restaurants and activities, organize information, translate conversations and help your group make plans—without taking over the experience.
**PRIVATE GROUPS BY DESIGN**
Every Pod is a private place for the people you invite.
Create separate Pods for your family, friends, trips, teams, clubs, events and other groups—and move easily between them.

listings.name: Podz: Family & Group Organizer
listings.description:
Podz is one private place for families and groups to plan together, do more together, and remember it together.
Bring calendars, tasks, conversations, photos, meals, trips and everyday planning into one shared space so everyone knows what’s happening, who’s going and what comes next.

**EVERYDAY FAMILY & GROUP ORGANIZATION**

Everything your family, friends or group needs to stay connected and organized:

• Share calendars and events with Snapshot, Day, Week, Month and Agenda views.  
• Create to-dos, reminders, shopping lists, packing lists and more.  
• Chat privately with end-to-end encrypted messaging and share photos with the people in your Pod.  
• Create shared photo galleries and collections for trips, events and everyday moments.  
• See where family or group members are at a glance when they choose to share their location.  
• Create polls and make decisions together.  
• Plan meals, save recipes and organize shopping.  
• Keep shared notes, directories and useful information in one place.  
• Translate conversations when language gets in the way.  
• Bring outside calendars into Podz with device calendar sync, calendar subscriptions and imports.

**TRAVEL FROM IDEA TO MEMORY**

Podz goes beyond everyday organization and brings the whole trip together: Discover. Plan. Book. Enjoy.

Not sure where to go? Destination Discovery can suggest places based on your group, dates, budget and interests.

Know where you’re going? Build an itinerary, refine it with Ask Podz, and explore recommendations for places to stay, restaurants, activities and things to see.

Then keep the real trip organized together—with stays, transportation, reservations, activities, expenses, notes, packing lists, photos and more all in one place.

And when the trip is over, your itinerary, conversations, photos and shared photo collections remain part of your Pod’s history.

**ASK PODZ WHEN IT HELPS**

AI is woven thoughtfully into Podz to make planning, discovery, translation and organization easier.

Ask Podz can help discover destinations, build and refine itineraries, find restaurants and activities, organize information, translate conversations and help your group make plans—without taking over the experience.

**PRIVATE GROUPS BY DESIGN**

Every Pod is a private place for the people you invite.

Create separate Pods for your family, friends, trips, teams, clubs, events and other groups—and move easily between them.

Podz is available in English, Spanish, French and German.

**Your people. Your plans. One shared place.**

Life is better together.

Through fun World Music adventures, children master music skills l
bluejetty:00159780:ios.description:
PIANO GAMES FOR KIDS...
Welcome, Little Rock Stars! Learning starts with music. Experience 500+ brain-boosting interactive music learning games designed for kids ages 2-7.
Through fun World Music adventures, children master music skills like piano, rhythm, and composing. The app also teaches early learners about language, cultures, instruments and other amazing things through music and games.
Why Learn Music with Panda Corner?
- Panda Corner is the most easy & fun way to introduce your child to music & piano!
- The earlier kids start learning music, the greater the lifelong cognitive benefits!
- Kids who learn music on average have 25% higher reading & math skills. 
- Music accelerates communication, expression, & social emotional learning.
- World Music gives your child a head start to ace the topics of language, STEAM skills, & cultural learning.
- The secret is: When you learn music, you’re giving your child a great hack to learn faster and remember more!
Some modules of the Panda Corner App include:
Singalong - Fun Music for Kids
Hundreds of songs for kids: nursery rhymes, educational holiday songs, & original kids’ songs. Sing along is a curated center for kids to rap, sing, and dance along to their favorite songs and games.
Piando - Piano Lessons 
Easy & fun piano learning games for toddlers & kids that help master pitch, rhythm, sight-reading, keyboard training & composing in a fun way!
Nursery Rhymes - Song & Games Collection
Sing along to your favorite classic nursery rhymes like: “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star,” “Wheels on the Bus,” and “Row, Row, Row Your Boat.” Develop fundamental music skills in diverse interactive games including: piano, rhythm, and instruments.
Rainbow Notes - Baby Music World
Explore music notes with your magical animal friends and even create your own song! Follow Domi Panda the conductor to learn music patterns in the C major scale.
Globetrotter 
Develop empathy and cultural awareness through World Music games and adventures where your child will learn new vocabulary, instruments, foods, and cultural practices.
The app will allow your kids to become international stars while they make movies in Los Angeles, learn Kung Fu poses in China, and even ride the train through Appalachia, encouraging limitless creativity!
Panda Corner is 100% kid safe so you can be assured your child is in good hands with our friendly animated experts - Sola and Domi Panda, who educate and accompany your kids on their numerous adventures.
Features:
- Original music, animation, and games modes created by Grammy Award winning production studio
- Hours of music, piano games & interactive activities with new content released monthly
- A fun reward system for increased motivation
- Activity, worksheet, and coloring sheet downloads accompany the song lessons
- Play in English or Mandarin Chinese
- Adaptive curriculum to develop pitch, rhythm, and composition skills
- Tempo control
- No ads
How can I get access?
Panda Corner has a free trial to understand its educational benefits, and for your kid to try the music games, after which you can start a monthly subscription. You can also share one Panda Corner subscription with the whole family. 
Subscription Details:
Includes a free 7 day trial
Payment charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to end of current period
User may manage subscriptions & turn off auto-renewal by going to Account Settings after purchase
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to Panda Corner
Join the Panda Corner Band!
Instagram: @pandacornerofficial 
YouTube: youtube.com/pandacorner
Spotify: Panda Corner

bluejetty:00024618:ios.description:
Qfile Pro is a free companion app for QNAP NAS that allows you to browse and manage the files on your NAS using your iPhone or iPad.
Prerequisites:
- iOS 16 or later
- QNAP NAS running QTS 4.0 or later, QuTS hero 4.5.0 or later
Major features of Qfile Pro:
- Access files on your QNAP NAS anytime, anywhere.
- Directly upload photos and documents from your iOS devices to your NAS.
- Easy sharing: Create download links to easily share files via email or SMS, or simply email the file as an attachment.
- Easy management: Move, copy, rename, and delete files on your NAS using your mobile device. No computer required.
- Offline file reading: Download files from your NAS to your iOS device for convenient access when you do not have an Internet connection.
- Auto upload: Automatically upload photos from your device's photo gallery to the NAS. (To ensure that Qfile Pro can continually provide this background service, you must allow the location service - please note that this may noticeably decrease battery life.)
- Qysnc integration: Synchronize files between your mobile device and your QNAP NAS. (Requires QTS 4.3.4/QuTS hero 4.5.0 or later, and Qsync Central to be installed on your QNAP NAS device.)
Other features:
1. Support for displaying files thumbnail.
2. Supports control playback from QNAP NAS to DLNA devices. (requires QNAP Media Server, and QTS 4.0/QuTS hero 4.5.0 or later)
3. Support for file compression. (QTS 4.0/QuTS hero 4.5.0 or later)
Supported Formats:
Photos: BMP, JPG, JPE, PNG, TGA, GIF
Music: MP3, FLAC, OGG, WAV, AIF, AIFF
Videos: AVI, MP4

bluejetty:00164031:ios.description:
SUGAR.FIT IS ON A MISSION TO IMPROVE METABOLIC HEALTH IN INDIA.
Sugarfit is a team of leading diabetologists, endocrinologists & dieticians of India.
Book diabetes, obesity & weight management sessions with Sugarfit experts, including personalised nutrition and lifestyle guidance.
Here’s how we can help you manage diabetes, prediabetes, obesity and improve your metabolic health.
1. Diabetes & Weight Management Program
We help you improve your metabolic health through a comprehensive approach focused on nutrition, lifestyle, fitness and expert medical guidance.
For people using GLP-1 medications for weight management, our program provides support around nutrition, protein intake, physical activity, healthy habits and progress — helping you stay consistent throughout your journey.
2. Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) to track causes of your blood sugar spikes in real time.
We provide biometric feedback through a CGM to show how your blood sugar responds to food, exercise and other lifestyle habits so that you maximise your health and manage your metabolic health better.
This program also focuses on educating individuals on the importance of monitoring blood sugar levels and taking the necessary steps to maintain healthy levels.
3. No Fad dieting. Simple eating
Eating right is far more effective than eating less. Our Doctors and nutrition experts help to craft customised diet plans for diabetes, obesity, weight management and your individual health goals.
4. Most Compassionate Diabetes & Weight Management Experts in India
Our meticulous 5-step selection process followed by a custom training program ensures you are guided by only the best. Our experts provide unmatched individual attention to help you build sustainable healthy habits.
Whether you are managing diabetes, obesity or are on a GLP-1 journey, our experts are there to support you through every stage.
5. Unmatched personalisation
Our evidence-based approach accounts for your personal tastes, lifestyle choices and metabolic condition to deliver precision nutrition, progressive fitness & mindfulness advice.
Our program promotes the importance of exercise, healthy eating habits, adequate protein, stress management, medication adherence where prescribed, and maintaining a positive outlook.
Why Our Program works:
We address the root causes of metabolic health
The root cause of chronic high blood sugar is often linked to metabolic dysfunction and insulin resistance. Our science-backed approach focuses on improving metabolic health through personalised nutrition, fitness and lifestyle interventions, alongside appropriate medical care.
Our pioneering approach
Our approach brings together nutrition, fitness and behavioural support to help improve metabolic health, support healthy weight management and promote sustainable lifestyle changes.
For people using GLP-1 medications, we complement medical treatment with personalised support around nutrition, protein, fitness, lifestyle and progress.
Diabetes & Weight Management by Precision Nutrition
Our unique nutritional guidelines help support healthy blood sugar and weight management while allowing people to eat to satisfaction and avoiding fad diets.
This application is intended to provide valuable information to manage your Type-2 Diabetes, Pre-Diabetes, obesity and weight management with the help of valuable content, nutritionists and assigned doctors. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, please see your nearest doctor or emergency services immediately.
GLP-1 medications should be used only under the guidance of a qualified healthcare professional. Sugarfit does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
Note: This app’s premium functionalities work only with a paid subscription. You will undergo physical examination to get a subscription.
REACH US:
To share feedback please email us at: hello@sugarfit.com

bluejetty:00179365:ios.description:
Repicture is a specialized app designed for social media such as Instagram that lets you easily resize and enhance your photos.
With Repicture, you can edit your images to perfectly fit social media’s latest vertical feed, Stories/Reels, and square formats.
**Perfect for users who:**
- Want to effortlessly create photos optimized for social media latest vertical feed
- Need to adapt their images to social media recommended sizes
- Wish to maintain a consistent, unified aesthetic across their social media posts
- Wish to add frames to their photos
- Want to customize frame colors or images
- Want to apply photo filters and adjust their intensity
- Desire to fine-tune image adjustments
- Plan to add text overlays to images
- Need to remove backgrounds from photos
**Key Features:**
- Format Selection: Choose from vertical portrait, Stories/Reels, square, and horizontal landscape sizes
- Frame Fitting: Options include fit, full, and margins
- Background Customization: Change colors, add blur, or use any image
- Photo Filters: Choose from six styles and adjust the intensity
- Image Adjustment: Control brightness, contrast, exposure, and more
- Text Overlay: Customize font, size, color, and rotation
- Background Removal: Isolate subjects by removing backgrounds
**Secure privacy**
This app processes images on your device. Your images are never sent to an external server.
**Paid version**
We offer a subscription-based or one-time purchase option for our paid version.
Features convenient for editing photos for social media posts are available.
Features:
- Batch edit: Settings for batch processing multiple images are available.
- Custom size: You can edit images in high resolution without compression.
- Save space settings: The app can remember the previously selected frame fit type and save the custom space values.
- Edit with original aspect ratio: You can edit the image while maintaining the aspect ratio of the loaded original image.
- No ads: Ads will not be displayed and you can use the app comfortably.
Paid plans:
- Monthly subscription
- Yearly subscription
- One-time purchase
Please confirm the current price on the in-app purchase screen before purchase.
**Notes on paid version (subscription)**
- If the automatic renewal is not canceled more than 24 hours before the end of the period, the contract period will be renewed automatically.
- Automatic renewal will be charged from 24 hours before the end of the period until the end of the period.
- You will be charged via your Apple ID account.
- Cancellations for the current month or year are not accepted.
- Cancellation cannot be performed by any method other than the following.
**Confirmation and cancellation of paid version contract (subscription)**
You can check and cancel the subscription from device's settings.app -> Apple ID -> Show Apple ID -> Subscription -> Repicture.
* If automatic billing is not registered, “Subscription” is not displayed.
**Notes on paid version (one-time purchase)**
- You will be charged via your Apple ID account
- Cancellations are not accepted.

- Repicture is an independent tool and is not sponsored, endorsed, or affiliated with Meta Platforms, Inc. or Instagram LLC in any way.

bluejetty:00174904:ios.name: Pinbox - Map Your World
bluejetty:00174904:ios.summary:
Featured by Apple in “Best New Apps”!
Plan your next trip, mark places you want to go, and remember your favorite spots. Across town or across the world, you’ll never forget another place with Pinbox!
Add pins where you are, where you’ve
bluejetty:00174904:ios.description:
Featured by Apple in “Best New Apps”!
Plan your next trip, mark places you want to go, and remember your favorite spots. Across town or across the world, you’ll never forget another place with Pinbox!
Add pins where you are, where you’ve been, or where you want to go. Pinbox makes it easy to quickly record and organize your important places into distinct maps for every activity, occasion, or geographic region.
Unlike other apps, Pinbox doesn’t force you to save all your places on a single map. You can make one map for your favorite local restaurants - make another map for your next business trip or vacation - and make another map for errands you need to run this weekend. The possibilities are endless!
Pinbox is about you and your places. It’s not a social network. You don’t have to create an account or enter your Facebook details to use the app. Your maps aren’t cluttered with random places bookmarked by strangers. Pinbox is simply the best app for privately bookmarking places that are important to YOU!
FEATURES
• Simple, easy-to-use interface
• Drop a pin for each place you want to remember
• Add photos, notes, and other details to each pin
• Choose from seven different pin colors
• Organize your pins into separate maps
• See your location in relation to your pins
• Send maps to other Pinbox users
• Send pins to Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze, or Transit for directions
• Display maps in Standard, Hybrid, or Satellite
• Save up to 5,000 pins total
EXAMPLES OF MAPS YOU MIGHT CREATE
• Travel planning
• Favorite restaurants or restaurants to try
• Customer locations/sales calls
• Friends and family locations
• Real Estate listings
• Favorite hiking/biking trails
• Secret fishing spots
• Dog-friendly places
• Parking spots
• Favorite stores
• Multi-stop errands
• Potential photoshoot locations
• The list goes on and on and on…
Still not convinced? Here are a few of our favorite reviews…
“Pinbox is one of those simple apps that does one thing so well it feels frictionless”.
-- Stephen Grassie
“The interface is gorgeous - I would say that it looks like something Apple designed”.
-- Macaddict
“I have been using this to keep track of all the places the kids and I go so they can see how spread out our world is and they can see where all we have gone. Will use it forever”.
-- 1Cool Daddy
“This app is extremely useful and so simple to use. A lifesaver for keeping track of locations”.
-- Davies Photo
“I love this app. It is exactly what it claims to be. I have wanted this app since the smartphone was invented. So simple, and so many uses”.
-- T1Man
Using Pinbox on an iPod Touch or an iPad:
Like other map apps, Pinbox uses GPS to determine your location. iPods and Wi-Fi-only iPads do not have a GPS receiver. On these devices, Pinbox provides your approximate location using information based on your proximity to known Wi-Fi networks (when on and available). The more accurate the available information, the smaller the circle identifying your position on the map. This feature is not available in all areas. Known Wi-Fi networks are predominantly in urban areas. An internet connection is required to load maps, look up addresses, and search. Although Pinbox can be installed on iPads, it’s not formatted for the larger iPad screen - it runs doubled like all other iPhone apps.
Pinbox is the result of a collaboration between Scott D. Smith and Paul Burd. We sincerely hope you like it!

AI Art is a leading AI-powered art creation platform that empowers users to unleash their creativity and explore the boundaries of art through powerful AI painting capabilities
bluejetty:00161042:ios.description:
"Unlock the Future of Creation — Turn Ideas into Art" — AI Art
AI Art is a leading AI-powered art creation platform that empowers users to unleash their creativity and explore the boundaries of art through powerful AI painting capabilities and a diverse range of artistic style models. We offer free painting credits — simply enter a text description, choose an art style, and watch as AI brings your ideas to life, generating stunning artworks in just seconds.
【Powerful AI Painting Capabilities】
AI Art can easily recognize your creative intent through descriptive prompts. With its advanced artificial intelligence painting technology, it transforms your imagination into breathtaking works of art — whether you wish to create a lifelike portrait or a mesmerizing fantasy world, AI Art delivers with remarkable precision.
【Unlimited Painting Styles】
AI Art's painting models are primarily based on Stable Diffusion and the AI Art proprietary painting engine, offering a wide selection of artistic styles to suit diverse creative needs. It integrates various traditional art forms such as oil painting, watercolor, and sketching, while also featuring modern styles including anime, manga-inspired art, thick-paint (impasto), sci-fi, and more.
【High-Quality & Fast Output】
AI Art is designed for both high-quality output and rapid generation, producing impressive artworks with exceptional speed. Leveraging advanced rendering technology, it creates realistic and finely detailed paintings. Meanwhile, we have optimized our algorithms and runtime to ensure quick response times and a smooth, seamless creative experience.
【Continuous Innovation】
We are committed to ongoing innovation and regular updates, staying aligned with the latest trends in the art world. We frequently introduce new painting features, styles, and creative tools to satisfy our users' desire for novelty and diversity. This means you can continuously enjoy fresh and exciting painting experiences while keeping pace with contemporary artistic movements.
【Special Note】
Within the AI Art app, the in-app currency "Art Coins" purchased by users can only be used within this application.

bluejetty:00161546:ios.description:
Hey! I’m Lyndi Cohen, dietitian, nutritionist, and best-selling author AKA The Nude Nutritionist.
I’ve tried every diet there is and after a decade of starting from scratch every Monday, I finally stopped dieting and got Back to Basics. Now my life doesn’t revolve around food and I have more time (and energy) for the stuff I love.
Through this app I provide the tools and knowledge I’ve learnt to help you get healthy, feel great and stop worrying about your weight - without the guilt, restrictive meal plans, or diet culture B.S.
Join me today and get healthy without dieting (because we all know diets suck).
What’s inside the Back to Basics App:
500+ NUTRITIONIST APPROVED RECIPES (THAT ACTUALLY TASTE AMAZING!)
* Discover 500+ deliciously easy, healthy recipes
* Recipes developed by expert dietitians and nutritionists so you can eat tasty food without worrying about your weight
* Family and budget-friendly with easy-to-find ingredients
* Includes vegetarian, pescatarian, gluten-free, dairy-free and pregnancy safe options
TIME-SAVING MEAL PLANNER AND MEAL PREP MENUS
* Seamlessly plan weekly meals in one-tap with the fully-flexible meal planner
* Easily adjust recipe serves to suit how many people you’re cooking for
* Time-saving meal prep menus showing you how to cook ahead of a busy week in just one hour
* Meal prep like a pro with easy-to-follow videos
EASY GROCERY SHOPPING LISTS
* Quickly generate a customisable weekly shopping list
* Integrate your list directly with Woolworths, Amazon Fresh, Tesco, Waitrose, Walmart, Countdown and 30+ supermarkets globally
* Easily shop online or in store directly from the app
MOOD-BOOSTING DAILY-WORKOUTS
* Boost your mood with quick 5,10 and 20-minutes at-home workouts
* Suitable for all fitness levels and no equipment needed!
* Includes pregnancy-safe workouts for each trimester
* Backed by women’s health and fitness experts
EXPERT MINDSET & INTUITIVE EATING SUPPORT
* Get ongoing mental support to stay healthy without dieting
* Step-by-step mindset and mindful eating videos to help you learn a new approach to food, manage cravings and tackle emotional eating
* Join Challenges for ongoing motivation and support
* New intuitive eating and mindset content added weekly
PREGNANCY AND POSTNATAL SAFE
* Back to Basics is filled with pregnancy and postnatal friendly recipes
* 100+ pregnancy-safe workout vid

bluejetty:00123305:ios.description:
The Washington State Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Washington State Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Washington State Mobile App, you must be enrolled as an Washington State Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00122856:ios.summary:
Experience the legacy of IME now on your smartphone. Presenting IME Pay!

bluejetty:00122856:ios.description:
Experience the legacy of IME now on your smartphone. Presenting IME Pay!
With the aim to simplify daily life for all Nepalese, IME introduced IME Pay for easy, quick, and hassle-free online digital payments for day-to-day services. Licensed by Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) and powered by IME Remit, IME Pay is now a leading payment gateway in Nepal.
IME Pay is an advanced digital wallet that allows users to transfer money from wallet to wallet, pay utility bills and make purchases online or offline instantly with a few quick taps on their smartphones. It essentially brings all cash transactions to the tips of your fingers, from basic household purchases to high volume business trades. With our wide range of partners and merchants, we are dedicated to ease your everyday life by providing you the most lucrative offers.
With Nepal’s largest IME network of 25,000+ touchpoints, we encourage our customers to make smart and safe payments digitally, within the convenience of their smartphones. All your payments are just a tap away with IME Pay!
Our Features include:
MONEY TRANSFER
Add Money
You can load money into your IME wallet account from various available mediums:
• Linked Bank
• E-banking/M-banking
• Connect IPS
• Nearby Agents
IME Pay users can enjoy free banking transactions with linked banks like Global IME Bank, NIC Asia Bank, Siddhartha Bank, Bank of Kathmandu, Kumari Bank, NIBL Bank, and other banks.
Send Money
Send money feature makes IME Pay users to conveniently send/ transfer money to desired destinations:
• IME Pay Wallet transfer
• Cash Pickup
• Bank Deposit
Withdraw Money
You can withdraw the desired amount from nearby IME Agents. Scan the QR code located in agent counters and cash out the desired amount.
Request Money
You can also request the desired amount to your friends and family. Both parties should be IME Pay users.
UTILITY BILLS PAYMENT
You can make quick and easy payments with a few taps on your smartphone. We offer a wide range of facilities to our valued customers. Our services include:
• Mobile Top-up (NTC, Ncell & SmartCell)
• Landline (Nepal Telecom)
• Electricity (Nepal Electricity Authority NEA)
• Water (Khanepani)
• TV (DishHome, MeroTV, SkyTV and more)
• Internet (Worldlink, Vianet, Subisu, ADSL and more)
• EMI (MAW Investment, Jagdamba Credit &Hulas)
• Insurance Premium (IME General Insurance, Sagarmatha, NECO & more)
MERCHANT PAYMENTS
You can make payments for products and services at IME Pay registered merchants including restaurants, cafes, convenience stores, and more. Scan QR codes placed in the payment counter at the merchant location or search for the merchant directly in the app. You can find various discounts and offers available at merchants in the “Deals” section.
TICKETING
We provide the option to find tickets according to your preferences and buy tickets directly from your smartphone. You can instantly book tickets via IME Pay for the following services:
• Airlines
• Movie Tickets
• Chandragiri Hills Cable Car
EVENTS
Ticketing and Voting are facilitated by IME Pay where you can instantly purchase tickets to available events. Vote for your favorite contestants in TV shows or any other competitions integrated into the app.
No more queue! No more traffic jams! No more penalty!
Live a smart life, choose IME Pay today, and pay all your bills anytime from anywhere instantly!

bluejetty:00083860:ios.description:
An independent browser thoughtfully designed by a single human, and funded by its users.
WHAT THE PRESS SAYS
“A very robust, exquisitely designed, stunningly handsome web browser. […] It’s just so thoughtful. So utterly modern in its appearance and features, but old-school in its hyperfocus on serving you, the user, through craftsmanship.”
— Daring Fireball
“My favorite iOS browser these days is Quiche Browser. It’s somehow both incredibly simple and one of the most customizable browsers I’ve ever tried.”
— The Verge
“Quiche Browser has clearly been designed with care.”
— MacStories 
“If you want a lightweight, private, minimalistic, yet customizable web browsing experience on your iPhone – [Quiche Browser] might be the perfect answer for you.”
— 9to5Mac 
“Quiche Browser is unique, engaging, and fully customizable.”
— Lifehacker
BROWSER CUSTOMIZATION DESIGNED TO STAY SIMPLE AND BEAUTIFUL
• Choose and place every toolbar and menu button.
• Customize the address bar’s appearance and contents.
• Choose from a list of ready-to-use toolbars, which you can then adapt to your needs.
• Use a Liquid Glass toolbar, or switch to a Classic one if Liquid Glass isn’t your thing.
• Manage tabs with multiple display and sorting options.
• Read web pages in full screen for focused, distraction-free browsing.
BUILT-IN BLOCKING
Ads, trackers, and cookie banners are blocked by default. 
Pages load faster and feel less cluttered.
DARKEN ALL WEBSITES
Pick a unique dark mode theme and apply it to every website. 
No more blinding white pages at night.
COMFORT MODE
Adjust the interface so your tabs, favorites, and search suggestions are always easy to reach with one hand.
UNIQUE QUALITY-OF-LIFE IMPROVEMENTS EVERYWHERE
• Use any search engine, even Kagi or your own SearXNG instance.
• Enhance your toolbar with a wide range of tools: disable JavaScript, switch to desktop mode, close all tabs and clear data, translate pages, and more.
• Estimated read time for every page.
• Open new tabs on the website of your choice.
• Extreme energy saving in Low Power Mode.
MY PRIVACY STANCE: KEEP YOUR DATA FOR YOURSELF
• Zero data tracking or usage monitoring.
• Never connects to any first-party or third-party servers, except to RevenueCat for managing purchases and preventing fraud.
• No sign-up, obviously.
LIGHTWEIGHT, FAST, AND ORIGINAL
Quiche Browser is not another bloated clone of Firefox, Brave, or Chrome. 
I built it entirely from scratch for performance and to keep it lightweight.
FULLY INDEPENDENT
• No investors dictating growth or influencing product direction. 
• No search engine deals, data monetization, or partner agreements shaping the browser.
• It’s just me, building the browser of my dreams.
100% FUNDED BY USERS
Subscribing to Quiche PLUS unlocks additional features such as Website Darkening, Comfort Mode, all app icons, and all button styles.
Building a web browser alone is a full-time job, and subscribing also allows me to:
• Keep the app up to date with new iOS releases and features.
• Build more unique features.
• Start working toward a macOS version.
—

bluejetty:00034949:ios.name: Stud Finder Wall Detector Tool
bluejetty:00034949:ios.summary:
# THREE TOOLS IN ONE: STUDS, LEVELS, AND ANGLES
Find the studs behind a wall, check whether a surface is level, and measure or match an angle. Every reading comes with visual, sound, and haptic feedback, so you can keep the phone against t
bluejetty:00034949:ios.description:
# THREE TOOLS IN ONE: STUDS, LEVELS, AND ANGLES
Find the studs behind a wall, check whether a surface is level, and measure or match an angle. Every reading comes with visual, sound, and haptic feedback, so you can keep the phone against the wall and still know what it found.
# MAGNETIC STUD FINDER WITH FIVE PRESETS
Wooden studs are held by nails and screws, and those are what the magnetometer sees. Choose the preset that matches what you are looking for — Nails in Stud, Metal Stud, Metal Pipe, Electrical Wiring, or High Precision — and the filtering adjusts to it.
# ACCURATE BUBBLE LEVEL
Horizontal, vertical, and surface bubbles, with the exact tilt in degrees beside them. Set the sound to any axis and you can level a shelf without watching the screen.
# ANGLE FINDER WITH A LOCKED REFERENCE
Measure an angle, lock it as a target, and match the second cut to the first. The dial shades the gap between the two, so how far off you are is something you see rather than calculate.
# FEEDBACK YOU CHOOSE
Sound and haptics are configurable per axis and per intensity. Work quietly, or set it loud enough to hear over a drill.
# APPLE WATCH COMPANION
Mirror the readings to your wrist. The phone stays flat against the wall while you read detection strength, bubble alignment, or the current angle on the watch.
# VISUAL INDICATORS THAT SHOW THEIR WORK
A strength meter and a history graph, so a peak is visible as a peak rather than as a single number that has already moved. The angle finder draws a full compass with degree markings.
# TUTORIALS INCLUDED
Step-by-step guides for finding studs, levelling surfaces, and measuring angles, plus how to use the Apple Watch companion.
# SUBSCRIPTIONS AND AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
- Your subscription includes access to all tools and the Apple Watch companion app.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of your selected subscription period.
- Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in your App Store Account Settings.
# LEGAL
Terms of Service: https://cooptimizeit.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://cooptimizeit.com/privacy-policy
# SUPPORT
Contact us at info@cooptimizeit.com. We reply within 48 hours.

bluejetty:00126212:ios.description:
[Description]
Let's create and print labels using your mobile device!
P-touch Design&Print2 is a free application that enables you to design labels on your iOS device (iPhone/iPad*) and print them via Bluetooth® using your Brother label printer. 
* iPhone compatibility mode
[Key Features]
- Easily create stylish and practical labels, decorative tapes, and satin ribbons from a variety of templates perfect for all your labeling, crafting, storage, retail, business, and gift wrapping needs.
- Choose from a wide variety of fonts, symbols, emoji, patterns, and frames to create and design labels, decorative tapes, and satin ribbons.
- Insert images and logos and preview the final design before printing.
- Insert QR codes using the "Share label" feature to share links to websites or videos. (P-touch CUBE XP and CUBE Plus only)
[New Features in Brother P-touch Design&Print2] 
- Text Recognition: Scan and insert text without having to enter it manually. (P-touch CUBE XP and CUBE Plus only)
- Cloud Storage: Upload label templates to the cloud, reuse them, and share them with others. 
-Translation Function: Automatically translate scanned or typed text and add it to your label. (P-touch CUBE XP and CUBE Plus only)
[Compatible machines]
P-touch CUBE XP, P-touch CUBE Plus, P-touch CUBE and PT-N25BT
To help us improve the application, send your feedback to Feedback-mobile-apps-lm@brother.com. Please note that we may not be able to respond to individual emails.

bluejetty:00151400:ios.description:
ohcuGO is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with ohcuGO:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
Transfer money between your accounts.
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
View and save your monthly statements.
Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the ohcuGO app, you must be enrolled as a Old Hickory Credit Union digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00177185:ios.description:
Want to improve your kid's math skills? How about helping your kids master mathematics with fun, free math games? Math Games is the perfect way to help children learn math skills the easy way!
Our math games for kids is super fun! Solve a wide variety of math puzzles, brain teasers, and brain math puzzles using nothing more than basic arithmetic. Pick up new math skills in addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, or get more advanced with fractions ¼, decimals, and mixed operations. 
Collection of Math Games offered:
◾ Addition games - 1, 2, or 3 digit addition, sequential addition, plus more addition games.
◾ Subtraction games - 1, 2, 3 digit subtraction game to learn how to subtract
◾ Multiplication games - Best practice game to learn multiplication tables and multiplying methods.
◾ Division games - Learn to divide by playing multiple fun division games
◾ Fractions - Step-by-step learning of fraction calculation, fun and easy way to learn fractions.
◾ Decimals - Fun adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing decimal modes to learn
◾ Square Roots - Practice squares and square roots, learn how to squares a number
◾ Exponents - Practice exponent problems
◾ Mixed operations - Put your knowledge to the test by practicing addition, subtraction, multiplication, division all in one mode!
All of these math games are free to enjoy, and they're suitable for all ages, from kids to adults. Within this educational kids app, we've tried to teach kids step-by-step how to add, subtract, multiply and divide. Anyone who wants to hone their skills by playing math games is welcome to download and try them out!
Test your addition, subtraction, multiplication, and other number skills in the following modes:
• Memory Match - Flip number memory cards and match answers to the equations.
• Challenge Mode - Finish the puzzles before time runs out!
• Dual Mode - Split-screen interface for two players.
Math games for kids should be fun! Our math app is suitable for children in kindergarten, 1st grade, 2nd grade, 3rd grade, 4th grade, 5th grade, or 6th grade, and of course, any teenager or adult who is interested in training their brain and improving their math skills!
Our math games are tested on our kids first and made with love. We'd like to think our math games are filled with endless math worksheets, which kids can practice over and over again. Within our math app, we've tried to teach addition, subtraction, multiplication, division to the best of our ability. We would love to improve the game further for kids in kindergarten, 1st grade, 2nd grade, 3rd grade, 4th grade, and 5th grade - so please let us know grade specific what else we can add to the math game. If you enjoy our collection of free kids games, all we ask in return is that you share the games with friends and family.
What are you waiting for? Download the funnest new math game today for free!

bluejetty:00170175:ios.summary:
Start learning Japanese with words and phrases you can read, listen to and practice at your own pace. English meanings and pronunciation guides help you explore the language.
CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN
Explore 252 lessons across 26 chapters, inc
bluejetty:00170175:ios.description:
Start learning Japanese with words and phrases you can read, listen to and practice at your own pace. English meanings and pronunciation guides help you explore the language.
CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN
Explore 252 lessons across 26 chapters, including basic hiragana and katakana, greetings, numbers, food, family, home, work, travel, transport, nature and more.
The alphabet lesson introduces 46 basic hiragana and 46 basic katakana characters with audio and romanized readings.
Prefer a focused route? Choose from five mini courses: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, and Health & Emergency. Each brings related lessons together around a useful topic.
LISTEN AND REVIEW
Choose between the Sakura and Ren voice options for bundled recordings. Adjust playback speed and replay words or phrases as you study. Lesson text and bundled recordings can be used offline after installation. Purchases, ads and sending support messages require an internet connection.
PRACTICE WHAT YOU LEARN
Review with flashcards, answer multiple-choice and true-or-false questions, match words with their meanings, and type answers in writing exercises. Revisit words that need more practice and check your exercise results.
MAKE STUDYING PERSONAL
Save favorite words and phrases for quick review. Follow your learning progress, record daily check-ins and set study reminders with notification permission. Choose a theme and learning appearance that suits you.
KEEP A COPY OF YOUR PROGRESS
Use manual Backup & Restore to export your favorites, progress, exercise history and included preferences to a file. Import a compatible backup when you need it. Purchases and notification permissions are not transferred in the backup.
HELP IMPROVE THE CONTENT
Use the flag beside a word to prepare a report about its audio, translation or example. You can also open Feedback & Support in Settings or contact support@dugloapps.app.
ACCESS
Some learning content is available without a purchase. Access to all lessons and premium features requires a one-time purchase or subscription. See the in-app purchase screen for available plans and terms.
Privacy Policy: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-japanese/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-japanese/terms/

bluejetty:00177167:ios.description:
Take the auto-battle sim genre and add a splash of ridiculous by adding dozens of cute and vicious animals to the fray! Pack your animal army with lions, dogs, bears, and more before sending them into battle to win gold and glory in Animal Warfare.
Each animal fights differently and no battle is the same! Build and upgrade your army your way to take on challenging fights. 
Animal Warfare features:
- Deep and addictive progression systems
- A crisp and minimalistic art style
- An expansive campaign with 100s of unique levels
- A huge roster of animals to collect, each with unique perks and abilities 
- A Challenge Mode where you can earn bonus rewards
- Epic Boss Battles to test your skill!

No cancellation of the current subscription period is allowed.

bluejetty:00127286:ios.name: ToonSquid
bluejetty:00127286:ios.summary: ToonSquid is the powerful 2D art and animation studio for your iPad. Its flexible layer system allows you to combine the charm of hand-drawn traditional animation with keyframes that automatically animate layer properties over time. With a
bluejetty:00127286:ios.description:
ToonSquid is the powerful 2D art and animation studio for your iPad. Its flexible layer system allows you to combine the charm of hand-drawn traditional animation with keyframes that automatically animate layer properties over time. With a library full of beautiful, blazing-fast and fully customizable pixel and vector brushes, animatable effects, a smudge tool, animated text and vector shapes, bones with inverse kinematics, video and audio layers, camera movements, symbols and many more features, ToonSquid makes it easy to bring your vision to life.
Traditional Animation
- Create hand-drawn frame-by-frame animations
- Control how long you want to show each drawing in the timeline
- Draw in resolutions of up to 4k
Keyframe Animation
- Add keyframes to automatically animate layer and effects properties over time
- Choose from an extensive list of customizable easing curve presets to create organic motion between keyframes
- Easily loop your keyframe animation
Powerful Layer System
- Define the order and length of each element in your animation using layers and drawings and a flexible timeline
- Organize your layers into groups for a clean workflow or to animate multiple layers at once
- Use the camera layer to quickly define the visible portion of your animation in the export
- Mask layers to other layers, even when their contents are animated
- Choose from 27 industry-standard layer blend modes for beautiful compositing effects
Fully-customizable Brushes
- Draw gorgeous brush strokes with ToonSquid's state-of-the-art digital brush engine
- Take full advantage of Apple Pencil's pressure and tilt sensitivity and the iPad Pro's 120Hz display for lag-free drawing
- Use vector brushes to create brush strokes that are sharp at every zoom level
- Edit the 60+ brush settings and import custom textures to create a brush library that is perfectly tailored to your art style
- Blend your strokes together using the smudge tool
- Draw in a variety of styles such as sketching, inking, wet mixing, pixel art, and more
- Export and share your custom brushes with others
- Import your existing library of Adobe® Photoshop® brushes
Vector Shapes
- Create custom shapes using the path tool by placing and editing each curve control point
- Quickly add common vector shapes from the shape library
- Import SVG files
- Fill and stroke your shapes with beautiful gradients and edit them directly on the canvas
- Animate the visible length of a path using its trim properties
Animatable Effects
- Create character rigs using bones and add inverse kinematics constraints
- Create custom meshes to deform pixel layers when they are part of a bone rig
- Animate perspective and warp effects
- Apply adjustments, blur, pixelation, drop shadow, chroma key, halftone, parallax and more effects
Efficient symbol workflow
- Split your animation into separate clips that you can then reuse multiple times using symbols
- Make edits to an animation clip and immediately see the changes in all of its symbol instances
- Use frame markers to speed up your lip-syncing workflow
Text
- Add text layers and animate their appearance
- Import your favorite fonts
Color
- Use ToonSquid's powerful color picker with plenty of different interfaces to choose the exact colors you need
- Create custom color palettes and share them outside the application
- Pick colors straight from the canvas using the pipette tool
- Fill connected regions quickly with the fill tool
Audio and Video
- Add audio clips to your timeline and perform lip-syncing animations
- Import videos, GIFs and images into your project and work with them through symbols
Transform
- Animate a layer's position, rotation and scale properties using keyframes
- Build transform hierarchies to achieve more advanced movements
- Edit your layer's motion path directly on the canvas
Numerous Export Formats
- Export your work in one of many common file formats such as MP4, MOV, GIF, PNG, JPEG, PSD, and more.

bluejetty:00073752:ios.description:
Stay updated with North Jersey News, your premier source for breaking news, local stories, and in-depth reporting across Northern New Jersey. Get timely updates and thorough coverage on the topics that matter most to you. 
We’re here because we believe that local journalism is valuable – whether you enjoy the printed newspaper or prefer digital access to North Jersey news, we’re here to keep neighbors connected and hold leaders accountable. 
We’re our community’s trusted storytellers. We’re here for it. 
WHAT WE’RE ALL ABOUT: 
• Investigative reporting that gives you an inside look at New Jersey schools, politics, environment and the mob. 
• Unmatched North Jersey high school sports coverage from our Varsity Aces team. Plus, access to your favorite pro and college teams. 
• Exclusive inside scoops on the hottest restaurants in North Jersey, from dive bars to Michelin stars. 
• Local journalism that holds the powerful accountable, celebrates where we live and helps us solve problems. 
• Stay up-to-date with election news, analysis, and results. 
• App features like real-time alerts, challenging puzzles and lively podcasts, a personalized feed, the eNewspaper, and more. 
APP FEATURES: 
• Real-time breaking news alerts 
• A personalized feed on the all-new For You page 
• The eNewspaper, a digital replica of our print newspaper 
Subscription Information: 
• The North Jersey app is free to download and all users can access a sampling of free articles every month. 
• Subscriptions are charged to your account at confirmation of purchase and automatically renew each month or year, unless turned off in your account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. See "Subscription Support" in the app's Settings for more details and customer service contact information. 
MORE INFORMATION: 
• Privacy Policy: https://cm.northjersey.com/privacy/ 
• Terms of Service: https://cm.northjersey.com/terms/ 
• Help Center: https://help.northjersey.com

Use this magic Diary, put down all your thoughts or plans, and follow them as time passes. Make it your trustworthy friend who never judges you and who's always there for you. Unicorn Journal will be your private book. Every girl will love it!

Whether you want to keep your secret away from prying eyes, maybe a secret love story, or want to record your life's emotions as time passes, you now have a friend who listens to you. Set a password to make sure that your thoughts are safe and private!

Make it a habit to write one or more mini-notes during your day quickly. Set a reminder in your Diary. Leave a few words about your workout session and what happened at school or in the office during your day on weekends.

Use this diary app to write down your journal of daily events, appointments, secrets, and feelings. You can also use it as a diet journal, dream journal, travel diary, or to write an autobiography.

Features:
- Lock your Diary with the password (PIN code) or biometrics. You can change it in the settings
- Add a reminder in case you forget your password!
- Create, modify, and delete entries in a very simple and intuitive way
- Add pictures and drawings
- Stickers, emoticons - decorate your note
- Wallpapers - download beautiful wallpaper with unicorns
- Change your avatar, add a nick
- Share your memories with friends (by Facebook, Gmail or Messenger)
- Reminder – set a reminder to remember to add notes regularly
- Import and export notes option
- Change the skin of your Diary (Premium option)
- Check the unicorn history in comics
- Collect all items
- Check statistics

The application is suitable for kids.
----------

Unicorn diary  terms of service
1 week Diary + from 4.99$ per week (prices may vary slightly depending on the region).
1 month Diary + from 19.99$ per month (prices may vary slightly depending on the region)

You can find all in-app purchases on this app store page below under "In-app purchases".

Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless they have been switched off at least 24 hours before the subscription period expires. Your account will be charged within 24 hours of payment. You can manage your subscriptions in the iOS settings and switch the automatic renewal on or off. A subscription that is already running cannot be canceled within the term that has already started.

Enjoy!

bluejetty:00098552:ios.name: GOV.UK One Login
bluejetty:00098552:ios.summary:
You can use the GOV.UK One Login app to prove your identity to access some government services. It works by matching your face to your photo ID.
You can also use this app to save a digital version of your HM Armed Forces Veteran Card to yo
bluejetty:00098552:ios.description:
You can use the GOV.UK One Login app to prove your identity to access some government services. It works by matching your face to your photo ID.
You can also use this app to save a digital version of your HM Armed Forces Veteran Card to your phone. 
In future you'll be able to save other digital documents, such as your driving licence. This is not available yet.
Before you start
You need to get this app if you’re:
• using a service on the GOV.UK website that asks you to prove your identity with GOV.UK One Login
• saving your digital Veteran Card to your phone
You’ll be guided to this app when it is time to use it.
What you need
You can use any of the following types of photo ID to prove your identity:
• UK passport
• non-UK passport with a biometric chip
• UK photocard driving licence
• UK biometric residence permit (BRP)
• UK biometric residence card (BRC)
• UK Frontier Worker permit (FWP)
You can use an expired driving licence if it expired in the last 90 days and it was issued by DVLA.
You can use an expired BRP, BRC or FWP up to 24 months after its expiry date.
You need to have your original photo ID with you. You cannot use a photocopy or digital copy.
You will also need:
• a well-lit area where you can take a good quality photograph
• an iPhone 8 or newer
• iOS 16.7 or higher
How it works
You'll need to sign in to the app with your GOV.UK One Login details. This links the app to the GOV.UK website so you can continue proving your identity.
If your photo ID is a passport, BRP, BRC or FWP you will:
• take a photo of your photo ID
• scan the biometric chip in your photo ID using your phone
• scan your face using your phone
If your photo ID is a driving licence you will:
• take a photo of your driving licence
• scan your face using your phone
What happens next
Once your information has been submitted in the app, you'll need to go back to the GOV.UK website, so you can finish proving your identity and access the service you were trying to use.
Privacy and security
The personal information you provide to prove your identity will not be saved either on the app or on your phone. We collect your data securely and delete it when it is no longer needed.
Digital documents you add to the app will be saved on your phone so you can access them whenever you need.

bluejetty:00088379:ios.summary:
How many sleeps until Christmas?
Christmas Countdown puts the countdown right on your home screen and lock screen, so the whole family can see how close Christmas is, every time they pick up the iPhone. Rated 4.8 stars by more than 2,400 p
bluejetty:00088379:ios.description:
How many sleeps until Christmas?
Christmas Countdown puts the countdown right on your home screen and lock screen, so the whole family can see how close Christmas is, every time they pick up the iPhone. Rated 4.8 stars by more than 2,400 people. Free, no ads, no account.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Add the widget once and the days (or sleeps) left are always in sight. No need to open the app: the widget updates by itself every day, all season long.
LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
See the countdown without even unlocking your phone. Pick the round widget with its progress ring, which fills up as Christmas gets closer, or the one-line widget above the clock.
SLEEPS, NOT JUST DAYS
Kids don't count days, they count sleeps. Switch to sleeps mode and the app answers the question you hear every evening in December: "How many more nights until Santa comes?"
LIVE COUNTDOWN IN THE APP
Open the app for the full countdown: days, hours, minutes and seconds ticking down in real time, under gently falling snow. Prefer a calm screen? Turn the snow off in one tap.
DEC 24 OR DEC 25
Celebrate on Christmas Eve or on Christmas Day? Choose the date you count down to, and every widget follows. In Sweden, the app counts to December 24 by default.
FESTIVE THEMES
Classic red, pine green or ice blue. Your colour applies to the app and to the widgets, so your home screen matches your mood.
ALL YEAR LONG
Christmas is over? The countdown starts again for next year, and we say Merry Christmas on the way.
IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Available in 16 languages, from French and German to Japanese and Korean.
PREMIUM: SNOWY SCENE WIDGETS
A one-time purchase unlocks exclusive widgets: a snowy landscape with a cabin, a snowman and fir trees, in small and medium sizes, painted in your theme colour. Premium also removes the FREE badge from the classic widget and supports an independent developer. No subscription, ever. Already bought it? Restore your purchase in one tap from Settings.
HOW TO ADD THE WIDGET
1. Download Christmas Countdown, it's free
2. Long-press an empty area of your home screen and tap Edit
3. Tap Add Widget and search for Christmas Countdown
4. Choose a size and tap Add Widget
For the lock screen, long-press the lock screen, tap Customize, then add the widget under the clock.
MADE BY ONE PERSON
Christmas Countdown is built by an independent developer who loves Christmas as much as you do. Ideas, bugs or just a hello? Write from the Settings screen: every message gets read.
Christmas only comes once a year. Start counting.

bluejetty:00086893:ios.name: RateHawk: Hotel Booking
bluejetty:00086893:ios.summary:
RateHawk is an online platform for booking hotels, air tickets, and hire cars, as well as for arranging other travel services. It is present on 101 markets and in 14 languages for travel professionals.
Book with confidence at great prices.
bluejetty:00086893:ios.description:
RateHawk is an online platform for booking hotels, air tickets, and hire cars, as well as for arranging other travel services. It is present on 101 markets and in 14 languages for travel professionals.
Book with confidence at great prices. Your online hotel booking tool for business with a user-friendly interface, wide range of inventory and 24/7 multilingual support.
Different collaboration models
We offer collaboration in various formats. You get to choose which model is more convenient: Net prices or commission. Work with net prices or choose your commission. We make it easier for you to manage your business.
Huge inventory selection
You can choose from over 2,500,000 hotels, guest houses, hostels, and apartments at great prices for corporate clients and travel agencies. We work with major global inventory suppliers and tens of thousands of hotels directly. This allows us to provide you with the best rates and save your money.
Booking air tickets
You may choose and book individual or group flights from any of 200 airlines throughout the world 
Convenient and functional web platform
In our user-friendly system, you can quickly book hotels or flights, hire a car, and make group or individual bookings. When creating an appropriate and user-friendly interface for tourism professionals, we applied our invaluable experience from developing our B2C product. We receive a huge volume of varied content each day from suppliers and from hotels directly, as well as feedback from our travelers. Our content team unifies all the material to ensure that you have full and high-quality information that you need to make a booking.
For all types of users
You may assign user roles and restrict access. Finance department staff will gain one level of access, managers another, group leaders a third, and administrators a fourth. Each role has its functionality and rights assigned to it. You can create or delete accounts directly.
A reliable support service
You will enjoy fantastic client support and be assigned an account manager. We are available to serve you 24/7: we support bookings, help you in your work, and resolve arising issues. Our support service speaks the language of your region.
Exclusive manual pre-checks of bookings
We guarantee maximum reliability. So that you can be sure that your clients are expected in the hotel, we carry out a manual pre-check of all bookings and recheck the details of each booking with the hotel.
High-quality back office
All information about bookings, as well as invoices, vouchers and reports and so on, are available to you in real-time. This will help you to manage your bookings and customize reports in the most convenient way possible, and to download reports in whatever format is most convenient for you.
Loyalty program
It’s a great value booking on RateHawk. Book hotels, accumulate points, and use them in part or in full to pay for your own bookings or to provide discounts to clients. 1 loyalty point = 1 currency unit.
Work with RateHawk and earn more with us!

Feature Overview

 currencies, providing users with faster, lower-cost, and seamless online
 international remittance services.
 In addition to currency exchange, the platform offers an intelligent
 conversion calculator, cross-border remittance, U.S./Hong Kong stock investing
 services, and market tracking for cryptocurrencies, gold, silver, crude oil,
 and other commodities—helping users manage funds and stay on top of market
 dynamics in one place.
 - Wallet: Covers asset management, receiving payments, transfers, deposits,
 and withdrawals. Supports crypto withdrawals and remittances at any time,
 with a clear view of account assets.
 - Instant Swap: After deposit, users can complete online multi-currency
 exchange with no preset limit, and withdraw funds to offshore bank accounts.
 - Wealth: Flexible wealth management service with daily yield settlement,
 automatically credited to available account balance.
 - Financial Asset Trading: Covers major markets including U.S. and Hong Kong
 stocks, with one account connected to multiple market opportunities.
 - Market Tracking: Supports market tracking for cryptocurrencies, gold,
 silver, crude oil, and other commodities, helping users monitor real-time
 price moves, trends, and market rhythm.

 capabilities to provide global users with an integrated financial experience
 covering payments, international remittance, securities investment, and market
 tracking services. Whether for cross-border fund management or multi-market

 mind.

 efficiency.

 and smoother fund transfers.

 advanced traders.

 stocks, cryptocurrencies, gold, silver, crude oil, and other commodities, so

 investing, helping reduce trading costs.

bluejetty:00141268:ios.description:
Welcome to Resilient, your workout and nutrition guide to unlocking both physical and mental strength. Led by Registered Nurse and certified trainer Nicci Robinson, Resilient is designed to build unshakable strength - inside and out. Nicci's expertise ensures every workout plan is crafted to deliver results, while her focus on technique guarantees you train smarter, not harder. This app is packed with powerful workout plans, tailored nutrition, mindfulness tools and motivation to challenge you, transform your body, and bring out your most resilient self. 
NEW: COOKBOOK
Discover our brand-new Cookbook—a flexible alternative to the Meal Plan! Packed with healthy, easy-to-make recipes, it’s designed for effortless meal planning. Browse by category—Protein-Rich, Low-Carb, Vegetarian, and more—or filter by meal type and even Post-Workout fuel. Whether you're craving a Power Bowl, Sandwich, or something theme-specific, there's something for every taste and goal.
What’s Waiting for You in Resilient: 
Strength training plans designed for women who are serious about fitness.
- Goal-Specific Training Programs: targeted workout plan, whether it’s building strength, toning your body, or increasing endurance. Programs include a mix of strength exercises, HIIT, cardio, and bodybuilding workouts. 
- Structured Workout Plans: reps-and-sets-based workouts with detailed instructional videos from Nicci to master proper technique, maximize results, and avoid injury. 
- Flexible Workout Options: workouts for home or gym, with the freedom to adapt exercises to any environment. 
- Apple Watch Sync: Track reps, sets, heart rate, and calories burned in real time. 
Nutrition and Meal Plans for lasting results 
- Protein rich diet: nutrient-packed meal plans, available in both classic and vegetarian options, to support muscle boost, growth and recovery. 
- Targeted nutrition tags: meal plans designed to support mental health, enhance immunity, and accelerate recovery. 
- SMART meal planning: save favorite recipes, create shopping lists, and streamline your nutrition so you can focus on your fitness goals. 
Mental resilience tools to face challenges with confidence 
- Meditations & Sleep Sounds: Guided meditations and calming audio help you relax, manage stress, and sleep better. 
- Mindful Breathing & Affirmations: breathing exercises and affirmations to foster inner peace and boost self-confidence. 
Performance Tracking & Workout Insights 
- Track your workout progress: log weights, measurements while monitoring streaks and achievements. 
- Personal Dashboard: complete view of your journey with workout summaries, nutrition, meal plans, hydration goals, and motivational quotes. 
Transform your body, own your confidence, and turn every challenge into strength. Join today and become the most resilient version of yourself!
App works with Apple Health to record your calories burned after a workout.
This app provides users with extensive features, including workouts, meal plans, and more, all of which require an active subscription. Users are required to make payments in order to have access to these exclusive features that are designed to enhance your fitness journey seamlessly.
Payments for access to the application will be auto-renewed if it is not turned off at least 24 hours before the current period. The account will be debited at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Users can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in the app’s settings.
App provides diet plans which cannot be taken as a medical diagnosis. If you wish to get a medical diagnosis, please contact with your nearest medical center.
Terms of service: https://resilient.app/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://resilient.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00061944:ios.name: Alphablocks: Letter Fun
bluejetty:00061944:ios.summary:
From the BAFTA nominated pre-school learning TV shows Alphablocks and Numberblocks, we bring you Alphablocks Letter Fun!
Your little ones are going to LOVE interacting with the Alphablocks in this amazing App. It’s hugely entertaining to p
bluejetty:00061944:ios.description:
From the BAFTA nominated pre-school learning TV shows Alphablocks and Numberblocks, we bring you Alphablocks Letter Fun!
Your little ones are going to LOVE interacting with the Alphablocks in this amazing App. It’s hugely entertaining to play and makes a real difference to their reading through fun, multisensory learning.
Alphablocks has been on TV for nearly a decade, helping millions of children learn to read the fun way. Now your little ones can meet all the Alphablocks from A to Z, learning letters and sounds with four great phonics mini-games and a fantastic singalong song.
"Alphablock A says a! when an apple lands on her head! "
Every Alphablock is designed to make their letter and sound easy to learn, encouraging kids to interact with the characters and really get to know the alphabet. They’ll have great fun getting hands-on with letters and sounds.
* No in-app purchases *
▸ MINIGAMES
There are four minigames per Alphablock — that’s over 100 great activities for kids to enjoy!
◆ Bubble pop! — match letters to sounds by popping the bubbles that match the sounds you hear.
◆ Paint me — listen to letter sounds as you paint each Alphablock with your finger.
◆ Favourite things — listen out for words that begin with each letter sound and add them to the Alphablock’s collection of favourite things.
◆ Hide and seek — listen carefully to tell letter sounds apart, and see if you can spot where the Alphablock is hiding.
▸ ALPHABLOCKS LETTER SONG
Sing along with the Alphablocks as they all get together to sing their letter sounds in a mnemonic song that kids will love and remember!
▸ LETTER SOUNDS AND NAMES
When your child has mastered their letters and sounds, change to Letter Name mode and have fun learning all the letter names too.
▸ EARN STARS
Every minigame earns a star. Collect all four stars to watch the Alphablock sing their line from the Alphablocks letter song. Can you light up all the stars for all your Alphablocks? (The app keeps your progress between visits. You can reset it if you want to start again or to let a friend or sibling play.)
▸ FULL OF FABULOUS PHONICS
Alphablocks is made by teachers and reading experts. It’s built around systematic synthetic phonics, as taught in UK schools. Alphablocks is a step-by-step reading system with episodes, books and more that has helped over a million children learn to read the fun way.
Alphablocks Letter Fun was created by Blue Zoo Animation, the multi-award winning studio who are passionate about creating fantastic content for kids tv and games. Blue Zoo has produced many hit pre-school shows including Go Jetters, Digby Dragon, Miffy, Tree Fu Tom, Mac & Izzy, and more. 
www.blue-zoo.co.uk

bluejetty:00016919:ios.description:
You may have heard that winter was coming. So brace yourselves! No continent shall remain immune to the Evolution virus. The last frontier has finally been breached: Penguin Evolution is here!
After starring in several children movies and even learning how to tap dance, penguins finally found their place in the evolutionary chain. Combine penguins to evolve them and discover their most curious, exotic and bizarre forms!
And they are so cute you could die! No, seriously. They are, like, 4 feet tall sometimes. And have very sharp beaks. So… I don’t know… I... I wouldn’t get too close to one if I were you.
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar penguins to create new mysterious creatures
• Use penguin poop coins to buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a penguin to make coins pop when penguins poop
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many penguin species to discover
• A mind-blowing story yet untold
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution, 2048 and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No penguins were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
This game is cooler than a popsicle! Come play it.
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq
