Hammer is a powerful GPS navigation app designed specifically for commercial truck drivers. Built by the community at TruckersReport.com, Hammer Truck GPS delivers precision routing, safety-first features, and
bluejetty:00026633:ios.description:
Smarter Trucking Starts Here.
Hammer is a powerful GPS navigation app designed specifically for commercial truck drivers. Built by the community at TruckersReport.com, Hammer Truck GPS delivers precision routing, safety-first features, and robust offline map capabilities tailored to the needs of professional drivers.
KEY FEATURES
- Truck-Specific GPS Navigation
- Turn-by-turn directions customized for commercial vehicles
- Routing that considers your truck's height, weight, length, axle count, and cargo type
- Offline map access keeps you on track without cellular data
- Real-time rerouting around traffic, accidents, and road closures
- Landscape mode and satellite view for easier readability on the road
- Trip Planning Tools for Truckers
- Multi-stop route optimization with custom waypoints
- Find weigh stations, fuel stops, rest areas, truck stops, parking, and more
- Detailed POIs with diesel prices, hours of operation, click-to-call buttons, and amenity listings
- Traffic and weather overlays for route efficiency and safety
- Safety-First Features
- Weigh station alerts
- Speed limit notifications
- Lane guidance and spoken voice directions
- Dark mode for low-light driving conditions
COVERAGE AREAS
- United States (including Alaska & Hawaii)
- Canada
- Mexico
Whether you're hauling across state lines or navigating complex city routes, Hammer equips you with everything you need to drive smarter, safer, and more efficiently.
Developed by TruckersReport.com — the largest online community of professional truck drivers, dedicated to building tools and resources that empower the trucking industry.

The Tower Defense Battles You Love, Now in PvP! 
Charge into the arena in the best PvP tower defense game ever - welcome to Kingdom Rush Battles!

bluejetty:00023531:ios.description:
The Northwest Public Broadcasting App:
The Northwest Public Broadcasting App allows you to enjoy the services of Northwest Public Broadcasting - radio and TV (NPR and PBS). Listen and watch your favorite shows/clips anywhere you want to. You can also pause and rewind live audio, and view radio and TV program schedules! You can explore, watch and listen to On Demand stories whenever you want and share stories with your friends!
Live Radio Streaming:
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from Northwest Public Broadcasting even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing.
• Integrated program schedules for Northwest Public Broadcasting streams!
• One-click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to Northwest Public Broadcasting in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
Stream Video Content:
• Watch your favorite PBS shows using our DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). Catch up on your favorite shows or important news programs you count on every day.
• Stream your favorite Northwest Public Broadcasting shows including: Jam with Dan, Access NW, Dr. U and more, all in one place!
• Northwest Public Broadcasting members can access their NWPB Passport account, allowing you to watch special curated content!
News:
• Specially curated local news to make sure you know what's happening throughout your day. News that includes: NPR News, Northwest News Network, PBS Newshour, Earthfix and many other public media news outlets. You can even opt in for TEXT MESSAGE ALERTS for breaking news.
• Environmental stories from our friends at EarthFix, covering stories that impact our environment
• Curated NPR and PBS Newshour hour to give you a national perspective on issues
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The Northwest Public Broadcasting app is brought to you by the people at Public Radio and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued viewers and listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, on whatever device you have!
Please support Northwest Public Broadcasting by becoming a member today!
nwpb.org/support

bluejetty:00087984:ios.name: Wallpix: Wallpapers & Themes
bluejetty:00087984:ios.summary:
Dress your Apple Watch and iPhone in one style. WallPix brings watch faces, live wallpapers and Home Screen themes together in a single catalog, with new designs added all the time.
Browse, tap the heart to keep what you like in Favorites,
bluejetty:00087984:ios.description:
Dress your Apple Watch and iPhone in one style. WallPix brings watch faces, live wallpapers and Home Screen themes together in a single catalog, with new designs added all the time.
Browse, tap the heart to keep what you like in Favorites, and install it in a few steps. Every install comes with a short visual guide, so nothing is left to guesswork.
ON YOUR WRIST
• Full screen faces that run in the WallPix app on Apple Watch and can show your heart rate, heart rate variability, steps, walking and running distance, active calories, exercise minutes, stand hours and the local forecast.
• Faces that go straight to My Faces, right next to the faces from Apple. No Wallpix watch app needed for these.
• See each face in a watch case before you send it.
• Keep Display Awake holds a full screen face on screen, and a quick guide shows how to bring WallPix back every time you raise your wrist.
ON YOUR IPHONE
• Wallpapers for the Lock Screen and Home Screen, saved to Photos in full quality.
• Live wallpapers that come to life on your Lock Screen, saved as Live Photos.
• Themes with matching icons and wallpapers. Get all the icons from one downloaded profile, or set them one by one with Shortcuts.
• Wallpaper of the Week and gentle notifications when new faces and wallpapers land. No spam.
GETTING A FACE ON YOUR WATCH
1. Open a face and tap Add to Watch.
2. Allow Health and Location if the face shows activity or weather. You can skip either.
3. Keep your watch near your iPhone until it says Done!
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Health data is read only to show it on your face. WallPix never saves workouts or health data. Location is used only to look up the forecast where you are. Keep Display Awake runs a workout session to hold the face on screen, so your watch battery runs down faster while it's on.
WallPix speaks English, German, Spanish, French and Portuguese.
WALLPIX PREMIUM
Premium unlocks every watch face, wallpaper and theme. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID account settings at any time.
Questions or a face that doesn't look right? Write to help@themeshere.com.
Privacy Policy: https://themeshere.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://themeshere.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00167534:ios.description:
Welcome to Cat Fantasy, an enchanting cyberpunk, anime-style 3D turn-based RPG. Immerse yourself in a world where cats transform into captivating anime girls and beloved waifus. Dive into an Isekai adventure as an Inspector, leading a diverse group of anime cat girl combatants to unravel mysteries and save a world on the brink of destruction.
**Follow us to get more information and rewards:**
Twitter: https://x.com/catfantasyen
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@catfantasyen
Discord: https://discord.gg/catfantasyen
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/catfantasyglobal/
**FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS:**
- Free Pulls: Up to 1,000 free summons!
- Anime Girls & Waifu Collection: Collect and interact with a diverse cast of characters.
- Gacha: Experience the thrill of summoning new anime waifus and upgrading your team.
- Turn-Based RPG Mechanics: Enjoy a blend of classic RPG elements and innovative card fusion tactics.
- Isekai Adventure: Immerse yourself in a captivating storyline that transports you to a cyberpunk world.
- Simulation & Management: Balance your time between battling evil forces and running a cozy café.
**GENEROUS FREE PULLS**
Earn up to 1,000 free summons by logging in, completing missions, and attending events—more generous than other gacha games.
**UNIQUE ANIME CAT GIRL SETTING**
Cat girls seamlessly shift between feline and humanoid forms, harnessing Pathos Particles to maintain their abilities, evoking the charm of neko characters. Immerse yourself in a captivating world where anime girls and feline humanoids intertwine, creating a unique and engaging experience.
**DEEP INTERACTION WITH BELOVED CAT WAIFUS**
Forge intimate connections with your beloved anime girl through private scenes and unlock interactive actions that deepen your bond, crafting an immersive ACG experience. Each anime girl possesses a unique personality and backstory, making your interactions all the more engaging and personal.
**UNIQUE CARD FUSION TURN-BASED COMBAT**
This anime turn-based RPG features an innovative combat style—fuse skill cards to unlock powerful effects. The card fusion system adds depth to the combat, ensuring each encounter is exciting and dynamic.
- Take full control of character turn order, number of actions, and allocation of Ultimate energy within a single turn.
- Customize your lineups with counter-attack, curse-based, or follow-up attack strategies, blending them freely to suit your playstyle.
**STUNNING GRAPHICS**
Experience breathtaking visuals that bring the world to life. Detailed character designs and vibrant environments are sure to captivate fans of anime and cat girls alike.
**SIMULATION ELEMENTS: MANAGING A CAFE**
Embrace a harmonious blend of thrilling battles and tranquility as you manage a charming café. Delight customers with delectable cuisine while lending an ear to their stories, providing a comforting sanctuary amidst chaos in this free simulator.
Immerse yourself in Cat Fantasy, where adventure, love, and mystery intertwine in a unique turn-based RPG. Explore a captivating realm filled with charming neko characters and embark on a journey that will enthrall your heart and imagination. Cat Fantasy offers an engaging experience for anime and cat girl enthusiasts. An unforgettable Isekai adventure awaits!

bluejetty:00184316:ios.summary:

- a myGov account linked to the ATO

bluejetty:00184316:ios.description:
The ATO app allows you to manage your tax and super affairs on the go – making tax simple and easy.
For a personalised tax and super experience, you will need:
- a myGov account linked to the ATO
- to register your device by providing and verifying an Australian mobile number and an email address.
With the ATO app, you can: 
- follow your 2025-26 tax return from start to finish, including checking prefill information, tracking the progress of your return and its outcome
- view in real-time when lodgments and payments are due, and seamlessly action them via our online services
- set up quick login using your device’s security features like face and fingerprint recognition
- view messages in real-time when important changes are made to your ATO record and to verify certain actions before they are submitted
- lock your ATO record if you see fraudulent activity, to keep it safe
- verify if a call claiming to be from the ATO is genuinely from us
- view your tax accounts, with links to our online services to view transactions, create payment plans or pay
- see an overview of your super balance and accounts
- view your employment income and superannuation contributions required from your employers
- check your personal, business (sole traders only) and registered agent’s details
- access our most popular tools.
Our most popular tools include:
- myDeductions: record your work expenses as an employee or sole trader. Sole traders can also record income. At tax time you can easily upload your myDeductions records to your tax return or email a copy to your tax agent.
- Tax withheld calculator: calculate the amount of tax to withhold from salary and wage payments.
- ABN Lookup: search for an Australian business number (ABN).
- Business performance check: compare your business with similar businesses in your industry using the latest Small business benchmarks.
The ATO app can automatically send usage data to help improve the app. The data we collect doesn’t identify you and you can choose to turn this off at any time in your app’s settings.
GPS can be used to record trips in myDeductions. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
To record a trip in myDeductions using the GPS option, the app needs access to your device location.
Find out more at www.ato.gov.au/app

bluejetty:00174614:ios.description:
HopToIt — Australia’s Smarter Transit App
From Melbourne to Brisbane, Perth to Adelaide — get live bus, train, tram, and ferry times across Australia (excluding Sydney) with HopToIt, your all-in-one transport companion.
“HopToIt works brilliantly wherever I travel. The live times are accurate, and the trip planner is super handy for finding the fastest route.”
Why Australians love HopToIt:
• Live public transport tracking across major cities
• Stop and departure alerts
• Smart trip planner with step-by-step directions
• Live and offline route maps
• One-tap “Get Me Home” journeys
• Customisable widgets for quick access
Never miss your stop again — with Get Off Alerts, HopToIt reminds you when it’s time to hop off. Track your bus, train, or tram in real time, see how busy it is before boarding, and stay informed about delays, detours, and service changes.
Whether you’re commuting in Melbourne, exploring Brisbane, or heading home in Adelaide, HopToIt keeps you moving with reliable, real-time information.
Coverage Includes:
• Melbourne: PTV trains, trams, and buses
• Brisbane & SE Queensland: TransLink buses, trains, trams, and ferries
• Perth: Transperth buses, trains, and ferries
• Adelaide: Adelaide Metro buses, trains, and trams
• Canberra: Transport Canberra buses and light rail
• Hobart: Metro Tasmania buses
• Darwin: NT Government bus network
• Regional networks nationwide
• Real-time service alerts, detours, and closures
Plan trips, check live arrivals, and save your favourite stops — all in one app built for travellers across Australia.
--------
What is HopToIt?
HopToIt is a real-time public transport app for Australian cities and towns outside of Sydney. It shows live bus, train, tram, and ferry times, with trip planning and service alerts.
Which cities are supported?
HopToIt covers Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Canberra, Hobart, Darwin, and many regional centres across Australia.
Does it work with PTV, TransLink, and Transperth?
Yes — HopToIt supports all major operators including PTV (Victoria), TransLink (Queensland), Transperth (Western Australia), and Adelaide Metro.
Can I track vehicles in real time?
Absolutely. You can view your bus, train, or tram on the map, see live arrival times, and plan connections easily.
Does it include service alerts and delays?
Yes — HopToIt

bluejetty:00035503:ios.description:
FitSW is personal training software that helps trainers manage clients, build workout plans, track progress, plan nutrition, schedule appointments, accept payments, communicate with clients, and grow their fitness business from any device.
Whether you train clients online, in person, or through a gym, FitSW gives you one platform to manage your coaching, programming, client communication, and business operations.
BUILT-IN CLIENT MESSAGING
Keep coaching conversations connected to the work your clients are doing.
With FitSW’s integrated chat, trainers and clients can discuss workouts, tasks, meal plans, progress, payments, and other in-app resources directly in the conversation. Share links to specific workouts, nutrition plans, goals, tasks, forms, appointments, and more so clients know exactly what you are referring to.
Instead of switching between texts, emails, spreadsheets, and separate apps, FitSW keeps communication tied to each client’s training program.
KEY FEATURES
Workout Management

"Some urgent business has come up, so I'm going to have to leave this farm for a while. So it is to you, who found this letter, that I leave this farm. But do not worry! I have summarized how to take care of this farm in this letter. If you run the farm well, you'll have all the treats you can eat"

bluejetty:00172752:ios.summary:
[What is ScanSnap Home?]
ScanSnap Home is a data management app that lets you easily use "ScanSnap" image scanners from your iPhone or iPad.
Even without a ScanSnap, you can capture paper documents using your smartphone's camera to save a
bluejetty:00172752:ios.description:
[What is ScanSnap Home?]
ScanSnap Home is a data management app that lets you easily use "ScanSnap" image scanners from your iPhone or iPad.
Even without a ScanSnap, you can capture paper documents using your smartphone's camera to save and use them as digital data.
ScanSnap Home automatically converts paper documents, photos, and business cards into data that is easy to find, organized, and ready to use.
ScanSnap Home works seamlessly with cloud services and various apps, allowing you to use your important information securely and conveniently from anywhere.
When used with ScanSnap, ScanSnap Home supports even faster and higher-quality scanning.
[New Feature: ScanSnap Camera Support]
Now you can create scanner-quality images simply by taking a photo of a document with your smartphone.
Whether you are on the go or at home, you can digitize documents on the spot even without a ScanSnap device.
Thanks to the image processing and automatic processing technologies honed in the ScanSnap series, such as background removal, orientation correction, and automatic color detection,
you can save paper documents in a clear and well-organized format.
[Compatible Models]
iX2500, iX1600, iX1500, iX1300, iX100
[ScanSnap Home Features]
・Use with just a smartphone
Even without a ScanSnap device, you can scan paper using your smartphone's camera and manage your data.
・Easy scanning with just a smartphone
When connected to ScanSnap, you can easily configure scan settings and perform scans from your smartphone. No computer is required.
・Automatic saving in the best format for your needs
You can save files in formats suited to your needs, such as PDF or JPEG.
・OCR-based search
You can perform full-text searches based on the recognized text.
・ScanSnap Go for iX2500
Simply hold your smartphone near the ScanSnap to connect, and the connection information is automatically deleted after use.
・Easy data search and viewing
You can instantly search and view saved data, so you can make use of it even when you're on the go.
・Easy sharing through apps
Easily share data through email, chat, and messenger apps.
・ScanSnap Cloud support
Scanned data is automatically categorized into "Documents", "Business Cards", "Receipts", and "Photos", and can be saved to cloud services.
Note: The ScanSnap Camera, OCR function, and ScanSnap Cloud service are only available in regions where the ScanSnap Cloud service is provided.
https://www.pfu.ricoh.com/global/scanners/scansnap/scansnap-cloud/country.html
[Recommended for users who want to...]
・Digitize paper documents without a scanner
・Scan without using a computer
・Check documents while on the go
・Easily share scanned data
・Manage business cards and documents digitally
・Organize information from paper documents so it can be searched right away
・Work primarily on a smartphone
[System Requirements]
The following are required to use this app.
・Wi-Fi environment for either a direct connection or a wireless LAN router
・Wi-Fi-enabled ScanSnap device (when using features that work with ScanSnap)
Note: The ScanSnap Go feature is available only on the iX2500.

bluejetty:00017350:ios.description:
Universal Remote supports hundreds of models with various operating systems and screen resolutions, ranging from basic models no longer in manufacture to 2021 novelties with the most powerful hardware.
The remote differs depending on not only the Smart TV manufacturer but also the type of operating system. 
Touchpad Instead of Buttons. We are confident that navigation with swipe gestures is much more convenient than by pressing regular "down" or "right" buttons, not distracting you from the most important thing: searching for your favorite movie or series on the TV.
Still Can’t Turn the TV On? In a word, you can, but under one condition. Most new Smart TV models support the Wake-on-LAN function. It is possible only if you had already been connected to the TV earlier. Therefore, when using the application for the first time, you will need a hardware remote control. After that, you can use your Universal Remote.
Premium Subscription
You can subscribe for unlimited access to Premium features. Subscription is $19.99 yearly. 
Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines is the equivalent of the subscription price in USD. 
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. For details please visit the link https://support.apple.com/HT202039. 
When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use pictures marked as Premium.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. 
Terms of Use: https://kraftwerk9.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kraftwerk9.com/privacy

Welcome to the Apartment Guide iOS app! 
With new listings from all over the US every day use Apartment Guide to help you find your next rental home, whether you need a place in San Francisco, Houston, Boston, Philadelphia, New York, Los Angeles or anywhere in between!
What others are saying about the Apartment Guide app:
“I love that I can save my favorite places, email directly to all apartment management companies and there is a link for driving directions. The most convenient way for apartment hunting! Thank you!”
“I am so glad I found this app. It’s so informative and helpful. I feel more confident that I will Be able to find a new apartment in the spring. Teri”

• Explore properties using a map or list view.
• Share your favorite properties with friends and family.
• Get an insider’s opinion with the help of real ratings and reviews you can trust from actual residents.
• Save time with our Advanced Search Filters that allow you to specify the number of bedrooms, bathrooms, price range, property type, and desired amenities and more.
• Take a virtual 360-degree tour of many apartments with HD videos and panoramic tours.
• Save your search criteria and get alerted when new listings become available through push notifications and email. 
• Check out apartment photos and floorplan images to get a glimpse of what each unit has to offer.
• Save your favorite rentals to easily access them again and again.
• Continue your search across all your devices including your iPhone and iPad.
• Call or email properties directly from the app.

bluejetty:00137904:ios.description:
Think of Suffolk Transit On-Demand as a whole new way to get around — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. 
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone (or by calling 631-818-2982).
- Get picked up on a nearby street corner.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said. Eligible users can also take advantage of concessionary fares. 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make the world a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride. 
Questions? Reach out at support-suffolk@ridewithvia.com. Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00119676:ios.summary:
Time Tracker by eBillity
Save Time | Increase Profitability
Keep track of time from any device, anywhere with Time Tracker by eBillity. Our time tracking software is securely connected to the cloud and runs automatic backups, so if you lose
bluejetty:00119676:ios.description:
Time Tracker by eBillity
Save Time | Increase Profitability
Keep track of time from any device, anywhere with Time Tracker by eBillity. Our time tracking software is securely connected to the cloud and runs automatic backups, so if you lose your internet connection you can manually sync your time entry to your account once your device is back online. 
Unique Time Tracking
Just like you, your business is unique so when we designed Time Tracker we decided to be unique too which is why we created options based on why you need to track time – is it for payroll or billing?
Time Tracker for Payroll
Time cards are the default setting for Time Tracker and the ideal way to capture your team's time for payroll. Time cards allow employees to clock in and out of shifts, take breaks, switch between projects and receive overtime alerts. 
With time cards the admin or manager can easily: and be notified when their break is coming to an end. 
Monitor employee hours to estimate costs within each pay cycle
Set thresholds to automatically calculate overtime and double time 
Set time rounding (up or down); for example, if an employee clocks in at 08:55 am the time entry can round up and be recorded as 09:00 am.
Receive automatic notifications of a rate increase to overtime/double time
Time Tracker for Billing
Timers are ideal for invoicing clients and they’re the default setting for our Time Tracker +Billing account. With timers you can easily capture every second worked in just one click – run multiple timers, switch between clients, projects and activities. 
Mark time entries as billable or non-billable
Enter your hourly billing rate or add a flat fee
Flag the time entry as standard or overtime
Option to add the time entry to an invoice
Included in every account:
Geolocation tracking
View a detailed map of where your employees were when they logged time to avoid billing disputes and verify locations (displays location after the entry is saved/not real-time tracking).
Time entry approvals
Submitted time entries can be edited, rejected or approved by an admin. Approved time entries automatically sync with your accounting and payroll software (if enabled).
For larger teams, you can assign your managers or supervisors (for example) as an admin so they can review and approve their own team’s time entries.
Time Tracker +Billing also offers expense tracking and client billing!
Manage expenses
Track expenses with your mobile device; take a photo of your receipt and upload it to Time Tracker. Expenses can be reviewed, marked as billable and easily added to client invoices (optional).
Client Billing
Turn time and expenses into branded client invoices, allow your clients to pay invoices instantly when you connect your account with Stripe payment gateway. 
Invoice Management
View your list of invoices to see what percentage is paid and email client invoices from any device. 
Additional Desktop Access
For additional features login to your account via your desktop:
To invite additional people to your account so you can track time as a team
Seamless integration with payroll, expense and accounting software such as Xero, Sage, Intuit’s QuickBooks, ADP, Gusto, Reckon, Concur and MYOB
To access powerful, real-time reports in multiple formats (PDF, CSV, online, HTML)
Detailed time logs to protect you against labor disputes and audits
Configurations for DCAA/DOL compliance
Access to our developer open API
Support is always free
At eBillity we’re here to help you every step of the what which is why we offer free unlimited phone, email, and live chat support to all of our customers. 
Have a question? We’re always happy to help! 
Toll Free: (800) 851-0992
International: +1 (732) 253-4200
Australia: (02) 8317 1139
Mon-Thurs: 9:00 am - 6:00 pm, EST / Friday: 9:00 am - 4:30 pm, EST

bluejetty:00079270:ios.description:
Welcome to the thrilling world of Idle Racer, where you can merge your creativity and passion for driving to build your unique car and participate in intense races against formidable opponents.
In Idle Racer, you start the game with a basic car that you can upgrade using the in-game currency earned simply by tapping the screen. The more you tap and click, the more in-game money you earn. You can spend this money on purchasing new parts for your car, such as engines, tires, spoilers, and much more. You can also merge two parts of the same level to create a higher-level part, which will increase the speed and power of your car.
Stop by the garage and personalize your car by choosing from a wide range of parts, colors and styles - make it truly unique!
Feel the adrenaline rush as you drift around corners and speed past your opponents. Win races and earn rewards!
Idle Racer offers you the thrill of racing, the joy of building your own car, and the excitement of unlocking new possibilities. This game is perfect for everyone who loves cars and racing. Enjoy the game!

bluejetty:00046518:ios.description:
LAFCU Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with LAFCU Mobile:
 -Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
 -Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 -Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 -Transfer money between your accounts
 -Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 -Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 -View and save your monthly statements
 -Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the LAFCU app, you must be enrolled as a LAFCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00141537:ios.description:
Emergency! Patients are waiting in line! Prescription orders are pouring in. The pharmacy is short-staffed and we need your help! If you've ever dreamed of being a doctor and saving lives, then try the pharmacy prescription challenge!
Welcome to the warm and healing Hospital Fever, the doctor game. Here, you will play the role of a hospital medical staff. From the basic pharmacy to different clinics, provide patients with wonderful treatment services, design and build hospital facilities, manage medical staff within the hospital, and build your medical centers around the world!
— Operating and Managing Hospitals —
Provide targeted medical services to patients with different illnesses to help them recover. Earn funds to purchase and upgrade medical facilities, recruit excellent medical staff, improve the hospital's medical environment, gradually expand the hospital's scale, and ultimately build the perfect hospital in your mind!
— Explore Different City-themed Clinics —
Unlock and expand your hospitals around the world. From London, England, to Florence, Italy, and to Kyoto, Japan. The hospital themes in each city are full of local style and characteristics, bringing you different and novel experiences.
Record and cure patients in various cities, form a team of the world's top doctors, and grow into a world medical tycoon in this healing and challenging journey.
— Fun Events and Rich Systems —
There are not only classic daily events such as archive experts, gold medal nurses, extreme rescue, and DNA testing, but also interesting events such as pediatric emergency room, ambulance racing, and charity pharmacy. In addition, there are decoration systems, union systems, and happy value systems to add more fun. A steady stream of events are being developed, waiting for you to challenge!
— Game Features —
• Fresh, cute, relaxed and casual cartoon style.
• Changeable map levels to enjoy different city scenery.
• Freely upgrade equipment and hire doctors with rich strategies.
• A variety of decorations to choose from to build your own hospital style.
• Rich achievement content to easily obtain massive rewards.
• Collect different patients and unlock unique patient illustrations.
• Unique memory system to experience the warm storyline.
More maps and more hospitals are coming soon!
Contact us: hospitalfrenzy@outlook.com

bluejetty:00039791:ios.description:
Yarnal is your personal knitting and crochet journal, designed to help you store, organise, and manage all your creative projects with ease. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced maker, Yarnal keeps everything you need in one beautifully simple app.
With a clean, user-friendly interface, Yarnal makes it simple to store patterns, notes, yarn details, photos, and more. The built-in row counter lets you pick up right where you left off.
KEY FEATURES
• Clear, organised overview of all your knitting and crochet projects
• Easily recreate past projects with stored details and photos
• Never lose a pattern again—store PDFs directly with your projects
• Pick up your work anytime with per-project row counters
• Add yarns, sizes, hooks/needles, and more for complete documentation
• Hands-free tally/row counting with simple voice commands
• Sync across your devices via iCloud
• All your projects in one easy-to-use app
FEEDBACK
Missing a feature? Found a bug? Have a suggestion? Get in touch—your feedback helps make Yarnal even better.
FREE VS. UNLIMITED
The free version includes a limited number of projects, ads, and some feature restrictions.
Upgrade to Yarnal Unlimited to unlock the full experience—available via monthly, yearly, or one-time purchase.
Payments are charged to your App Store account. Subscriptions can be managed or canceled at any time in your account settings under Subscriptions.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00154375:ios.description:
How to Play:
Become the ocean's ultimate matchmaker! Help adorable sea creatures grow from tiny tadpoles to majestic whales in this gravity-defying underwater puzzle adventure.
Core Mechanics
1、360° Ocean Launchpad
Swipe & Aim: Drag anywhere on the circular reef border to aim
Power Control: The longer you hold, the stronger your throw!
Tidal Physics: All creatures drift toward the swirling vortex center
2、Marine Match Magic
Merge two identical creatures to unlock 10 dazzling species:
lownfish → crab → Pufferfish → ... → Majestic Whale!
Strategic stacking creates chain reactions - watch seahorses flip-tumble into combos!
3、Bubble Survival
Keep all creatures inside the protective bubble - one escape = GAME OVER!
Dynamic Gravity: No boring vertical drops - plan orbital merges
Skill-Based Shooting: Master bank shots & rebound angles
ASMR Ocean: Lullaby waves + squeaky-cute creature sounds
4、Pro Tips
"Aim for cluster edges to trigger domino mergers!"
“Save power boosts for late-game giant squids”
“Rotate your device to "steer" the gravity flow!”
Perfect For:
Match-2 fans craving physics depth
Animal lovers who adore aquatic cuteness
Strategy gamers who love risk/reward tension
Ready to Make a Splash?
"The most refreshing merge game since sliced sushi!"

bluejetty:00146722:ios.name: HookBook: Sex Tracker & PrEP
bluejetty:00146722:ios.summary:
HookBook is a private sex tracker, dating calendar, sexual health journal, and partner album built for adults who want a secure way to remember partners, protection, PrEP, DoxyPEP, STI screenings, photos, videos, and personal history.
Whet
bluejetty:00146722:ios.description:
HookBook is a private sex tracker, dating calendar, sexual health journal, and partner album built for adults who want a secure way to remember partners, protection, PrEP, DoxyPEP, STI screenings, photos, videos, and personal history.
Whether you are single, queer, polyamorous, in an open relationship, dating casually, or simply taking better care of your sexual wellness, HookBook helps you keep your information organized without ads or social networking.
HookBook is not a dating app. It is your private record, calendar, partner album, and little black book.
Track Your Sex Life Privately
Log the details that matter to you:
- Date, time, notes, locations, and custom tags
- Partners and anonymous encounters
- Protection status
- Activity history and frequency
- Private partner albums for photos, screenshots, and videos
- Location-tagged activities on your Insight Map
Private Partner Albums
Keep partner-related photos, screenshots, and videos organized inside HookBook instead of mixing them with your main photo library. Use private albums to remember people, moments, profiles, conversations, or anything else you want stored with your dating history.
Sexual Health Tools
Stay more organized with:
- STI/STD and HIV screening reminders
- PrEP tracking and history
- TasP/ART medication reminders
- DoxyPEP logging for post-exposure STI prevention
- Calendar views that compare sex history, protection, PrEP, and DoxyPEP
- Apple Health integration
Insights and Calendar
Understand your patterns over time:
- Activity frequency
- Partner history
- Body count
- Protection breakdowns
- Top partners, tags, and locations
- Monthly and yearly summaries
- Map-based insights
- Wrapped-style personal recaps
HookBook Keyboard
Save your go-to dating messages, replies, or phrases and quickly insert them anywhere with the HookBook Keyboard. It is useful for dating apps, texting, and any conversation where you reuse the same phrases often.
Privacy First
HookBook is designed for sensitive personal information:
- Face ID / Touch ID protection
- No ads
- No personal data collected
- Private by design
- Lightweight and simple to use
- Backup and restore support
Built for Modern Dating
HookBook is useful for people exploring casual dating, queer dating, poly dating, open relationships, swinging, threesomes, consensual non-monogamy, or simply tracking sexual wellness over time.
For gay, bisexual, queer, trans, nonbinary, and other sexually active adults, HookBook can help connect your personal history with your sexual health routine.
Important: HookBook is a tracking and reminder tool, not medical advice. Talk with a healthcare professional before making decisions about PrEP, DoxyPEP, STI testing, HIV prevention, treatment, or medication use.
Take control of your private sexual wellness record with HookBook.
Contact: info@hookbook.app
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00061316:ios.summary:

This is the full featured Plus Edition o
bluejetty:00061316:ios.description:
Visual Thinkers Rejoice!
Inkflow works like a word-processor for visual thinking. Capture your ideas as easily as with pen and paper, then arrange and reorganize them with your fingers!
INKFLOW PLUS
This is the full featured Plus Edition of Inkflow. It is the same as the in-app purchase from the basic edition Inkflow. Please download this only if you haven't already upgraded in-App.
DIGITAL WRITING DONE RIGHT
Inkflow's ink feels like a really smooth fountain pen. Great for expressive writing or sketching. Effortlessly scale or move anything you select. This will change the way you think about ink: Jot down a list of concepts then rearrange them to fit into the bigger picture. literally move your thoughts around the page, and assemble big ideas with your fingers. This works great for brainstorming and planning. It's also perfect for prototyping layouts, sketching, and drawing.
FULL RESOLUTION ZOOM
Zoom and pan with two fingers. Inkflow's ink stays sharp no matter how much you zoom in, so you can add fine details at full quality. It's also lightning fast and lag free. This allows writing and drawing with incredible precision, with or without a stylus.
INKPORT: COPY AND PASTE FROM THE REAL WORLD
Only Inkflow Plus includes the revolutionary Inkport tool. Inkport uses your iPad's camera to instantly convert your written notes and sketches into Inkflow's native vector ink. Easily pull in materials from multiple sources and go from paper to iPad without missing a beat. Inkport is going to change the way you use paper in your workflow.
TEXT, PHOTOS, and PAPER BACKGROUNDS TOO
Insert text boxes and photos anywhere on the page and resize them seamlessly with the ink. You can also choose from a selection of different paper backgrounds.
EASILY CREATE and SHARE
Inkflow let's you export your books to PDF, high-resolution JPEG, and share them via Twitter, Email, or with other Apps.
PLUS FEATURES
This edition includes the full set of expanded features, including:
- Inkport
- iCloud sync
- Dozens of beautiful stationery designs
- Multiple grid, dotted, lined, and hex paper templates
- A customizable, full color palette,
- Pencil, Eraser, and Paint Brush tools,
- Rotate, Cut, Copy, Paste Ink,
- Page Management,
- Notebooks with unlimited pages,
- An additional 50+ fonts on the iPad,
- Custom paper backgrounds,
- And more!
Universal App for iPad, iPhone and iPod Touch: Upgrade once and get Inkflow Plus on all your compatible devices connected to your iTunes account!
GREAT FOR CLASS
We built a standalone Plus Edition mainly so that Educational institutions can take advantage of the volume purchase program (check with your school's Apple rep for details).
A PLATFORM FOR CREATIVITY
We strongly believe that the iPad is not just a consumption device. It's a creativity device. Thanks for supporting us in our journey of building Creative Apps like Inkflow. We hope you enjoy it!

bluejetty:00019288:ios.description:
Klasik Okey oyunudur. Okey yapay zekası, zengin görsel efektleri, basit, kullanışlı arayüzü ile amaca uygun okey oyunu karşınızda. İnternetsiz, bilgisayara karşı okey oynayın. Herkese iyi eğlenceler.
Okey Özellikleri:
- Game Center,
- Başarılar,
- Sıralamalar,
- İstatistikler,
- Görevler,
- Seviyeler.
Ayarlar:
- Sayıdan düş belirleme,
- Oyun Hız Ayarı,
- Renkli Okey açık / kapalı,
- Gösterge puanı açık / kapalı,
- Akıllı Taş Dizme açık / kapalı
Oyun Seti:
Okey oyunu standart olarak dört adet oyuncuyla oynanır. Okeyde oyuncunun taşları dizmesi için ıstaka ismi verilen tabla bulunur. Kırmızı, siyah, mavi ve yeşil renklerinde 1'den 13'e kadar numaralı ikişer setten oluşan toplam 106 tane taş bulunur. Taşların içinde iki adet sahte okey taşı da vardır.
Başlangıç:
Taşlar karıştırılıp her bir oyuncuya 14’er taş verilir. İlk oynayacak oyuncuya 1 adet taş fazladan verilir ve 15 taşla başlatılır. Oyuna 15 taş dağıtılan kişi başlar. Oyuncular kendilerine dağıtılan taşları önlerindeki ıstakaya dizerler. Geriye kalan taşlar, rakam kısmı masaya gelecek şekilde üst üste dizili olarak ortaya konur. Ortada dizili taşların üzerinde yer alan taşın bir üst değeri okey taşıdır. Bu taş her eksik taşın yerine kullanılabilmektedir.
Normal Diziliş:
Oyuncunun elindeki on dört taş, en az üç taştan oluşmak koşuluyla, doğru perlere (gruplara) ayrılmalıdır. Normal dizilişte iki farklı per mevcuttur.
- Grupta yer alan tüm taşlar aynı değerde ancak farklı renklerde olmalıdır. Bu grupta üç ya da dört taş yer alır.
- Gruptaki (perdeki) tüm taşlar aynı renkte ve birbirini sırayla takip eden sayılardan meydana gelmelidir. Bu grupta en az üç taştan oluşmalıdır.
- Bazı durumlarda ise 13 numaralı taştan sonra 1 numaralı taş gelebilir, fakat bu taştan sonra 2, 3, 4 gibi üst sayı taşlar konamaz.
Çifte Diziliş:
- Oyuncu elinde bulunan taşlardan, her biri aynı değerde ve renkte yedi adet çift taş dizmelidir.
Gösterge Kuralı:
Yeni bir el başladığında, elinde gösterge taşının aynısı olan oyuncu oynama sırası geldiğinde bu taşı gösterir ve kasadaki miktarın yarısını kazanır. Gösterge yapmak için eldeki taşı ortadaki gösterge taşının üzerine çekerek bırakmak gerekir. Gösterge diğer oyunculara bir puan cezası olarak yansıtılır.
Bitiş Türleri:
- Bitişte kullanılan taş sıradan bir taş ise normal bitiş sayılır. Puan değeri 2'dir.
-‘Okey dışarı’'da denir. Bitişte destenin üzerine bırakılan taş Okey taşı ise oyuncu okey atmış sayılır. Elin puan değerini 2'ye katlar.
- Taşların dizilimi çiftlere göre yapılmışsa; yani ıstakadaki her taşın bir çifti varsa, oyuncu çiftten bitmiş sayılır. Puan değeri 4'tür.Çifte gitmeyi belirtmek zorunda degildir.
- Bütün taşlar aynı renkte ve 1’den 13’e kadar sıralı ise sıralı renk yapılmıştır. Bu durumda puanlar ne olursa olsun hepsi sıfıra düşülür ve oyun biter.
- Bu bitiş türünde ise bütün taşlar aynı renkte ve sıralı bir biçimdedir ama bazı taşlar ikişer tane olduğundan sırasız renk yapılmıştır ve sekiz puan değerindedir.
NOT: 
- OYUNDA PUANLAMALAR VE İSTATİSTİKLER ANLIK OLARAK GÜNCELLENMEZ!

Gösterge yapmak için eldeki taşı ortadaki gösterge taşının üzerine çekerek bırakmak gerekir. Gösterge diğer oyunculara bir puan cezası olarak yansıtılır.

- Bitişte kullanılan taş sıradan bir taş ise normal bitiş sayılır. Puan değeri 2'dir.

- Bütün taşlar aynı renkte ve 1’den 13’e kadar sıralı ise sıralı renk yapılmıştır. Bu durumda puanlar ne olursa olsun hepsi sıfıra düşülür ve oyun biter.
- Bu bitiş türünde ise bütün taşlar aynı renkte ve sıralı bir biçimdedir ama bazı taşlar ikişer tane olduğundan sırasız renk yapılmıştır ve sekiz puan değerindedir.

bluejetty:00172178:ios.summary: Yo, check it out! Layer Man is an insanely exciting hyper-casual mobile game that guarantees players an entertaining and addictive experience. The game is all about a stickman runner who races through a crowded runway to collect as many hoo
bluejetty:00172178:ios.description:
Yo, check it out! Layer Man is an insanely exciting hyper-casual mobile game that guarantees players an entertaining and addictive experience. The game is all about a stickman runner who races through a crowded runway to collect as many hoops as possible without hitting any obstacles.
One of the most awesome things about the game is how simple it is. All you gotta do is collect layers scattered throughout the runway to build a slinky toy. The more layers you collect, the longer the slinky toy becomes, which can give you a sweet boost on the final stage of the level. It's easy to understand, but challenging to master, which keeps things interesting.
As you're running through the runway, you gotta navigate through various obstacles to avoid collisions. If you bump into an obstacle, you lose some hoops, which ain't cool for your overall score. That's why it's crucial to keep collecting hoops and dodging obstacles like a boss.
And to make things even more exciting, Layer Man has multiple levels with increasing difficulty. You gotta step up your game and navigate through these levels, collecting layers and avoiding obstacles like a pro, to become one of the masters of the game.
But wait, there's more! Layer Man isn't just a fun game to play. It also tests your reflexes, concentration, and agility. As you progress through the game, you gotta hone these skills to succeed, which is a dope opportunity to boost your attributes.
The graphics of Layer Man are visually appealing, with vibrant colors and a smooth interface, making it an enjoyable experience for players of all ages. The game's design is both fun and intuitive, which makes it easy to pick up and play for anyone who's interested.
So, what are you waiting for? Download Layer Man now and put your running skills to the test. Collect as many layers as you can, avoid obstacles, and win the game! Whether you're looking for a fun way to pass the time or you're an experienced gamer, Layer Man is sure to provide you with hours of entertainment.

bluejetty:00138283:ios.summary: "Mind Reader" is a futuristic twist on the classic game of 20 questions that will leave you astounded at its ability to guess what's on your mind! This game transports players into a world where technology meets telepathy, providing an expe
bluejetty:00138283:ios.description:
"Mind Reader" is a futuristic twist on the classic game of 20 questions that will leave you astounded at its ability to guess what's on your mind! This game transports players into a world where technology meets telepathy, providing an experience that's both visually stunning and mentally stimulating.
Here's how it works: Players start by selecting a category for their thoughts, choosing from options such as animals, sport, movies, and more. Once you've locked in your secret thought, "Mind Reader" springs into action, using its advanced algorithm to ask you a series of yes/no questions. Your task is simple - answer honestly and watch in amazement as the game narrows down the possibilities with each question.
But that's not all! "Mind Reader" is designed to challenge itself and you, striving to guess your thought in 20 questions or less. With each playthrough, you'll be intrigued by its uncanny ability to get into your head, making every game a unique encounter with this digital psychic.
Fun, interesting, and a little bit mysterious, "Mind Reader" promises an engaging experience without compromising your privacy. We understand the importance of keeping your thoughts to yourself, which is why we guarantee that no personal information regarding players is ever collected. This game is purely for entertainment, allowing you to dive into a world of guesswork and wonder without any strings attached.
So, are you ready to test the limits of "Mind Reader"? Can it really figure out what you're thinking, or will you be the one to stump the system? There's only one way to find out. Join us in this futuristic journey of mind games, where your thoughts become the playground for the ultimate guessing game!

bluejetty:00062567:ios.description:
The Piper PA-44 Training is an innovative new way to study aircraft systems and limitations. System description sections take the main information from the POH and organizes in easy to navigate chapters.
Interactive diagrams for the major systems allow the user to tap on various switches, levers, circuit breakers, and buttons and watch how those inputs change the diagram. Descriptions and limitations are also noted for various parts of each system throughout the diagram.

DISCLAIMER: The Piper PA-44 Training App is to be used as a reference only and cannot be used for flight or to replace formal training.

bluejetty:00041327:ios.summary:
► Could we live more than one real life?
We only get one chance to live this wonderful but tricky life. Should we be less careful and take more risks, or, on the contrary, should we think through each and every step? 
That's a hard questi
bluejetty:00041327:ios.description:
► Could we live more than one real life?
We only get one chance to live this wonderful but tricky life. Should we be less careful and take more risks, or, on the contrary, should we think through each and every step? 
That's a hard question to answer, isn’t it? But let's imagine we do have a golden opportunity to experience our life several different times - in other words, to try as many things as possible so we get the best possible result.
Sounds like a good idea! Are you ready to take a chance and change your personal reality right now? Life simulator Staff can help you. It gives you an interesting and unusual way to create your own virtual version of real life: eat well, sleep well, work hard, buy a house, and, sure get a cat…Oh! And don't forget to fix the outlet in the bedroom! So you see, everything in our life simulator depends on you and you alone!
► Grab a pen and write down your to-do list for today!
Welcome to your new house, time to turn it into a cozy home! Starting now, you'll be responsible for household responsibilities like putting up wallpaper, putting in new floors, fixing all the outlets, and many other crucially important things! Wait a second! Maintaining a house costs a lot nowadays! Do you have the money to spend on it?
This is where our life simulator turns into a job simulator! You'll be offered a wide range of job opportunities. Every day you will have to work hard and earn money to make your home warm and comfortable.
Honestly, it basically follows the same logic as real life: gotta work hard for the money. 
► Song lyrics aside, here goes the game description.
Every single day, you will face different problems that will all have to be solved as soon as possible. You'll have to work hard and complete diverse tasks: wait tables in a restaurant, put out fires and save people, feed pets and clean apartments, and more. The job simulator will definitely help you learn about dozens of professional fields and prepare you to join any team.
Also, household chores will pop up on a regular basis. This house design game is aimed at improving all aspects of your living conditions every day. There's never a dull moment!
Remember that being a hardworking person and earning money is the only way you'll be able to fix up your new house and make your romantic partner happy.
► Features of the app:
• Inspiring level structure: each one unlocks unique new opportunities. It's one of those popular house design games where you can build your dream house.
• Breathtaking storytelling: the game motivates you to get busy! Each action has a detailed backstory and possible consequences.
• Cost accounting guide: you will learn how to manage money. You'll be balancing the high cost of different additions against the restrictions of your salary.
• Goal-oriented tasks: to work or not to work, that is the question! Every single action is a part of an overall strategy that will get you the results you want.
Rise to the challenge and test yourself: could you live more than one real life? 
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

REPLY TO CONVERSATIONS
Paste a message or choose a screenshot to generate reply suggestions. Choose a tone and language, review the results, then copy the response you want to use.

WRITE AND REWRITE
Describe what you want to say, ask for writing help, or improve an existing message.

SUMMARIZE TEXT AND SCREENSHOTS
Submit text or a selected screenshot to generate a summary.

CREATE CAPTIONS
Turn your ideas into captions for social posts.

ONLINE AI PROCESSING
Reply AI uses online services to generate responses. Text you submit, text extracted from selected screenshots, and images submitted to the summarizer are sent to our servers for processing. The app also uses purchase verification, usage analytics and crash diagnostics. See our privacy policy for the data collected and your choices.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Some features require an auto-renewable subscription. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Dominican Republic Radio – Tune Into the Soul of the Caribbean 
Feel the rhythm and culture of the Dominican Republic no matter where you are! Dominican Republic Radio lets you stream live FM and AM stations directly from Santo Domingo, Santiago, Punta Cana, and beyond.
From energetic merengue and bachata to reggaeton, pop, talk shows, and local news — this app brings the authentic Dominican sound to your fingertips, 24/7.

Enjoy crystal-clear sound and fast, stable streaming.

Save the stations you love most for quick and easy access.
Build your personalized Dominican playlist.

Instantly revisit your recently played channels.
Never lose track of your favorite stations.

Fall asleep to soft tropical tunes or smooth Dominican rhythms.

Quickly find stations by name, genre, or city.
Discover hidden gems and trending channels with ease.
 Bring the Caribbean vibe wherever you go!
Whether you want to dance to bachata, groove to merengue, or catch up on the latest Dominican news — this app is your ultimate radio companion.
Download Dominican Republic Radio today and stay connected to the sound, spirit, and culture of the DR — anytime, anywhere!

Grid Filler: Shikaku Tiles is a clean and satisfying logic puzzle built around filling grids with perfect rectangles using pure reasoning.
Divide each grid into squares and tiles, making sure every section matches its number exactly. The rules are simple, but every decision matters. One misplaced tile can block the whole board, while a smart move reveals a smooth, elegant solution.
Inspired by the classic Shikaku puzzle style, Grid Filler challenges your brain with calm, focused gameplay. There are no timers, no pressure — just you, the grid, and the quiet satisfaction of solving a problem the right way.
Designed for short sessions and deep concentration, Grid Filler is perfect for relaxing while training your logic and pattern-recognition skills. Whether you’re looking to unwind or sharpen your mind, every level offers a fresh, rewarding puzzle to solve.

Perfect Face is a powerful AI selfie editing, makeup, and photo retouch app designed for natural, realistic, and professional results. With advanced AI makeup tools, Perfect Face lets you apply virtu
bluejetty:00099084:ios.description:
Perfect Face – AI Makeup & Photo Editor
Perfect Face is a powerful AI selfie editing, makeup, and photo retouch app designed for natural, realistic, and professional results. With advanced AI makeup tools, Perfect Face lets you apply virtual makeup, enhance facial features, and retouch photos instantly using just one photo.
Unlike many AI photo apps that require multiple images to train a model, Perfect Face works with a single image. Upload one photo and get instant AI face retouching, makeup enhancement, body editing, and photo improvement with high-quality results in seconds.
Perfect Face combines AI face editing, virtual makeup, body shaping, beauty retouching, and photo enhancement tools into one simple solution. Improve selfies, upgrade portraits, fix group photos, retouch body shape, enhance old pictures, and correct bad lighting with one tap. Designed for users who want natural results that still look like the real you.
AI Selfie Editor & Natural Makeup
Perfect Face delivers realistic AI retouching and virtual makeup without an over-edited look. Improve skin texture, remove blemishes, smooth skin, brighten eyes, and balance facial features while maintaining natural detail and skin tone. Apply soft makeup effects, glow, and warmth for a polished but authentic appearance.
Why Perfect Face Is Different
Many face editing apps rely on unrealistic filters or require multiple photos to produce results. Perfect Face focuses on natural beauty and instant one-photo editing. Results are subtle, high-quality, and professionally refined. No distortion, no fake skin, no exaggerated makeup. Perfect Face enhances your photo while staying true to your original look.
Perfect for users who want to retouch photos quickly, enhance social media content, improve dating profile images, or polish selfies before sharing.
Key Features
AI Face Editor & Retouch
• One-tap face retouch
• Skin smoothing and texture enhancement
• Remove acne, wrinkles, and blemishes
• Teeth whitening and eye brightening
• Facial balance and reshaping
AI Makeup & Beauty Editor
• Natural virtual makeup effects
• Soft makeup, glow, and warmth
• Designed for realistic, camera-ready results
AI Photo Enhancer
• Turn low-quality or blurry photos into HD
• Improve lighting, exposure, and colors
• Restore old or grainy photos
Body Editor
• Natural body shape adjustments

bluejetty:00200204:ios.name: On Pace: Steps vs Average
bluejetty:00200204:ios.summary:
Are you walking more or less than usual today? One glance at your wrist answers it.
On Pace draws the comparison you know from the Health app (today so far against your average day) and puts it where you actually look: on your Apple Watch
bluejetty:00200204:ios.description:
Are you walking more or less than usual today? One glance at your wrist answers it.
On Pace draws the comparison you know from the Health app (today so far against your average day) and puts it where you actually look: on your Apple Watch face and on your iPhone Home Screen.
THE GRAPH, ON YOUR WATCH FACE
An orange line for today, a grey line for your average, and the two numbers that matter. It fits the large rectangular slot of Modular and Infograph Modular, and the Smart Stack. Smaller slots show how far along your usual pace you are.
THE SAME NUMBERS AS THE HEALTH APP
The day graph averages the previous four weeks, hour by hour, exactly as Health does. What you see on your wrist matches what you see in Health.
DAY, WEEK, MONTH AND YEAR
This week against your usual week. This month against your usual month. This year against the years before it.
LIKE WITH LIKE
Mondays are not Saturdays. Compare today with the same day of the week, or this November with your other Novembers.
BARS, TOO
Hours of today, the last seven days, the last twelve weeks or months, side by side with their average.
NOT ONLY STEPS
Distance, active energy and flights climbed get the same graphs.
WIDGETS ON IPHONE
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with the same comparison.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
On Pace reads your activity from Apple Health, with your permission, and never writes to it. Your data stays on your iPhone and your Apple Watch. No account, no servers, no analytics, no ads.
Apple Watch is optional: the iPhone app and widgets work on their own.

Develop your film with a smile!
Develop! is a flexible, elegant timer for developing film and working in the darkroom. Build your own development recipes in a few taps: as many steps as you need, each with its own agitation intervals. It's entirely up to you; you're in full control.
Notable features:
- Voice Control: Hands wet? Just say "NEXT" to move on to the next step. Recognition runs on your iPhone, no internet connection needed.
- Keeps time in the background: Leave the app or lock your phone and the timer keeps running. You'll get a notification when a step ends and at every agitation.
- Intervals: A built-in interval timer handles things like "beep after the first minute, then every 30 seconds." You'll see at a glance how long until your next inversion.
- Darkroom Mode: A strict red-on-black theme for darkroom use.
- Flexible: As many recipes and steps as you like, steps of up to 90 minutes, named your way, with notes for every recipe.
- Easy to read: A large timer you can see across the room, styled after a classic camera body, right down to the vulcanite.
- Import: Bring in recipes straight from FilmDev.org.
- Share: Send a recipe as a file with Mail, Messages, AirDrop or anything else on the share sheet.
No more losing track of time or forgetting to agitate every 30 seconds. Concentrate on being the best photographer and alchemist you can be, and leave the timing to Develop! Now go out there and shoot a roll of film. Good luck!
100% free. Always.

Saturn — Your Personal RSS Universe
Saturn is a beautifully designed RSS reader built for people who love staying informed without the noise of social media algorithms. Follow your favorite websites, blogs, YouTube channels, and news publications all in one clean, fast, and distraction-free experience across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Whether you’re catching up on breaking news, reading long-form articles, or saving stories for later, Saturn helps you focus on what matters most: the content.
Features
• Follow your favorite websites and publications with RSS
• Read articles in a clean, distraction-free Reader View
• Sync your feeds, bookmarks, and reading progress with iCloud
• Save articles to revisit anytime
• Discover new publications and expand your reading
• Beautiful native experience designed for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Fast, lightweight, and privacy-focused
• Organize your reading experience your way
• Minimal interface designed for comfortable daily reading
• Stay up to date without clutter, or algorithmic feeds
Built for Apple Devices
Saturn is designed specifically for the Apple ecosystem with support for:
• iPhone
• iPad
• Mac
• iCloud Sync
Your reading experience stays seamlessly synced across all your devices, so you can start reading on one device and continue on another.
Distraction-Free Reading
Saturn’s built-in Reader View removes clutter so you can focus entirely on the article. Clean typography, simplified layouts, and a calm reading experience make long-form content enjoyable again.
Discover New Sources
Explore curated publications and discover new voices, websites, and topics to follow. Build your perfect personalized news feed from trusted sources across technology, business, science, entertainment, gaming, sports, and more.
Save What Matters
Bookmark articles and create your own personal reading library. Saturn makes it easy to return to important stories whenever you want.
Privacy First
Your feeds and reading experience are yours. Saturn is designed with a privacy-focused approach and uses iCloud to securely sync your data across devices.
Download Saturn and build your perfect reading experience.
Saturns Privacy Policy - https://saturn-rss-reader.vercel.app/privacy
Saturns Terms Of Service - https://saturn-rss-reader.vercel.app/terms
